title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of cleanand sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that: describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and ScienceSalary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Kommunaldirektør til Morsø Kommune (genopslag)
description:
Vil du sætte det lange lys på Morsø?

Morsø er på mange måder en kommune, der kan mere end størrelsen umiddelbart tilsiger. Her er korte afstande, stærke fællesskaber og en særlig evne til at skabe resultater med afsæt i lokale styrker. Kulturmødet er ét eksempel. Hanklits optagelse på UNESCOs Verdensarvsliste i 2026 er et andet.

Nu søger vi en kommunaldirektør, der sammen med kommunalbestyrelsen, organisationen og øens mange aktører vil tage næste skridt. Du kommer ikke til en kommune, der skal ”fikses”. Du kommer til en organisation med et stærkt fundament, stor faglig dedikation og erfarne ledere – men også til en kommune, der står over for vigtige strategiske valg: befolkningsudviklingen, fremtidens velfærd, den grønne omstilling, erhvervsudvikling, bosætning og Morsøs nye UNESCO-position kalder på et langsigtet blik og evnen til at omsætte ambitioner til handling.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe retning, sammenhæng og gennemslagskraft.

Som kommunaldirektør er du øverste administrative rådgiver for borgmesteren, økonomiudvalget og hele kommunalbestyrelsen. Du skal sikre professionel og transparent politisk betjening, skabe gode beslutningsprocesser, og samtidig have mod til at bringe nye perspektiver ind i det politiske rum.

Du skal stå i spidsen for direktionen og sikre, at organisationen arbejder samlet om de politiske mål. Det indebærer blandt andet at styrke den tværgående ledelse og evnen til i fællesskab at omsætte strategier og politiske prioriteringer til virkelighed, udvikle samarbejdet på tværs og vurdere, hvordan organisationen bedst understøtter de kommende års opgaver. Samtidig skal du være en synlig og nærværende leder, der kan mærkes i organisationen og i de lokale miljøer – og sammen med borgmesteren være en aktiv ambassadør for Morsø Kommune regionalt og nationalt.

Vi søger en erfaren offentlig leder

Du har betydelig ledelseserfaring – herunder erfaring med ledelse af ledere – fra en kompleks, politisk styret organisation. Kommunal erfaring er en fordel. Du har stærk forståelse af politisk betjening, strategisk ledelse, økonomistyring og organisationsudvikling. Som leder kan du både sætte retning og skabe følgeskab. Du giver ansvar og ledelsesrum, men du går heller ikke af vejen for selvstændigt at udarbejde større og komplekse oplæg til politisk drøftelse.

Personligt lægger vi vægt på, at du møder mennesker i øjenhøjde, skaber tillid og kan samle forskellige perspektiver om en fælles retning. Du skal kunne navigere sikkert mellem politik, organisation og omverdenen – og have både nysgerrighed og mod til at udfordre det bestående, når det er nødvendigt.

Om Morsø Kommune

Morsø Kommune har ca. 19.300 indbyggere, omkring 1.500 årsværk og et årligt budget på ca. 1,8 mia. kr. Organisationen er bygget op omkring en tværgående direktion, syv faglige centre og en tværgående driftsstab.

title: Elektronikfagtekniker søges – vær med til at løse globale vandudfordringer.
description:
Elektronikfagtekniker søges – vær med til at løse globale vandudfordringer.

Vil du arbejde med avanceret teknologi, der gør en reel forskel i verden? Og trives du med både præcision, håndværk og teamwork? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi er en ambitiøs scale-up virksomhed, der udspringer fra forskning på Aarhus Universitet med en klar mission. Nemlig at udvikle næste generations jordscannere og bidrage til løsningen af verdens stigende vandproblemer. Siden vores etablering i 2020 er vi vokset til et stærkt team på 20+ medarbejdere og vi er kun lige begyndt.

Nu søger vi en elektronikfagtekniker (eller tilsvarende) til produktionen, der vil være med til at bringe vores banebrydende teknologi fra produktion til virkelighed.

Om os.

Hos TEMcompany udvikler, producerer og sælger vi avancerede geofysiske instrumenter, der hjælper med at afbøde den globale vandkrise. Vores styrke ligger i samspillet mellem hardware og software fra mikroprocessorfirmware og FPGA til brugervenlige interfaces på både Windows og mobile platforme.

Vi gør kompleks teknologi tilgængelig for ikke-eksperter og vores løsninger er allerede på vej ud i verden.

Virksomheden er delvist ejet af Poul Due Jensen | Grundfos Fonden.

Din rolle.

Du bliver en central del af vores produktionsteam, hvor du arbejder hands-on med elektronik og tilhørende mekanik. Du er med til at opbygge og kvalitetssikre instrumenter, der skal fungere i praksis og under ofte barske forhold.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Er uddannet elektronikfagtekniker eller har tilsvarende erfaring med produktion af avancerede instrumenter

  • Har sans for kvalitet, detaljer og godt håndværk.

  • Trives i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger.

  • Ser løsninger frem for problemer også når tempoet er højt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver.

  • Lodning (blyfri og SMD) samt montering af komponenter.

  • Opbygning og samling af instrumenter (elektronisk og mekanisk).

  • Kabling og terminering i instrumentkasser.

  • Montering af boards og stikforbindelser.

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af teknisk dokumentation.

  • Dokumentation af instrumenter i vores management system.

  • Ad hoc-opgaver i produktionen.

  •  Du har god erfaring med korrekt ESD-håndtering og er fortrolig med PC på brugerniveau.

Vi tilbyder.

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og gode ansættelsesforhold.

  • En velfungerende produktion og frokostordning.

  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med højt fagligt niveau og plads til udvikling.

Og vigtigst af alt bliver du en del af en virksomhed, hvor dit arbejde bidrager til løsninger, der forbedrer livskvaliteten for mennesker verden over.

Din ansøgning.

  • En kort ikke AI-genereret ansøgning, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og din motivation.

  • Dit CV med relevant erfaring og eventuelle referencer.

Evaluering.

Opstart ønskes snarest, og egnede kandidater bliver inviteret til samtale løbende. Send ansøgning, CV og eventuelle referencer til jobs@temcompany.com. Angiv ” Elektronikfagtekniker” i emnefeltet.

Du kan læse mere om TEMcompany på www.temcompany.com.

Kontakt Murat Celikcan for mere information på mc@temcompany.com eller telefon +4529135451.

title: Enhedslisten på Christiansborg søger politisk rådgiver på bolig og transport (barselsvikariat)
description:
Vil du være en del af en spændende og omskiftelig hverdag på Christiansborg, hvor du kommer helt tæt på beslutningerne? Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens Danmark og flytte de store dagsordener? Brænder du for transport og bolig?

Vi søger en politisk rådgiver i et barselsvikariat som strækker sig fra 1. februar til 30. juni, der kan rådgive Enhedslisten på bolig og transportområdet. Som politisk rådgiver skal du understøtte vores folketingsgruppe, og særligt de relevante ordførere, med at kvalificere og kommunikere vores politik inden for de nævnte områder.

ArbejdsopgaverDer er ikke to dage som er ens, men som politisk rådgiver for Enhedslistens folketingsgruppe skal du blandt andet:

·         Yde faglig bistand og rådgivning af folketingsmedlemmer

  • Understøtte folketingsmedlemmernes presse- og kommunikationsarbejde på dine områder

  • Researchopgaver og udarbejdelse af politiske udspil.

·         Samarbejde med relevante organisationer

 

Om digVi stiller ikke firkantede krav, hverken til din uddannelsesbaggrund eller dit CV. Vi forestiller os, at du:

-          Har indsigt i Enhedslistens politik særligt på bolig og transportområdet

-          Har arbejdet med et eller flere af de nævnte politikområder

-          Ved hvordan Enhedslisten kommer ud over rampen med vores politik og forstår at formulere dig skarpt i tale og på skrift

-          Kan strukturere din arbejdsdag og arbejde selvstændigt, samtidig med at du godt kan lide det tætte samarbejde med kollegaer og folketingsmedlemmer

-          Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet i en politisk organisation

Vi tilbyderEn arbejdsplads med engagerede og dedikerede kollegaer. En arbejdsplads, hvor der bliver lyttet til gode ideer, og hvor man som ansat har stor frihed i sit job inden for rammerne af de politiske prioriteringer.

De daglige arbejdsopgaver er i høj grad præget af en omskiftelig politisk hverdag, og derfor skal du være indstillet på at være fleksibel i situationer, hvor en ekstraindsats er nødvendig. Der vil også forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde.

Sekretariatet består af 24 medarbejdere, der yder faglig politisk og organisatorisk bistand til Enhedslistens 11 folketingsmedlemmer. De daglige arbejdsopgaver tilrettelægges i høj grad sammen med dine nærmeste folketingsmedlemmer.

 

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i en periode fra 1. februar-30. juni. Alle ansatte har samme løn- og arbejdsvilkår og vores enhedsløn er pt. 40.089 kr. pr. md. Derudover har Enhedslisten en pensionsordning, der følger CO-Industris overenskomst, hvilket pt. betyder 11%/4%. Dertil kommer en fritvalgsordning på 10%.

 

Det forudsættes, at du ved ansættelsen er eller bliver medlem af Enhedslisten.

 

Der vil forekomme både aften- og weekendarbejde. Til gengæld tilbydes der stor fleksibilitet og overarbejde afspadseres altid 1:1.

 

Der lægges i ansættelsespolitikken vægt på at fremme ligestilling i forhold til køn og etniske grupper, ligesom Enhedslisten giver fortrinsret til jobsamtale til ansøgere med funktionsnedsættelse. Det betyder, at hvis der blandt de bedst kvalificerede er personer med funktionsnedsættelse, skal vedkommende indkaldes til en samtale.

 

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte souschef Signer Mortensen (signe.mortensen@ft.dk, 61 62 47 33) eller rådgiver tillidsrepræsentant Julie Lindmann (julie.lindmann@ft.dk, 61 62 41 03)

 

 

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og senest d. 29. november kl. 23:59. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Ansøgningen skal sendes til jobenhedslisten@ft.dk med emnefelt ”Politisk rådgiver”. Vi holder samtaler i uge 50. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt, senest d. 1. februar.

-          Rådgive Enhedslistens folketingsmedlemmer

-          Tænke presseindsatser sammen med sociale medier og kampagnekommunikation

-          Hjælpe med at løfte en stribe af kommunikationsopgaver. Vi spænder bredt og arbejder foruden presse og SoMe med videoproduktion, tekstforfatning og debatindlæg.

-           

 

Om digVi stiller ikke firkantede krav til din uddannelsesbaggrund eller din præcise faglige baggrund. Det vigtigste er, at du er en dedikeret og faglig dygtig kollega, som går forrest i arbejdet med at sætte Enhedslistens rød-grønne politik på dagsordenen. Du kan komme med en baggrund indenfor kommunikation, journalistik eller noget helt andet. Vi forestiller os, at du:

-          Brænder for at få Enhedslistens politik og budskaber ud over rampen.

-          Finder det naturligt og har erfaring med at gribe telefonen og ringe til journalister

-          Skriver fængende tekster i forskellige formater. Fra det stærke hook i et SoMe-opslag til det lange debatindlæg.

-          Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet i en politisk organisation og har erfaring med politisk kommunikation.

Vi tilbyderEn arbejdsplads med engagerede og dedikerede kollegaer. En arbejdsplads, hvor der bliver lyttet til gode ideer, og hvor man som ansat har stor frihed i sit job inden for rammerne af de politiske prioriteringer.

Vi vil bestræbe os på at skabe en hverdag, hvor du får mulighed for at anvende dine kompetencer og erfaringer bredt inden for de forskellige discipliner.De daglige arbejdsopgaver er i høj grad præget af en omskiftelig politisk hverdag, og derfor skal du være indstillet på at være fleksibel i situationer, hvor en ekstraindsats er nødvendig. Der vil også forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde, og du vil indgå i en vagtturnus med vores pressetelefon i dag- og aftentimerne alle ugens dage. Du vil blive en del af et sekretariat med 24 medarbejdere, der yder faglig politisk og organisatorisk bistand til Enhedslistens 11 folketingsmedlemmer. De daglige arbejdsopgaver er i høj grad præget af det udadvendte presse- og kommunikationsarbejde. Du vil blive en del af vores presse- og kommunikationsteam, der består af 8 ansatte. I dagligdagen samarbejder vi tæt og løfter i flok.

 

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Alle ansatte har samme løn- og arbejdsvilkår og vores enhedsløn er pt. 40.089 kr. pr. md. Derudover har Enhedslisten en pensionsordning, der følger CO-Industris overenskomst, hvilket pt. betyder 11%/4%. Dertil kommer en fritvalgsordning på 10%.

 

Det forudsættes, at du ved ansættelsen er eller bliver medlem af Enhedslisten.

 

Der vil forekomme både aften- og weekendarbejde. Til gengæld tilbydes der stor fleksibilitet og overarbejde afspadseres altid 1:1.

 

Der lægges i ansættelsespolitikken vægt på at fremme ligestilling i forhold til køn og etniske grupper, ligesom Enhedslisten giver fortrinsret til jobsamtale til ansøgere med funktionsnedsættelse. Det betyder, at hvis der blandt de bedst kvalificerede er personer med funktionsnedsættelse, skal vedkommende indkaldes til en samtale.

 

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte presse- og kommunikationschef, Jakob Legarth Sandorff. på jakob.sandorff@ft.dk og telefonnummer 61 62 46 47 eller tillidsrepræsentant Julie Lindmann på julie.lindmann@ft.dk og telefonnummer 61 62 41 03.

 

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og senest d. 29. november kl. 23:59. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Ansøgningen skal sendes til jobenhedslisten@ft.dk med emnefelt ”Presserådgiver”. Vi holder samtaler i uge 50. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt, senest d. 1. februar. Der er interne ansøgere til stillingen.

title: Steel Fitters Wanted
description:
Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

·     English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

·         Safety Adherence: Strict compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) standards and proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Vores hjerte banker primært for hortensia, men vi forvandler også drivhusene til et farvehav af asters, julestjerner og diascia.

title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

Your Role

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
  • Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
  • Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
  • Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
  • Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.
Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
  • Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
  • Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
  • Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
  • Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.
Commercial and Customer Support
  • Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
  • Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
  • Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
  • Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.
Product Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
  • Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
  • Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
  • Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.
Your Profile

title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of cleanand sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that: describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and ScienceSalary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Steel Fitters Wanted
description:
Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

Your Role

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
  • Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
  • Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
  • Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
  • Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.
Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
  • Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
  • Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
  • Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
  • Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.
Commercial and Customer Support
  • Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
  • Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
  • Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
  • Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.
Product Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
  • Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
  • Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
  • Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.
Your Profile

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with product ownership, commercial awareness and an interest in working across the organization.

You bring:

  • A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering, process technology, production engineering or a comparable field.
  • Experience with product ownership, product development, mechanical engineering or technical project execution within industrial machinery or a related industry.
  • A good understanding of mechanical equipment, machine interfaces and the interaction between mechanics and automation.
  • Experience with hygienic equipment, food production or filling and dosing technology is an advantage.
  • The ability to understand customer applications and translate technical and commercial needs into product requirements and practical solutions.
  • A structured approach to product roadmaps, technical decisions, documentation and follow-up.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions influence customer value, project performance and lifecycle cost.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable engineering and ERP systems would be an advantage.

Above all, you are curious about how products perform in real customer environments. You enjoy developing technical knowledge, asking questions and bringing people together around solutions that work across the full value chain.

What We Offer
  • A central role with genuine influence on the future direction of Gram Equipment’s filling portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
  • The opportunity to combine technology, customer insight, commercial understanding and product development.
  • Close cooperation with experienced specialists across Engineering, Automation, Sales, Production, Projects and Service.
  • An international working environment with customers and colleagues across global markets.
  • Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
  • An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
  • Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.

The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.

Apply Now

Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. As an employee at REMA Distribution, you will become part of a company that aims to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices. You will play an important role in this process and become part of our yard shunter team in Vejle, working alongside skilled and competent colleagues.

About the job

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be part of a team working closely with our warehouse and logistics department.

Responsibilities

·       Your duties will include:

·       Operating a yard driver within the terminal area.

·       Connect and Disconnect trailers.

·       Preparing trailers for loading and unloading.

Today, we have more than 435 stores, operated according to a franchise model, with independent local franchisees responsible for each individual store.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the research and the position, please contact Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio (chisio@sdu.dk), research contact and supervisor. Additional enquiries may be directed to Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial one-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

Assessment and selection process

Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
