title: Business Development Senior Officer (d/f/m) (ECHO) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
description: IRC (International Rescue Committee) Germany is seeking aBusiness Development Senior Officer (d/f/m) (ECHO)- in Berlin / Bonn or Remote (within Germany) | ASAP |- full-time (40 hours/week) | Initially for 2 yearsAbout Us Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.The Crisis Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) Department runs the IRC’s humanitarian, recovery, and development programs in five regions: West & Central Africa, East Africa, Middle East and North Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Within CRRD, the Award Management Unit (AMU)’s Grants Operations & Analytics Team (GOAT) supports pre- and post-award work for projects managed by Technical Excellence, Global Supply Chain and Airbel.  Major ResponsibilitiesThe Business Development Senior Officer (ECHO), will be responsible for leading a portfolio of business development opportunities, ensuring that all proposals are compelling and submitted in accordance with IRC and Donor policies.Business Development Process (80%)ECHO oversight: Provide IRC Germany oversight to opportunities submitted under ECHO’s Strategic Policies and Strategic Humanitarian Supply Chain HIPs. This will include completing ECHO pre-award checklists and uploads to APPEL. Proposal leadership: Outside of the ECHO HIP season, will serve as Proposal Lead for funding opportunities assigned by the Head of Business Development.- Lead the overall proposal development process to ensure submissions are compliant, responsive, and compelling. - Support the technical team to position for anticipated calls, including pre-development of concept notes.- Project manage proposals ensuring internal approvals in line with external submission deadlines- Coordinate with country programs and partners to collect the documents and inputs needed for each proposal Proposal Budget development: Serve as Budget Lead for funding opportunities assigned by the Head of Business Development.- Develop proposal budgets to ensure consistency and accuracy across projects. Design, draft, refine, and finalize budgets and budget narratives (as needed) that are reflective of program design costs.- Ensure appropriate internal formats and donor formats for budget development are used.- Coordinate and liaise with country program finance and grants staff on proposals, providing guidance and feedback on workplans, deadlines, and proposal parameters.- Secure approvals across departments for submissions.Process Support and Feedback (10%)BD Process Improvements: Work on departmental and organisational initiatives to improve IRC’s BD processes.- Support refinement of business development processes for Technical Excellence.- Attend key cross-unit and cross-departmental meetings regarding business development to maintain an in-depth understanding of IRC funding streams and business development priorities.ECHO Awards Management and Compliance (10%)Awards Management: Act as IRC Germany’s post-award focal point for Technical Excellence and Global Supply Chain ECHO awards. - Provide ad-hoc compliance guidance to grants team on ECHO awards- Coordinate with grants team to ensure timely submissions of reports on APPEL.- Monitor ECHO portfolio through participation in project implementation meetings, ensuring progress against objectives and compliance with ECHO guidelines.- Manage donor relationship with ECHO across portfolio.Your ProfileEssential- Experience preparing or submitting proposals to ECHO- 5+ years of progressive work experience connected to business development and working in or closely with Technical teams - Highly collaborative and pro-active colleague with a talent for delivering results with cross-functional groups- Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with organizational information and financial systems- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a multi-cultural environment - University degree in Business Administration, Finance, International Development or a relevant field, or equivalent work experience- You have English language skills at C1 and German B1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF) (https://www.europaeischer-referenzrahmen.de/)  Desired- Experience working with IRC systems is a plus- Dedication to diversity, equity and inclusion, and a strong passion for our mission- Comfortable adapting to new challenges and dynamic priorities, while maintaining professional grace - Fluency in French, Spanish or Arabic language a plus We Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary between 60,028 and 67,090 Euro gross per year as well as an annual salary increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme, shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal (https://theirc.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Careers/job/Berlin-Germany/Business-Development-Senior-Officer--d-f-m---ECHO-_JR00005896) – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. For questions regarding the position, please contact Burrhus Njanjo (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org (https://mailto:HR.Deutschland@rescue.org) ).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. We particularly encourage people with personal or family experience of flight and migration to apply.With equal qualifications, we give preference to applications from people with severe disabilities. If you have any questions about accessible applications or inclusion, please feel free to contact our Inclusion Officer, Christine Mader (christine.mader@rescue.org (https://mailto:christine.mader@rescue.org) ).To ensure equal opportunities, we kindly ask you to refrain from including photos in your application documents.Please submit your application by 29th November 2026.All IRC workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct (https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct) . On this basis, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding (https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding) , Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.You can find more information about IRC Germany at IRCDeutschland.org (https://www.irc-deutschland.org/) .Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Als Spezialisten für den gewerblichen Bereich und deutschlandweit 46 Standorten ist Ihre Bewerbung als Elektromaschinenmonteur bei uns in den besten Händen.Aufgaben, Kompetenzen und Verantwortung- Als Elektromaschinenmonteur sind Sie für Stäbe und Formspulen für Generatoren (Ständerwicklung) zuständig- Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört u.a. die notwendigen Vorbereitungen für die Montagearbeiten- Sie führen Sichtprüfungen/Qualitätskontrollen durch- Des Weiteren betreuen Sie Prüf- und Montagevorrichtungen (z.B. Rollenböcke, Dreh-, Einfahrvorrichtungen, Arbeitsbühnen, Hebezeuge etc.) und achten darauf diese nach Vorgabe umzustellen, zu sichern und ggf. zu justieren- Sie arbeiten nach Vorgabe mit verschiedensten Baugruppen, dies beinhaltet einen vielschichtigen Montageinhalt (z.B. Arbeitspläne, Wickelvorschriften) entsprechend übernehmen Sie Aufgaben wie: Montieren, Justieren, Festsetzen, Verlöten- Sie überprüfen mithilfe der gängigen Prüfmittel Maßhaltigkeiten, Qualitätsparameter und Vollständigkeit der jeweiligen Montageinhalte- Die genaue Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse und evtl. AbweichungenFachliche Anforderungen- Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, idealerweise mit fachbezogener Berufserfahrung als Elektromaschinenmonteur oder vergleichbar- Technisches Verständnis und handwerkliches Geschick- Sie sind bereit im 3-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten- Zuverlässigkeit, Teamfähigkeit und Gute Umgangsformen sind für Sie selbstverständlich- Präzise und Gewissenhafte ArbeitsweiseArbeitgeberleistungen / Unternehmensangebot- Gehalt ab 21,18€/Std. bis 29,12€/Std.- Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld- Zahlreiche Mitarbeiter Rabatte- Kostenlose Beratung und Vermittlung- Passgenaue Stellenauswahl- Persönliche Betreuung und Profilerstellung- Vorbereitung auf Bewerbungsgespräche- Interessante Unternehmen kennenlernen in der RegionBei unserem Kundenunternehmen erwarten Sie außerdem:- Eine individuelle und intensive Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowohl für Ihre berufliche als auch persönliche Entwicklung- Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie ihre Persönlichkeit einbringen können und sich wohlfühlen können

title: Steuerfachangestellte/r mit Schwerpunkt IT & Digitalisierung (m/w/d) (Steuerfachangestellte/r)
description: DATEV | Unternehmen online | Digitale Kanzlei- und MandantenprozesseStandort: Büttelborn / beim Kunden / Remote nach AbspracheDu kommst aus der Steuerberatung, kennst DATEV und hast Spaß daran, wenn Prozesse digital, effizient und sauber funktionieren?Dann suchen wir genau dich.Die nexcon-it GmbH betreut Steuerkanzleien und deren Mandanten rund um ihre IT und Digitalisierung. Für den weiteren Ausbau dieses Bereichs suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die die Sprache der Steuerberatung spricht und gleichzeitig ein echtes Faible für digitale Prozesse hat.Dabei geht es nicht darum, den ganzen Tag klassische Finanzbuchhaltung zu bearbeiten. Du bist vielmehr die Schnittstelle zwischen Steuerberatung, Mandanten und IT und hilfst dabei, digitale Abläufe sinnvoll einzurichten, zu optimieren und in der Praxis zum Laufen zu bringen.Deine Aufgaben- Du bist Ansprechpartner für Steuerberater, Kanzleimitarbeiter und Mandanten bei Fragen rund um DATEV und digitale Arbeitsabläufe.- Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und zeigst auf, wie diese sinnvoll digitalisiert und vereinfacht werden können.- Du richtest DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO) bei Kanzleien und Mandanten ein und begleitest die Einführung.- Du unterstützt bei der Einrichtung und Optimierung von DATEV-Schnittstellen und digitalen Belegprozessen.- Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Mandanten und Kanzleien dafür, dass Belege und Daten strukturiert und DATEV-gerecht bereitgestellt werden können.- Du berätst beim Aufbau sinnvoller Prozesse, beispielsweise für Belegeingang, Freigaben, Rechnungen, Buchhaltungsvorbereitung und digitale Zusammenarbeit.- Du schulst Mandanten und Anwender und erklärst digitale Prozesse so, dass sie auch ohne IT-Studium verständlich sind.- Du arbeitest eng mit unseren IT-Technikern zusammen und übersetzt Anforderungen aus der Steuerberatung in konkrete technische und organisatorische Lösungen.- Du begleitest kleinere und größere Digitalisierungsprojekte bei unseren Kunden von der Idee bis zur praktischen Umsetzung.Das bringst du mit- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation aus dem steuerlichen bzw. kaufmännischen Umfeld.- Gute praktische Kenntnisse in Finanzbuchhaltung und typischen Kanzleiabläufen.- Erfahrung mit DATEV, idealerweise auch mit DATEV Unternehmen online.- Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Mandant und Steuerkanzlei in der Praxis funktioniert.- Eine hohe Affinität zu IT, Digitalisierung und modernen Arbeitsabläufen.- Du beschäftigst dich lieber damit, einen schlechten Prozess zu verbessern, als ihn einfach jeden Monat genauso weiterzumachen.- Du kannst technische Themen verständlich erklären und gehst geduldig auf unterschiedliche Anwender ein.- Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.- Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kunden.Eine Weiterbildung zum Fachassistenten Digitalisierung und IT-Prozesse (FAIT) ist natürlich ein Plus. Wenn du sie noch nicht hast, aber fachlich und menschlich zu uns passt, ist das für uns kein Ausschlusskriterium.Was wir dir bietenBei uns wechselst du nicht einfach von einer Steuerkanzlei in die nächste.Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, deine Erfahrung aus der Steuerberatung mit deinem Interesse an IT und Digitalisierung zu verbinden und aktiv an der digitalen Entwicklung unserer Kunden mitzuwirken.Dich erwarten:- abwechslungsreiche Projekte statt ausschließlich wiederkehrender Buchhaltungsroutine,- direkter Kontakt zu Steuerkanzleien und Unternehmen,- viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum,- enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen IT-Kollegen,- die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich insbesondere in DATEV, Digitalisierung und IT-Prozessen weiterzuentwickeln,- ein praxisnahes Umfeld in einem IT-Systemhaus, in dem Lösungen umgesetzt und nicht nur besprochen werden.Wen wir besonders suchenVielleicht sitzt du heute in einer Steuerkanzlei und merkst:„DATEV und Steuerberatung kann ich. Aber eigentlich macht mir die Digitalisierung, das Optimieren von Abläufen und das Lösen technischer Probleme viel mehr Spaß.“Dann solltest du mit uns sprechen.Wir suchen keinen Programmierer und auch keinen klassischen IT-Administrator.Wir suchen jemanden, der Steuerberatung versteht und Digitalisierung kann und damit die Brücke zwischen Steuerberater, Mandant, DATEV und IT bildet.Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Architekt/in)
description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. Our data pipelines extract and synthesize complex public, municipal, and real estate market indices into unified analytical models. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Backend & Data Extraction Engineer to design, deploy, and monitor scalable web crawlers, data scrapers, and data ingestion pipelines handling diverse, unstructured web sources. Key Responsibilities - Architect and maintain robust scraping and crawling pipelines targeting property portals, public registers, municipal gazettes, and economic data sources. - Implement parsing, data normalization, deduplication, and quality-validation routines for incoming raw data. - Manage proxy rotation, anti-bot mechanisms, rate limiting, and headless browser workflows. - Store and organize structured information using PostgreSQL, Redis, and document stores. - Package data services into Docker containers and interface them with internal analytics engines via REST/GraphQL APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology (e.g., FAST-NUCES, NED University, or equivalent). - Hands-on experience developing web scraping frameworks in Python: Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, or Puppeteer. - Practical knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching databases (Redis, MongoDB). - Experience with Linux environments, Docker, and Git. - Structured problem-solving mindset, persistence with complex web structures, and solid English skills. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Package: Excellent compensation package aligned with regional developer salaries. - Modern Workspace: Air-conditioned, reliable office in DHA Phase 1/2 with generator backup. - Local Leadership Path: Opportunities to scale into Engineering Lead / Data Operations Manager as the Karachi hub grows, supported by ongoing technical mentorship and European project workflows. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Top-performing engineers with consistent code quality and reliability over 3–6 months can transition to our research development institute in Germany under the § 18d researcher framework, complete with full visa sponsorship, relocation assistance, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-scraping@iris-institut.info

title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-geo@iris-institut.info

title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) (Computermathematiker/in)
description: Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-ai@iris-institut.info

title: Country Medical Head (m/f/d) (Arzt/Ärztin)
description: We are looking for a collaborative and pioneering Country Medical Head (m/f/d)  who is passionate about creating meaningful impact for patients to join our Medical Leadership & Strategy team in Monheim am Rhein, Germany.This role requires a minimum on-site presence of 40% in Monheim.About the roleAs Country Medical Head, you will be the accountable senior Medical leader for the German affiliate. You will set the strategic direction for Medical Affairs in Germany and lead the country Medical strategy across the portfolio, in alignment with country business priorities and regional and global Medical objectives.You will bring together scientific, patient, evidence and access perspectives to shape strategic country decisions, strengthen Medical excellence and create meaningful impact for patients.Through collaborative leadership, you will build strong connections across the German organisation and contribute the country perspective to regional and global Medical priorities.Who you'll work withYou will report to the Country General Manager, with functional alignment to Regional and Global Medical leadership.As a standing member of the Country Leadership Team, you will work closely with colleagues across Medical, Commercial, Market Access, Regulatory, Patient Value, Evidence Generation and other functions.You will lead and develop the German Medical organisation and work collaboratively with regional and global Medical teams.What you'll do- Set and lead the Medical strategy across the German portfolio, aligned with country, regional and global priorities.- Act as the senior scientific and Medical voice for the German affiliate, shaping key strategic and portfolio decisions.- Provide strategic Medical advice to the Country General Manager and Country Leadership Team.- Set portfolio priorities and guide Medical resource allocation to maximise scientific and patient impact.- Lead, develop and empower the German Medical organisation, fostering an inclusive and effective team culture.- Ensure Medical excellence, scientific integrity and effective governance, with clear accountability and decision-making across Medical activities.- Bring German healthcare, scientific, patient and access insights into regional and global Medical strategies.- Oversee evidence generation, scientific engagement and Medical education aligned with German healthcare needs.- Build trusted senior-level partnerships with scientific experts, healthcare decision-makers, patient communities and relevant external stakeholders.- Drive cross-functional alignment at leadership level to advance integrated strategies and meaningful patient impact.- Lead through complexity and change, translating evolving healthcare needs into clear Medical priorities and organisational capabilities.Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills- Advanced degree in Medicine, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related scientific discipline; a Medical Degree is strongly preferred.- Extensive senior-level experience across Medical Affairs, clinical development, evidence generation or related biopharmaceutical roles.- Demonstrated senior leadership experience within complex country, regional or global organisations.- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is required.- Demonstrated success in setting and leading Medical strategy across complex portfolios, therapeutic areas or significant business priorities.- Proven ability to work as a strategic partner to senior business leadership and contribute Medical and scientific perspectives to key decisions.- Demonstrated people leadership experience, including developing senior professionals, strengthening leadership capability and building inclusive and effective organisations.- Ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across country, regional and global organisations in a complex matrix environment.- Strong experience in external scientific leadership and senior stakeholder engagement across the healthcare ecosystem.- Deep understanding of Medical governance, scientific integrity, compliance and risk management, combined with sound judgement in complex situations.- Strong understanding of the German healthcare environment and its scientific, patient, access and policy landscape.- Strategic judgement and the ability to communicate, collaborate and influence effectively at senior leadership level.

title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Architekt/in)
description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

description: Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Package: Excellent compensation package aligned with regional developer salaries. - Modern Workspace: Air-conditioned, reliable office in DHA Phase 1/2 with generator backup. - Local Leadership Path: Opportunities to scale into Engineering Lead / Data Operations Manager as the Karachi hub grows, supported by ongoing technical mentorship and European project workflows. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Top-performing engineers with consistent code quality and reliability over 3–6 months can transition to our research development institute in Germany under the § 18d researcher framework, complete with full visa sponsorship, relocation assistance, and housing / accommodation support. description: Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) (Computermathematiker/in)
description: Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Architektur)
description: Job Title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Real Estate Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-REND-02 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-REND-02 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is a German research institution operating at the intersection of architectural digitization, environmental resilience, and sustainable development. We combine engineering precision with visual storytelling to present sustainable development concepts, municipal renewal proposals, and investment pitches to decision-makers. Role Overview We are looking for a creative and technically skilled 3D Architectural Visualizer to translate 3D building models and mass studies into photorealistic imagery, architectural perspectives, and presentation-ready visual assets. Key Responsibilities - Produce photorealistic architectural exterior and interior renderings from BIM/CAD geometry (Revit, SketchUp, Rhino). - Set up realistic lighting, material texturing, vegetation, and context environments for urban and commercial real estate assets. - Create mass studies, conceptual 3D volumes, and interactive walkthroughs for project feasibility presentations. - Perform post-production image enhancements and color grading in Adobe Photoshop. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers and research leads to accurately reflect structural design intent. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Visualization, 3D Design, Animation, or related field (e.g., Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture, DUET, or comparable). - Proficiency in industry-standard visualization software: 3ds Max, Blender, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or Corona / V-Ray. - Strong aesthetic sense for architectural composition, atmospheric lighting, and material detailing. - A portfolio showing realistic architectural renderings is required for consideration. - Professional working proficiency in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package matching market rates. - Infrastructure: High-performance rendering hardware and reliable, air-conditioned studio space in DHA. - In-Country Career Growth: Rapid progression to Senior Visualizer or Art Director within our growing studio, with continuous training in real-time engines and computational visualization tools. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Exceptional performers proving dedication and high visual standard over 3–6 months can qualify for an international transfer to our research facilities in Germany (§ 18d AufenthG), fully supported with visa facilitation, relocation, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

  • Rezanje, bušenje, brušenje i druga mehanička obrada metalnih dijelova.
  • Korištenje ručnog, električnog i pneumatskog alata.
  • Priprema dijelova za zavarivanje te suradnja sa zavarivačima.
  • Kontrola dimenzija i kvalitete izrađenih dijelova.
  • Održavanje urednosti radnog mjesta i pridržavanje pravila zaštite na radu.

  • Završena srednja škola bravarskog, strojarskog ili srodnog usmjerenja.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo na bravarskim poslovima.
  • Sposobnost čitanja tehničkih nacrta i razumijevanja tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Odgovornost, preciznost i samostalnost u radu.
  • Spremnost na rad u Njemačkoj.

Poznavanje jezika:

  • Poželjno znanje njemačkog jezika na razini B2.
  • Prihvaća se i tečno znanje engleskog jezika koje omogućuje nesmetanu svakodnevnu komunikaciju na radnom mjestu.

Nudimo:

  • Stabilno zaposlenje i dugoročnu suradnju.
  • Rad u uređenoj radionici u Njemačkoj.
  • Organiziran smještaj.
  • Redovita i stimulativna primanja.
  • Ugodno i profesionalno radno okruženje.
Poslodavac osigurava i financira putovanje do mjesta rada i odgovarajući smještaj.

title: Interior Finishing Worker
description:

title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Architekt/in)
description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. Our data pipelines extract and synthesize complex public, municipal, and real estate market indices into unified analytical models. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Backend & Data Extraction Engineer to design, deploy, and monitor scalable web crawlers, data scrapers, and data ingestion pipelines handling diverse, unstructured web sources. Key Responsibilities - Architect and maintain robust scraping and crawling pipelines targeting property portals, public registers, municipal gazettes, and economic data sources. - Implement parsing, data normalization, deduplication, and quality-validation routines for incoming raw data. - Manage proxy rotation, anti-bot mechanisms, rate limiting, and headless browser workflows. - Store and organize structured information using PostgreSQL, Redis, and document stores. - Package data services into Docker containers and interface them with internal analytics engines via REST/GraphQL APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology (e.g., FAST-NUCES, NED University, or equivalent). - Hands-on experience developing web scraping frameworks in Python: Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, or Puppeteer. - Practical knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching databases (Redis, MongoDB). - Experience with Linux environments, Docker, and Git. - Structured problem-solving mindset, persistence with complex web structures, and solid English skills. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Package: Excellent compensation package aligned with regional developer salaries. - Modern Workspace: Air-conditioned, reliable office in DHA Phase 1/2 with generator backup. - Local Leadership Path: Opportunities to scale into Engineering Lead / Data Operations Manager as the Karachi hub grows, supported by ongoing technical mentorship and European project workflows. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Top-performing engineers with consistent code quality and reliability over 3–6 months can transition to our research development institute in Germany under the § 18d researcher framework, complete with full visa sponsorship, relocation assistance, and housing / accommodation support. title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-geo@iris-institut.info

title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) (Computermathematiker/in)
description: Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-ai@iris-institut.info

Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Architektur)
description: Job Title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Real Estate Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-REND-02 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-REND-02 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is a German research institution operating at the intersection of architectural digitization, environmental resilience, and sustainable development. We combine engineering precision with visual storytelling to present sustainable development concepts, municipal renewal proposals, and investment pitches to decision-makers. Role Overview We are looking for a creative and technically skilled 3D Architectural Visualizer to translate 3D building models and mass studies into photorealistic imagery, architectural perspectives, and presentation-ready visual assets. Key Responsibilities - Produce photorealistic architectural exterior and interior renderings from BIM/CAD geometry (Revit, SketchUp, Rhino). - Set up realistic lighting, material texturing, vegetation, and context environments for urban and commercial real estate assets. - Create mass studies, conceptual 3D volumes, and interactive walkthroughs for project feasibility presentations. - Perform post-production image enhancements and color grading in Adobe Photoshop. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers and research leads to accurately reflect structural design intent. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Visualization, 3D Design, Animation, or related field (e.g., Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture, DUET, or comparable). - Proficiency in industry-standard visualization software: 3ds Max, Blender, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or Corona / V-Ray. - Strong aesthetic sense for architectural composition, atmospheric lighting, and material detailing. - A portfolio showing realistic architectural renderings is required for consideration. - Professional working proficiency in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package matching market rates. - Infrastructure: High-performance rendering hardware and reliable, air-conditioned studio space in DHA. - In-Country Career Growth: Rapid progression to Senior Visualizer or Art Director within our growing studio, with continuous training in real-time engines and computational visualization tools. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Exceptional performers proving dedication and high visual standard over 3–6 months can qualify for an international transfer to our research facilities in Germany (§ 18d AufenthG), fully supported with visa facilitation, relocation, and housing / accommodation support. title: Executive Souschef (m/w/d) (Koch/Köchin)
description: Deine Freunde wissen: Du bist ein Feinschmecker. Doch du bist noch viel mehr. Die gehobene Küche ist das, was dich Tag für Tag inspiriert und begeistert. Deine Liebe zum Detail lässt jedes Essen zum Erlebnis werden – immer und immer wieder. Zusammen mit einem Team passionierter Kochkünstler kreierst Du täglich etwas Neues. gelegen in der Elbphilharmonie, dem zurzeit gefragtesten Wahrzeichen Hamburgs inklusive atemberaubenden Blick auf den Hamburger Hafen.- Teamwork makes the dream work! Dich erwartet ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten.- Unser Management Team motiviert, beflügelt und informiert dich in unseren regelmäßigen Townhall Meetings.- Deine Karriere liegt uns am Herzen. Unsere regelmäßigen Beurteilungs- und Feedbackgespräche, sowie die individualisierten Entwicklungspläne helfen dir deine Karriereziele zu verwirklichen.- Fördern und fordern ist die Devise. Wir bieten dir zahlreiche Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten u.a. über unsere interne Lernplattform (Digital Learning Zone).- Wir haben immer ein offenes Ohr! Die Open-Door-Policy ist für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit und wird tagtäglich von uns gelebt!- Kostenfreie Fitnesskurse in unserem Spabereich helfen dir deinen sportlichen Ausgleich zu schaffen. Zudem kannst du unsere Fitnessräume jederzeit kostenfrei nutzen!- Für dein leibliches Wohl ist gesorgt. Unsere hauseigene Kantine ‚Bootshaus‘ mit großzügigem Balkon und traumhaften Blick über die Elbe versorgt dich täglich mit kostenfreien, köstlichen und ausgewogenen Mahlzeiten.- Gut gekleidet durch den Tag. Du erhältst eine kostenfreie Uniform inklusive deren Reinigung.- Mit einer „Inhouse Experience“ erlebst du unser Hotel aus der Gastperspektive und genießt mit deiner Begleitperson eine Übernachtung mit einem Besuch in unserer BLICK Bar (oder Room Service) mit anschließendem Frühstück.- Du schlemmst auch privat gern? Du erhältst 40% Discount auf alle F&B-Leistungen im The Westin Hamburg, Renaissance Hamburg & Marriott Hamburg, sowie 20% bei allen anderen Marriott Hotels weltweit.- Confetti is always a good idea! Wir feiern gern und das gemeinsam mit dem gesamten Team bei unseren jährlichen Mitarbeiterpartys! Außerdem unterstützen wir die jährlichen Team Outings mit insgesamt 50,00 € netto pro Mitarbeiter.- Wir zelebrieren unsere ‚Hosts of the Month‘, sowie ‚Azubi/Dual Student & Leader of the Quarter‘ in unseren Townhall Meetings und dazu gibt‘s 100,00 € netto für jeden glücklichen Gewinner! - Es sind die kleinen Dinge im Leben… Geburtstagsgeschenke, sowie Präsente zur Geburt von Kindern, Hochzeiten und Jubiläen versüßen die besonderen Anlässe im Leben.- Reisen ist deine Leidenschaft? Wir ermöglichen dir vergünstigte Mitarbeiter-, sowie Family & Friends-Raten für Übernachtungen in mehr als 10.000 Marriott International Hotels weltweit.- Du shoppst gern online? Dann stöbere auf der Plattform ‚Corporate Benefits‘, um prozentuale Vergünstigungen auf zahlreiche Top-Marken zu erhalten.- Unser aller Wohl liegt uns am Herzen. Unser weltweites „Marriott Take Care“ Programm ermöglicht regelmäßige Workshops, Events, Trainings und Meetings zum Thema ‚Wellbeing‘ im Team und in unserer Community.- Deine Gesundheit ist uns wichtig – deshalb gibt es jährlich im Rahmen einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung ein Gesundheitsbudget in Höhe von 300 € für dich zur freien Verfügung für Gesundheitsleistungen wie bspw. Medikamente, Brillen, Kontaktlinsen, Zahnreinigung, etc.

Design, draft, refine, and finalize budgets and budget narratives (as needed) that are reflective of program design costs.- Ensure appropriate internal formats and donor formats for budget development are used.- Coordinate and liaise with country program finance and grants staff on proposals, providing guidance and feedback on workplans, deadlines, and proposal parameters.- Secure approvals across departments for submissions.Process Support and Feedback (10%)BD Process Improvements: Work on departmental and organisational initiatives to improve IRC’s BD processes.- Support refinement of business development processes for Technical Excellence.- Attend key cross-unit and cross-departmental meetings regarding business development to maintain an in-depth understanding of IRC funding streams and business development priorities.ECHO Awards Management and Compliance (10%)Awards Management: Act as IRC Germany’s post-award focal point for Technical Excellence and Global Supply Chain ECHO awards. - title: Instandhalter (m/w/d) (Instandhaltungstechniker/in)
description: ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe mobility.Alongside the automotive sector - passenger cars and commercial vehicles - ZF also serves market segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives and test systems.With some 168,700 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €46.6 billion in fiscal year 2023. The company operates 162 production locations in 31 countries.Wir suchen einen Instandhalter (m/w/d) im Aftermarket für unseren Standort in #Schweinfurt.Unser Bereich Operations Engineering vereint die Kompetenzen aus unter anderem Elektronik und Mechatronik und besteht aus einem engagierten Team von 23 Mitarbeitenden. Wir arbeiten an Themen wie Verpackungs‑ und Fördertechnik sowie ersten Robotikanwendungen und setzen dabei auf enge Zusammenarbeit über alle Schichten hinweg. Alle Teammitglieder (m/w/d) übernehmen Verantwortung in der Schichtbetreuung und unterstützen sich gegenseitig - geprägt von einem harmonischen, hilfsbereiten Miteinander.Was Sie erwarten können als #Instandhalter (m/w/d):- Wartung, Reparatur und Durchführung von Fehlersuche und Störungsbeseitigung an Förderanlagen, Regalbediengeräten und Verpackungsmaschinen- Reparieren, Austauschen und Einstellen komplexer elektronischer und mechanischer Einheiten (z. B. Scanner, Umrichter, Etikettierer, Getriebe, PC‑Peripherie, Pneumatikkomponenten, Heißleimtechnik, Flurförderzeuge) unter Beachtung relevanter Betriebsanleitungen und Sicherheitsvorgaben- Analysieren von wiederkehrenden Störungen, sowie Planung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Optimierungsmaßnahmen an Anlagen und Maschinen- Erstellen und Pflegen von Plänen, Dokumentationen und Anleitungen unter Beachtung von Normen und technischen/betrieblichen Regelungen- Bestandspflege und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen, Hilfsstoffen, Werkzeugen und Ausrüstung mittels EDV und Kommunikationsmedien unter Einhaltung vorgegebener Budgets- Mithilfe bis hin zu eigenverantwortlicher Leitung bei Umbauten und größeren Reparaturen im AufgabengebietWas wir von Ihnen erwarten als Instandhalter (m/w/d):- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung - bevorzugt #Elektronik / #Mechatronik, alternativ #Mechanik- Erfahrung im Bereich der Fehlersuche und Reparatur von Maschinen und Anlagen von Vorteil, ebenso Kenntnisse in #S7 Steuerung- Erfahrung mit Förderanlagen, Regalbediengeräten sowie Verpackungsmaschinen wünschenswert- Höhentauglichkeit ist Voraussetzung- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im #3-Schicht-Betrieb und Wochenendarbeit erforderlich- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse erforderlichWarum Sie sich für ZF in Schweinfurt entscheiden sollten:- Tarifvertrag- 30 Tage Urlaub- JobRad- Corporate Benefits- ZF@LearningEinstufung:Je nach ERA-TV für die Arbeitnehmer der Bayerischen Metall- und Elektroindustrie und je nach Erfüllung der oben aufgeführten Aufgaben und Anforderungen.
