title: Global Demand Planner Nouryon
description: We are looking for a Demand Planner who combines strong analytical skills with a collaborative and business-oriented mindset. You will turn data, market insights and commercial input into reliable demand plans that help us improve availability, forecasting and supply chain performance. Does that sound like you? About the jobAs Demand Planner you will play a key role in our business planning process, creating and continuously improving a robust 24-month demand plan for your area.You will work at the intersection of Sales, Customer Service and Supply Chain, combining statistical forecasting with commercial and market insights to balance customer demand, product availability and operational efficiency.Please note: We apply continuous selection, so the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. In your future role as Global Demand Planner you will    Develop, analyze and maintain a rolling 24-month demand forecast, combining statistical forecasting, historical demand, commercial input and market insights.    Partner closely with Sales Managers, Customer Service and Supply Chain teams to align assumptions, manage exceptions and ensure anticipated market developments and commercial strategies are reflected in the demand plan.    Monitor forecast performance and demand management KPIs, identify forecast errors and trends, and translate your analysis into corrective actions and continuous improvements.    Perform forecast segmentation and maintain appropriate statistical forecasting models in Arkieva, ensuring products and new product/plant combinations are assigned relevant forecasting approaches.    Support and facilitate Global Demand Reviews and contribute to Supply Management and Demand Supply Reviews, including inventory strategies, new product introductions and product phase-outs.    Drive improvements in planning processes, tools and ways of working and contribute to Supply Chain and demand management projects. We believe you bring    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business or a related discipline OR equivalent relevant experience.    Solid understanding of supply chain and business planning processes, combined with strong analytical capabilities.    Demonstrated ability to work with large and complex datasets, including data validation, trend analysis and forecasting.    Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and confidence working with digital planning and data environments.    Very good communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.    A structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to prioritize, take initiative and move work forward with limited direction. Great if you have    Experience with SAP or another ERP system, Business Warehouse or another data warehouse, and Arkieva or comparable advanced planning software.    Experience with statistical forecasting, demand planning or Integrated Business Planning processes.    APICS CPIM or CSCP certification. We believe you areYou enjoy combining analytical thinking with collaboration and know how to turn complex information into clear conclusions and actions. You build productive relationships across functions and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.You take ownership of your work, set priorities and proactively move topics forward. At the same time, you are curious about how processes can be improved and comfortable challenging existing ways of working when data points to a better solution. You will have broad interaction across Sales, Customer Service and Supply Chain and the opportunity to influence both day-to-day planning performance and longer-term improvements in our processes and tools.At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process. We work actively and systematically with HSE matters to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff. We look forward to receiving your application! About NouryonExplore careers and life at NouryonIf you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. title: Data Platform Administrator

title: Product Owner - AI & Test Engineering
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software. Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you. A stream in the making AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas:     AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc.     AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing. You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers. You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.Profile description:Your profile     You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.     You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work.     You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.     You enjoy working with a broad range of stakeholders and helping new ways of working spread across an organization.     It’s a plus if you have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development, AI in testing, test automation, CI/CD or simulation.     You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. As a person, you’re curious, structured, communicative and collaborative. You’re comfortable when not everything is decided yet, and you enjoy helping to create structure together with others. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and like to keep learning. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

The role is offering a unique opportunity to contribute to the global energy transition while working in a highly collaborative and international environment. This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden."Are you ready to become part of a group of technical leaders with a passion for supporting our engineering teams and driving them forward? to a greener future."– Kamilla Sommarsjö, Global Head HVDC Lead Engineers - PlantsHow You'll Make an Impact    Provide strong technical leadership across Plants and Civil engineering teams and their interfaces.    Primary contact for technical communication with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.    Drive completion of engineering activities in tenders and projects, working closely Design    Station Auxiliary Power Systems    Civil Engineering    Auxiliary Systems (eg Fire Protection, HVAC, Security Systems)    Ensure effective coordination and management of interfaces between engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.    Represent the Plants discipline in customer meetings, partner discussions, and technical reviews.Your Background    Academic degree in Engineering (for example within Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related area)    At least 5 years of engineering experience, including experience of leading technical teams, multidisciplinary engineering activities or complex projects is required.    Experience within HVDC, transmission systems, substations, electrical power systems, offshore wind, or decisions when required.    Excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical solutions in a clear and structured manner.    Fluency in English, both verbally and written, is required. title: Lead Architect inom Identity & Access Management (IAM)
description: För kunds räkning söker vi nu en Lead Architect inom Identity & Access Management (IAM). Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.Om tjänsten:I rollen som Lead Architect / IAM Arkitekt arbetar du både taktiskt och strategiskt med att hålla ihop, driva och utveckla tjänster inom IAM-området tillsammans med flertalet duktiga kollegor.Du ansvarar för att leda och koordinera teamet genom mentorskap, samarbete och utveckling. IT-lösningar ska realiseras på ett korrekt sätt i enlighet med regulatoriska krav, verksamhetens behov samt i relation till andra IT-lösningar. Du prioriterar backloggen och stöttar gruppen genom ett tydligt ledarskap.I rollen säkerställer du att företagsövergripande arkitekturprinciper och riktlinjer kring standarder följs i den tekniska arkitekturen. Du gör medvetna arkitekturval för att skapa maximalt värde för verksamheten. Teamets fokus ligger på identitetssäkerhet och cybersäkerhet, regelefterlevnad, behörighetskontroll och livscykelhantering – områden där du har ett övergripande ansvar.Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:    Stötta och leda teamet    Leda dig själv och hjälpa andra att navigera i en snabbrörlig och stundtals oförutsägbar omvärld (VUCA)    Agera sakkunnig och stötta Head of Service Area, Service Managers och Service Owners    Ta fram beslutsunderlag för både affärsmässiga beslut och tekniska vägval    Säkerställa att krav, regler, lagar, processer, standarder och policyer efterlevs    Designa lösningsförslag ur olika perspektiv    Dokumentera lösningar och arkitektur    Presentera och kommunicera lösningar för olika målgrupper och i olika forum    Använda agila metoder för att koordinera och leda arbetetDin profil:För att trivas i rollen och möta förväntningarna ser vi att du har flera års erfarenhet som arkitekt inom IAM-området. Erfarenhet från globala och mer komplexa organisationer är meriterande.Som person är du positiv, lösningsorienterad och trivs i en dynamisk miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik. Du kommunicerar effektivt med målgrupper på olika tekniska nivåer och har starka presentationstekniker. Du har en stöttande personlighet där mentorskap, samarbete och utveckling är centrala drivkrafter.Kvalifikationer:För att vara relevant för rollen har du erfarenhet och djup kompetens inom ett eller flera av följande områden:    Privileged Access Security    Access Management och PAM    Identity Governance och Life-cycle Management    Policy enforcement och policy decision (PBAC, RBAC, ABAC)    Identity Federation och SSO (modern, traditionell, hybrid och public cloud)    Zero Trust / Zero Trust Network Access    API Security    Regulatoriska krav såsom NIST och Export Control    Foundation Data    PKI    MFA    Erfarenhet av Enterprise Architecture (Business, IT och Solution Architecture)    Förmåga att förmedla Enterprise Architecture-visionen till IAM-domänarkitektur    Visualisering och kommunikation av arkitekturer och transitionsarkitekturer    Stakeholder-hantering ur ett arkitekturperspektiv    Erfarenhet av att implementera och dokumentera domänarkitektur i stora organisationer.För kunds räkning söker vi nu en IT Solution Architect till avdelningen Special Purpose Environments. Är du en engagerad och lösningsorienterad person som vill vara med och designa och realisera IT-lösningar som skapar värde och efterlever regulatoriska krav? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!Ytterligare information:Location: MalmöI rollen kan resor inom Sverige förekomma.Detta är en projektanställning hos NXT Interim Malmö AB. Vi tillämpar kollektivavtal. Detta är en konsultroll med placering i en försvarshemlig miljö, vilket ställer höga krav på säkerhet och integritet. Säkerhetsprövning är ett krav för denna tjänst, och du måste vara svensk medborgare för att kvalificera dig.Kunden erbjuder:För kunds räkning erbjuder vi en dynamisk och innovativ arbetsmiljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas och bidra med din expertis. Här får du arbeta med spännande projekt och lösningar som gör skillnad för verksamheten.Låter detta som ett intressant uppdrag?Sök redan idag! Vi behöver din ansökan, inkluderat CV, på svenska. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan då anbudstiden är kort.NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag inom konsult- och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi arbetar inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter förmåner som sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller vardagen.

title: Vikarier till äldreboende i Nacka | Jul- och nyårsvikariat
description: Vill du bidra till en trygg, värdig och meningsfull vardag för våra boende under jul- och nyårsperioden?Vi söker dig som studerar inom vård och omsorg, har erfarenhet av  arbete inom vård och omsorg eller vill ta dina första steg inom äldreomsorgen. Vi söker dig som är intresserad av ett långsiktigt vikariat under jul, nyår och som gärna fortsätter hos oss även under sommaren. Du är flexibel, tar initiativ och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.Tidigare erfarenhet av vård och omsorg är meriterande, men det viktigaste är ditt engagemang, din vilja att lära och ditt intresse för människor.Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.Vi erbjuderNacka seniorcenter är det kommunala alternativet för äldreomsorg i Nacka kommun med verksamheter i Ektorp, Finntorp, Saltsjöbaden och Saltsjö-Boo.Som vikarie anställs du av Stab kompetensförsörjning som ansvarar för bemanningen vid kort- och långtidsfrånvaro. Du kan arbeta på en eller flera verksamheter beroende på behov och tillgänglighet.För att skapa kontinuitet i verksamheten ser vi gärna att du kan arbeta cirka 10 pass per månad. Vi söker dig som vill bygga en långsiktig relation med oss och som är intresserad av att fortsätta arbeta under sommaren.Utdrag från Polisens belastningsregisterI Nacka kommun krävs utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister för arbete inom äldreomsorgen i samband med anställning. Vi ber dig välja digitalt registerutdrag för snabbare hantering.Begär gärna utdraget i samband med att du skickar in din ansökan eftersom handläggningstiderna kan variera.Intresserad?Vill du bli en del av Nacka kommun? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!Tjänsterna avser vikariat under jul- och nyårsperioden utifrån verksamheternas behov, med möjlighet till förlängning. För att säkerställa en god introduktion inleds anställningen som timanställning. Vikariat erbjuds när introduktionen är genomförd och godkänd av både medarbetaren och verksamheten.Vi rekryterar utan personligt brev och ber dig i stället besvara urvalsfrågorna i samband med din ansökan. Bedömningen görs utifrån ditt CV och dina svar. Urval sker löpande och rekryteringsprocessen inkluderar gruppintervju och referenstagning.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Mechanical Design Manager for External Design

You will lead an experienced team, support individual growth, and create conditions for engineers to perform their best while delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.As part of the Power Transformers Engineering Management Team, you will contribute to the continued development of our engineering organization and help shape how we work, grow, and succeed together.Ludvika has been at the center of power transmission innovation for more than a century. Here, you will combine local teamwork and long-term relationships with the opportunity to contribute to projects that support energy transition on a global scale.How you’ll make an impact    Lead, coach, and develop a team of 15–20 mechanical engineers.    Foster a culture built on collaboration, ownership, safety, and continuous learning.    Support competence development and long-term succession planning within the team.    Work closely with project management, production, quality, and other engineering functions to ensure successful project execution.    Drive continuous improvements in ways of working, quality, and operational performance.    Balance customer requirements, business priorities, and sound engineering judgement.    Contribute to the strategic development of the Mechanical Design organization.    Create an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and challenged to growYour background    You hold a degree in Engineering or have gained equivalent knowledge through substantial experience in a technical field.    You have experience from engineering, product development, manufacturing, project execution, or another industrial environment.    Previous leadership experience is beneficial but not required. We are equally interested in experienced leaders and strong technical professionals ready to take the next step.    Experience from transformers, power systems, heavy industry, manufacturing, mechanical design, or related technical fields is an advantage.    You enjoy working with people and understanding how to build engagement, trust, and high-performing teams.    You are comfortable balancing day-to-day operational needs with longer-term strategic objectives.    You communicate effectively with engineers, specialists, project managers, production teams, customers, and senior stakeholders.    You are fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.More About Us​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com​Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Håkan Blomquist, hkan.blomquist@hitachienergy.com ; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, frank.hollstedt@hitachienergy.com ; Unionen: Olle Ruzicka, olle.ruzicka@hitachienergy.com

title: Scientist
description: Are you passionate about protein analytics and scientific problem-solving? Would you like to contribute to the development of innovative injectable products in a global, science-driven organization? We are looking for a Scientist to join our Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry team within Injectables Development in Uppsala.In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of analytical methods that support the advancement of new products and technologies. Working in a collaborative and highly skilled environment, you will help generate the scientific insights that drive innovation and ensure product quality throughout development.This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organization where your expertise will contribute directly to the future of injectable aesthetics.Make your mark. Grow with us.  Your team Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry is part of Galderma's Injectables Development organization in Uppsala. The team provides analytical expertise that supports the development of innovative products and technologies, helping to strengthen and expand Galderma's portfolio.You will join a collaborative and highly engaged team where knowledge sharing, scientific curiosity, and mutual support are valued. Together, we work in a dynamic environment where quality, innovation, and patient focus guide everything we do. Your missionAs a Scientist within Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry, you will plan, perform, and interpret analytical studies supporting product and process development. You will contribute to solving complex analytical challenges related to proteins and biologics while ensuring that all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements.Working closely with colleagues across Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions, you will play an important role in advancing development projects from early-stage investigations through method validation and implementation.This role offers a broad range of scientific and technical challenges, providing opportunities to deepen your expertise while contributing to projects with real impact on Galderma's future portfolio. Key responsibilities· Develop, optimize, and validate analytical methods for proteins and related biological materials.· Plan, execute, analyze, and document experimental work.· Interpret analytical data and provide scientifically sound conclusions and recommendations.· Author protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.· Provide analytical expertise and support within cross-functional development projects.· Ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with GMP, internal procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements.· Support project teams by identifying scientific solutions to analytical challenges.· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory and analytical development processes. Your profile You are a curious and collaborative scientist who enjoys combining scientific expertise with practical problem-solving. You are motivated by understanding complex biological systems and translating analytical results into meaningful insights that support product development.You thrive in an environment where teamwork, scientific discussion, and continuous learning are valued. At the same time, you take ownership of your work, approach challenges with a structured mindset, and maintain a strong focus on quality and scientific integrity.You are comfortable working in project-based environments, communicating complex information clearly, and collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds. title: Sjuksköterska till avdelning 96 LAH
description: Som sjuksköterska hos oss får du ett varierat arbete inom både öppen-, sluten och hemsjukvård, tillsammans med kollegor med bred kompetens. Här finns möjlighet att utvecklas, lära av andra och bidra med din egen erfarenhet, oavsett om du är nyutexaminerad eller erfaren.Vårt erbjudandeFör livet framåt. Region Östergötland har höga ambitioner och ett ansvarsfullt uppdrag. Det handlar om hälsa och vård, om vår regions utveckling och om dem som lever och vistas här. Vi vill fortsätta att vara i framkant, med vård, forskning och utbildning. Det innebär att våga tänka nytt – och att ha de bästa medarbetarna. Därför erbjuder vi unika möjligheter till vidare lärande och satsar på moderna miljöer med effektiva system och verktyg. Många av oss möter patienter och närstående, andra skapar förutsättningarna för livsviktiga insatser. Hos oss jobbar fantastiska människor mot samma mål – att göra skillnad på riktigt, och för livet framåt.I sektion LAH på Närvårdskliniken får du möjlighet att arbeta i unika miljöer och i multiprofessionella välfungerande team. Våra team består av läkare, sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, arbetsterapeut, fysioterapeut och kurator.Du kommer träffa våra patienter på vår avdelning men en stor del av vår verksamhet sker också utanför sjukhuset i patienternas hem. Ibland besöker vi patienterna för en gemensam bedömning i olika teamkonstellationer, ibland träffar du patienten själv och diskuterar med ditt team innan och/eller efter besöket. Läs gärna vår karriärstege för sjuksköterskor och om dina förmåner hos oss, här hittar du även information om bestämmelser gällande lön och ersättningar.ArbetsbeskrivningVi söker sjuksköterska för ett omväxlande arbete inom klinikens olika enheter. Du kan vara erfaren eller nyutexaminerad, personliga egenskaper är avgörande. Hos oss får du arbeta självständigt i team tillsammans med andra sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, läkare, arbetsterapeut, fysioterapeut och kurator. Här finns en samlad kompetens och medarbetare som delar med sig till varandra av sina kliniska och teoretiska kunskaper. Vi bedriver en dygnet runt-verksamhet och alla hjälps åt att leverera den vård våra medborgare är i behov av. Vårt arbete underlättas av bärbart arbetssätt där patientjournal alltid finns tillgänglig.Vi baserar vårt arbete efter principen om helhetsvård, som bygger på ömsesidig respekt och förståelse för patientens självkänsla och vilja. Alla symtom behöver lindras oavsett om de är fysiska, psykiska, andliga eller emotionella. Det handlar om insatser för att öka livskvalitet och välbefinnande. Fokus ligger på att skapa en professionell relation med patienten och dennes närstående.Klinikens medarbetare är en arbetsgrupp i olika åldrar, med olika bakgrund och med olika yrkeserfarenheter och kompetenser. I arbetslaget finns kollegor med spetskompetens inom palliativ vård, onkologi, akutsjukvård, öppen hälso-och sjukvård, geriatrik och gynekologi. Så välkommen med din kompetens!ArbetsgruppDu blir stationerad i ett av våra två vårdlag eller avdelning 96 och har din fasta punkt där men i den dagliga verksamheten hjälps vi åt och fördelar våra personella resurser där de bäst behövs utifrån kunskap och kompetens. Vi strävar efter att öka kompetensen hos våra medarbetare och du kommer att få rotera mellan öppen- och slutenvård och över dygnets alla timmar.Om digVi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska och har B-körkort. Du har gärna specialistutbildning i Palliativ vård, avancerad hemsjukvård eller Öppen hälso- och sjukvård. Då du arbetar i ständig dialog med patienter och kollegor är det ett krav att du har goda kunskaper i det svenska språket, både i tal och i skrift.Som person är du kulturellt medveten, empatisk och har lätt för att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter - till den här tjänsten söker vi dig som är flexibel. Flexibel hos oss handlar om att kunna anpassa sig efter rådande situation och ändra fokus vilket är avgörande då oförutsägbara händelser uppstår dagligen. Du är lojal och uttrycker en positiv attityd till ditt arbete. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och är nyfiken på nya utmaningar. Du trivs med att arbeta i team där alla yrkeskategorier lär av varandra. Vi arbetar nära varandra och behöver ha en god kommunikation för att lyckas lösa de uppgifter vi möter i vardagen. Därmed passar tjänsten dig som trivs med samarbete och är lyhörd samt kommunikativ till både kollegor, patienter och anhöriga. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig mognad.”Jag sökte mig till hemsjukvård och specialiserad palliativ vård i hemmet då jag vill bidra till att patienterna får ett värdigt bemötande under deras sista tid”. - Therese, specialistsjuksköterskaAnsökan och anställningVi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Inför anställning i ett patientnära arbete inom Region Östergötland kommer du att få fylla i en hälsodeklaration.Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Om du behöver hjälp med att registrera i systemet, kontakta kundtjänst Stöd och service, 010-103 60 00, under kontorstid.Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. title: Post-doc position at the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness at SSE
description: About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research areaWellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.The roleThe postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. Your profileThe applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. Qualifications    PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.    A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals    Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs    Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python    Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network    Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular scienceMeritorious    Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text    Development of open research software or openly shared models    Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics How to apply: Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:     A curriculum vitae     A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).     Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)     Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts     Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.For further questions on the positions, please contact Assistant professor and Executive Director Fredrik Lange at fredrik.lange@hhs.seAbout the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Carpenter i Gislaved söker Account Manager
description: Hos Carpenter får du möjlighet att vara med och påverka företagets fortsatta utveckling och tillväxt.Du får en roll med stort kundfokus, tydligt affärsansvar och möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med både kunder och kollegor.Här får du inte bara förvalta befintliga affärer – du får vara med och skapa nya.Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter, tar initiativ och motiveras av att se resultatet av ditt arbete.Från relation till affär – är det dig vi söker?Är du en driven och affärsorienterad säljare som trivs med att bygga starka kundrelationer, hitta nya affärsmöjligheter och skapa långsiktigt värde för kunder? Då kan detta vara ditt nästa steg.OM ROLLENSom Account Manager hos oss får du en viktig roll i företagets fortsatta tillväxt. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och stärka befintliga kundrelationer samtidigt som du aktivt identifierar, utvecklar och vinner nya affärer.Vi söker dig som tycker om att vara nära kunden, förstå deras verksamhet och behov och omsätta detta till konkreta affärsmöjligheter.Rollen passar dig som uppskattar frihet under ansvar, tydliga affärsmål och möjligheten att påverka. Du blir en viktig länk mellan kunden och Carpenter och arbetar nära kollegor inom försäljning, kundservice, produktion, teknik och projekt.DINA HUVUDSAKLIGA ARBETSUPPGIFTER- Utveckla och fördjupa relationerna med Carpenters strategiska kunder - Identifiera, utveckla och vinna nya affärer och kunder - Öka försäljning och marknadsandel genom aktiv bearbetning - Ta fram och genomföra tillväxtplaner tillsammans med Sales Manager - Förstå kundernas behov och omsätta dem till kommersiella möjligheter - Ansvara för offerter, prisdiskussioner och kommersiella förhandlingar - Följa marknaden, kundernas strategier och konkurrenternas utveckling - Delta i mässor, utställningar och andra kund- och marknadsaktiviteter - Säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet och utveckla långsiktiga kundsamarbeten - Arbeta tvärfunktionellt med interna team för att säkerställa att Carpenter levererar på kundens behovEn viktig del av rollen är att vara nära marknaden och kunderna. Du kommer därför att tillbringa en stor del av din tid ute hos kunder och potentiella kunder, normalt cirka 3–5 resdagar per vecka beroende på marknadens behov.VEM ÄR DU?Vi tror att du: - Har erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning eller Account Management - Gärna har erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustrin, tekniska produkter eller industriella lösningar - Har ett starkt kommersiellt driv och motiveras av att göra affärer - Har en tydlig hunter-mentalitet och tycker om att prospektera och vinna nya kunder - Är skicklig på att skapa förtroende och bygga långsiktiga relationer - Kan förstå tekniska behov och omvandla dem till kommersiella lösningar - Har mycket god kommunikations- och förhandlingsförmåga - Är resultatorienterad, självgående och proaktiv -Trivs med att samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen- Behärska svenska och engelska väl, både i tal och skrift- B-körkort är ett krav AnsökanI denna rekryteringen samarbetar Carpenter med oss på Junic. title: Backend Software Engineer Java
description: Senior Java EngineerBuild the services. Own the outcome.A concurrency bug that only appears under real load. A service that must stay available when adependency fails. Privacy guarantees that have to hold in production. These are the kinds of problems you will work through in this Java assignment.Join 2MNordic for a long-term client assignment in a small, autonomous engineering team. Own services from design through production, influence the technical approach and build frameworks used across teams and by the developer community.Why this role is worth your attention• Ownership from design to production. Take a goal, work out the approach and see your service through delivery.• Depth beyond the framework. Work with Java concurrency, memory behaviour and performance under real production load.• Decisions with consequences. Design for availability, security and distributed failure modes, with privacy central to the system.• Time to go deep. A long-term assignment gives you room to understand the domain and improve the services you build.What you will build and improve• Customer-facing web services that handle authentication, authorisation, spam control and demanding availability requirements.• REST services using Netty or similar frameworks, backed by storage and caching technologies such as Cassandra, Redis and memcached.• Distributed services designed around consistency, partitioning and failure recovery.• Shared frameworks and reliable releases supported by automated testing and CI/CD.How the team worksYou will work across teams, manage dependencies and make technical decisions others can follow.Priorities evolve as capabilities, security considerations and partner needs change. You should be comfortable adapting the plan, challenging assumptions and protecting quality as you do.Bring your engineering judgementYou have built and scaled services for real users, debugged production failures and learned from the results. Typically, that means five or more years of experience; the depth of your work matters more than the number.• Deep Java knowledge: the memory model, garbage collection behaviour and tuning, allocation pressure and java.util.concurrent beyond synchronised blocks. You can explain when to use virtual threads versus classic reactive models.• Production debugging: experience investigating problems that only appear under real load or concurrency, and reading dependency source code when documentation is no longer enough.• Service engineering: authentication, authorisation, availability, abuse prevention, reliability and performance tuning under load.• Distributed systems and data: sound reasoning about consistency, partitioning and failure modes, plus strong knowledge of Cassandra, Redis, memcached or comparable technologies.• Reliable delivery: REST services with Netty or similar frameworks, automated testing and CI/CD tooling.• Clear communication in English: explain technical decisions to engineers and non-engineers, write useful design documents and work through trade-offs across teams.Experience that adds valueCryptography knowledge is particularly valuable: PKCS, KMIP, X.509, AES, key derivation functions and certificate authorities. Key handling and privacy guarantees are central to the system.Experience with ML systems, frameworks or algorithms is a bonus, as is familiarity with GitHub, Maven, Docker, Spinnaker and Kubernetes.Your consultancy partner: 2MNordicFounded in Sweden in 2001, 2MNordic helps companies turn technological complexity into operational capability. Our work spans software development, architecture, automation, AI and data.This assignment brings that approach to hands-on backend engineering with our client in Malmö.Explore our work at 2mnordic.com.Let your work start the conversationSend your CV or consultant profile, availability and a few lines about a difficult Java or distributed systems problem you helped solve.Location matters: this is an onsite assignment in Malmö. Include your current location and whether you can commute or relocate. The working language is English.

title: Junior Structural Analysis Engineer – Marine Technology
description: Work with large-scale moving structures where structural analysis, advanced mechanics and material engineering come together. Help develop innovative wind-powered technology for more energy-efficient shipping, taking your calculations and design solutions all the way to full-scale applications. As part of a small engineering team, you'll have the freedom to influence the product and take ownership from day one. Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, you'll get to tackle complex engineering challenges while developing your technical expertise.About the RoleWe are looking for a Junior Structural Analysis Engineer to join an innovative technology company in Stockholm, developing large-scale mechanical systems for more sustainable shipping. The company combines advanced engineering, mechanical design and material technology to create solutions that harness wind power and reduce fuel consumption in the maritime industry.In this role, you will focus on developing and improving existing products, making complex mechanical structures lighter, more efficient and easier to manufacture. Your work will range from detailed structural calculations and smaller design improvements to evaluating major design changes and new technical concepts.You will work closely with mechanical engineers and other specialists in a small, collaborative development team. The products involve large moving structures exposed to demanding environmental conditions, where loads, movement, material properties and mechanical functionality must all be considered.What makes this opportunity particularly exciting is the ability to influence the actual product. Your calculations and technical assessments will directly contribute to design decisions, and you will have the opportunity to follow your work through development, manufacturing and testing. With a high level of responsibility and freedom, you will play an active role in shaping both the technical solutions and the final product.Key Responsibilities    Perform structural calculations and analyses of large-scale mechanical structures and components.    Analyze and optimize designs with regard to strength, weight, functionality and manufacturability.    Evaluate how different loads, movements and material properties affect structural performance.    Prepare calculation reports and technical documentation to support engineering decisions.    Work with calculation and simulation tools, including opportunities to develop and improve analysis methods.    Evaluate design alternatives and contribute to technical solutions in close collaboration with mechanical engineers.    Participate in product development, from early concepts and design iterations to final solutions and testing.About You    A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Engineering Mechanics, Marine Engineering or a related field.    A solid understanding of structural mechanics, strength of materials and mechanical behavior under different loads.    Experience with structural calculations and analysis, gained through academic projects or professional work.    An interest in mechanical design and understanding how individual components contribute to the performance of a complete system.    Good communication skills in English.It is considered an advantage if you have experience with finite element analysis (FEA), ANSYS, Python or similar engineering calculation tools. Experience with large mechanical structures, moving systems, hydraulics, steel or composite materials is also valuable. A background in marine engineering, offshore, heavy industry or working with DNV standards would be particularly relevant.As a person, you are self-driven, curious and comfortable taking responsibility for your own work. You enjoy getting into the technical details of calculations while maintaining an understanding of the bigger picture. You take initiative, explore different solutions and are motivated by seeing your engineering work turn into real, functioning products.About the employmentThis is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and our client is for you to transition to direct employment with the client after 12 months.Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.Practical information    Employment: Full-time    Start date: By agreement    Location: Stockholm, Flemmingsberg    Salary: Market-aligned monthly salary    Contact person: Anna PerssonAbout FridayFriday connects technical specialists with companies where their knowledge and ambitions can develop over time. We take the time to understand what you are looking for and match you with roles that fit both your experience and your next career step.We value potential and ambition and work actively toward an inclusive recruitment process in which candidates are assessed on relevant qualifications and experience.Friday has offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Each year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and recruit technical specialists for organisations ranging from international companies to growing technology businesses.

title: Spaceport Engineer  EGSE
description: Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace?  Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?    If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as EGSE (Electrical ground support equipment) Spaceport Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.   Help build the systems that make rocket launches possible! As a Spaceport Engineer – EGSE, you will design, build and maintain the electrical ground support equipment used in testing and launch operations. Combining hands-on work with system ownership, you will collaborate with operations teams, suppliers and customers to bring reliable data acquisition and control systems into use. JOB REQUIREMENTS     A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.     A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles, particularly low-voltage instrumentation and control circuits.     Experience programming or configuring PLC and HMI systems, and using electrical drawings to build or troubleshoot panels and wiring harnesses.     A practical approach to solving technical problems, with the ability to take initiative and work closely with others to keep projects moving. Desired We welcome different technical backgrounds. Experience in some of the following areas would be valuable, and you do not need to bring them all:     Data acquisition and control systems in aerospace, industrial facilities or similar environments.     Technical documentation such as P&IDs, wiring schematics, control descriptions and instrument lists.     Industrial networks, communication protocols and hardware interfaces, or National Instruments tools used with LabVIEW.     Safety requirements and hazard analysis for ground support equipment.     Supporting technicians or mentoring junior engineers. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES    Design and develop instrumentation, data acquisition, PLC and HMI systems, including the electrical drawings and documentation needed to build and maintain them.     Build, test, troubleshoot and commission equipment, including instrument calibration and configuration.     Coordinate installation from site surveys and supplier quotations through to commissioning, training and technical support.     Work with operations teams to deliver safe, reliable systems that meet project, regulatory and operational requirements.     Carry out system checkouts and support testing and launch campaigns, including launch-day operations.     Define requirements and coordinate the installation of supporting power and communications infrastructure.  JOB BENEFITSWe offer you       A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.      An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.      An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   Additional benefits  In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.       Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.      Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.       Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.      Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.      Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  LOCATIONThis is a full-time, permanent position based at our Space Center Esrange outside of Kiruna.  NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.  When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.   As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.   WE HEALP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACESSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.  With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.    We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Supply Chain Sales Support Manager
description: Do you enjoy creating clarity at the intersection of customers, Sales and Supply Chain? We’re looking for a Supply Chain Sales Support Manager to lead our global function and develop a proactive, structured and data-driven service that colleagues and customers can rely on. At Seco, collaboration, responsibility, curiosity and continuous improvement guide how we work and grow. Here, you get to:     Lead a global function at the heart of customer order flow.     Shape how Sales and Supply Chain work together through clear governance, service levels, KPIs and digital tools.     Join a collaborative environment where curiosity and continuous learning are valued.   About the job  You lead and develop the global Supply Chain Sales Support function, creating a standardized, customer-focused and efficient interface between Sales and our end-to-end supply chain. With a clear focus on governance and proactive support, you ensure that customer needs, order exceptions and supply constraints are translated into priorities and coordinated action. The function is in the middle of a shift: building on a strong foundation in case handling towards an end-to-end control and improvement capability. You lead that change, and you lead it through people. Developing your team’s skills, ownership and confidence is as much a part of the job as the processes and tools. Job responsibilities     Lead, coach and develop the Supply Chain Sales Support team: set clear roles and expectations, build capability in customer communication, supply chain understanding, problem-solving and case management, and grow people into broader ownership.     Lead the development towards proactive exception management, building on the team’s case-handling expertise, and make new ways of working stick in daily operations.     Establish and maintain global governance across the order-to-delivery flow, including ownership boundaries, decision rights and escalation paths.     Act as the primary supply chain interface for Sales and Customer Service regarding prioritized orders, supply exceptions and special customer requirements.     Develop the service model, including case categories, service levels, prioritization principles, escalation protocols and KPIs.     Use case data and performance insights to identify root causes and drive structural improvements with the responsible process owners.     Drive digitalization of case management, workflows, reporting and knowledge management, reducing repetitive demand through automation and self-service. Location and flexibility  The position is flexible is preferably based in Fagersta, Sweden, but another Seco location can be considered for the right candidate. We offer a hybrid working model that combines time at the office with remote work. Your profile   You have solid experience in supply chain, logistics, planning, order management or customer service operations. Having worked at the intersection of a commercial organization and operational supply chain functions, you’re comfortable creating structure across complex, cross-functional environments and using data to support decisions. You communicate fluently in English; Swedish is considered an advantage. Your background includes:      Experience establishing processes, ownership models, escalation paths or service frameworks across multiple functions.     Knowledge of customer-order exceptions, escalations and prioritization, preferably within a case-based way of working.     The ability to identify recurring operational issues, uncover root causes and turn insights into structural improvements.     Experience using CRM or case-management systems, ERP data, KPIs and reporting.     People leadership experience and a university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or equivalent experience. Customer focus and structure are central to your way of working. You simplify complex supply chain situations, create a shared understanding among commercial and operational colleagues and distinguish individual exceptions from structural problems. Calm and solution-focused, you challenge unnecessary manual work and fragmented processes while moving issues confidently towards resolution. The teamYou lead the global Supply Chain Sales Support team and work closely with Sales, Customer Service, Planning, Logistics, Production Units, Distribution Centres, IT and other operational functions. Together, you create globally consistent ways of working while accommodating relevant local requirements. Our Seco culture   At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.    Contact information   For further information about this position, please contact Christian Shafi, Global Logistics & Supply Chain Sales Support Manager +46 (0)70- 741 92 28 We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.   Union contacts – Sweden        David Romlin, Unionen, +46 (0)70-608 46 90      Jörgen Andersson, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)70-548 10 70     Benny Christiansen, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-523 50 60  Recruitment Specialist: Heidi Pynnönen     How to apply Send us your application no later than November 27th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099488.   We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test. For more information about our recruitment process, please contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

title: Socialpedagog sökes till HVB Viljan Varla
description: Om Viljan VarlaViljan Varla HVB ligger i en rymlig villa med lummig trädgård i Kungsbacka, nära skola, gym och fritidsaktiviteter. Vi tar emot pojkar och flickor 14–20 år med svårigheter eller riskbeteenden kopplade till trauma eller psykisk ohälsa, och erbjuder individanpassad behandling i en trygg, hemlik miljö. Om rollen som socialpedagogVi arbetar med engagemang i allt kring våra klienter.  Rollen som socialpedagog innebär att planera, genomföra och följa upp pedagogiska och behandlande insatser utifrån individens behov. Arbetet bygger på att skapa trygga relationer, motivera till förändring och stärka individens förmåga till självständighet. Det ingår även att dokumentera insatser och delta i planeringsmöten och utvecklingsarbete. Du fungerar som ett stöd för klienten och ni tillsammans utvecklar strategier för att uppnå mål i vardagen.Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:    Ge individuellt stöd i vardagliga aktiviteter, social träning och färdigheter.    Arbeta utifrån genomförandeplaner, behandlingsmetoder och pedagogiska insatser.    Hålla strukturerade samtal, motiverande samtal och använda andra evidensbaserade metoder.    Skriva journaler, genomförandeplaner, riskbedömningar och rapporter enligt gällande riktlinjer.    Samarbeta med kollegor, socialtjänst, skola, vårdinstanser och anhöriga.    Skapa en stabil, säker och förutsägbar miljö; hantera konflikter och gränssättning.    Planera och genomföra aktiviteter som stärker deltagarnas sociala och personliga utveckling. KvalifikationerDu är relationsskapande och har god förmåga att etablera relation med ungdomar i utsatta situationer. Du tar med dig humor och en vilja att vara en i teamet. Du är lugn, stabil och kan hålla ett realistiskt perspektiv på situationer som uppkommer i det dagliga arbetet.  Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och relaterar till andra på ett lyhört sätt samt trivs med att samverka med andra.  Du är en självständig, ödmjuk och ansvarsfull person som brinner för omsorgsarbete och kan se individens behov.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och det är av vikt att du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med ungdomar.  Krav:    Utbildad socialpedagog eller 400 YHP socialpedagog eller universitetsutbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.    B-körkort    Goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift    God datorvana, erfarenhet av dokumentation.    erfarenhet från arbete med ungdomar Meriterande:Repulse, MI, TMO och andra metoder man arbetar med inom behandling AnställningsvillkorRoll: SocialpedagogAnställningsform: Tillsvidare. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.Tjänstgöringsgrad: 100 procent.Arbetstid: Oregelbunden arbetstid.Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.Kollektivavtal: Vi är kollektivavtalsbundna till Vårdföretagarna/Kommunal, Bransch E.Vad kan vi erbjuda dig? Viljan är en del av Attendo, som är en trygg arbetsgivare och kan erbjuda dig som vill goda möjligheter att ta mer ansvar eller att gå vidare till nya roller. Vi erbjuder dig som medarbetare utbildningsmöjligheter, kollektivavtal, friskvård samt flera andra förmåner och och personalrabatter via vår förmånsportal AttendoPlus, i samarbete med Benifex.Om rekryteringsprocessenFöre eventuell anställning ska utdrag ur belastningsregistret tillsammans med giltig fotolegitimation visas upp. Om du blir kallad till en intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.Om Viljan/AttendoViljan är en del av Attendo, som är ett av Nordens största omsorgsföretag och startades 1985. Vi är verksamma inom IOF. Våra värderingar omtanke, engagemang och kompetens vägleder oss dagligen i vårt arbete för att alla ska uppleva trivsel, delaktighet, gemenskap och arbetsglädje.Om du vill vara med och hjälpa människor att ta nästa positiva steg i livet så är Viljan arbetsplatsen för dig.Som en del av vårt arbete för en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö genomför vi slumpmässiga alkohol- och drogtester.Välkommen med din ansökan!Tillsammans för en bättre morgondag!Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta: Malin.ademius@viljan.se

title: Security Officer
description: Reports to: Facilities and Operations Manager Stockholm International School is a non-profit foundation that caters to the Stockholm Diplomatic community, government, banks and industry. Therefore, the security aspect is very important. The Security Officer is responsible for the protection of the students as well as the protection of the staff, visitors and facilities. Our visionTo be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.Our missionStockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.Description/Purpose:     Provide close protection for all staff and students at all times during the school day     In charge of entrance security at drop-off and pick-up     Patrol of the grounds and buildings     Keep all buildings safe and secure from intruders and threats     Accompany staff and students on field trips, museums, sports days and other special events    Escort students between school buildings     Engage in weekly meetings with the Security Team to discuss current security issues and threats     Overview all locations on CCTV Preferred Education and Experience:    Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish    Training in security or close protection.At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.What we offer:As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. Contract:Temporary Contract - Spring TermTime allocation:  100%Starting: January 7, 2027Ending: June 15, 2027Salary:Individually negotiatedApplication:Last day for application:  November 30th, 2026We only accept applications in English and from certified candidates. SIS reserves the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found. Please send your letter of interest and CV to application@intsch.se. Please write “Security Officer” in the Subject Line.

title: Senior Accountant till världsledande bolag i Södertälje
description: Till vår kund, ett världsledande företag inom lastbils- och busstillverkning tillsätter SJR nu en Senior Accountant till en av vår kunds redovisningsenheter. Företaget sitter i fina lokaler i Södertälje med bra kommunikationer. Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid på 6 månader med start så snart som möjligt. För rätt person finns möjligheten därefter att bli förlängd på uppdraget. Om tjänstenI rollen ansvarar du för att bidra till korrekt och högkvalitativ finansiell rapportering samt säkerställa att redovisningen följer gällande regelverk och interna riktlinjer. Du får en bred kontaktyta inom organisationen och samarbetar med olika funktioner för att säkerställa kvalitet och effektivitet i de finansiella processerna.Organisationen befinner sig i en förändringsresa med fokus på digitalisering, moderna systemstöd samt harmonisering och effektivisering av arbetssätt och processer. Det här är därför en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera kvalificerat redovisningsarbete med analys, utveckling och förbättringsarbete.Ansvarsområden- Arbeta med löpande och kvalificerad redovisning, inklusive bokningar, kontoavstämningar och huvudbok.- Delta i månadsbokslut och andra periodiska bokslutsprocesser.- Sammanställa, konsolidera, analysera och rapportera finansiell information.- Säkerställa att redovisning och rapportering sker i enlighet med IFRS, Swedish GAAP och interna riktlinjer.- Ta fram finansiella rapporter, saldobalanser och underlag för intern och extern rapportering.- Ge stöd och vägledning till interna intressenter i redovisningsrelaterade frågor.- Bidra till finansiell kontroll, kvalitetssäkring och compliance.- Delta i utveckling och förbättring av processer, arbetssätt och datahantering.- Bidra i pågående projekt och andra initiativ inom Finance.Lämplig bakgrundVi söker dig som har en akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning, finans eller motsvarande, alternativt har förvärvat likvärdig kompetens genom arbetslivet. Du har cirka 3–4 års erfarenhet av kvalificerad redovisning, finansiell rapportering eller en liknande roll inom Finance och känner dig trygg i bokslutsarbete, kontoavstämningar och finansiell rapportering. För tjänsten behöver du ha erfarenhet av rapportering enligt IFRS och Swedish GAAP. Eftersom du kommer att arbeta i en internationell organisation med många kontaktytor behöver du också kunna kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Har du erfarenhet av SAP är det meriterande. Personliga egenskaperFör att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är strukturerad, analytisk och noggrann. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du uppskattar att samarbeta med andra.Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med olika delar av organisationen. Vidare har du ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt och ett intresse för att utveckla och effektivisera processer och arbetssätt. Du trivs i en föränderlig miljö där du får möjlighet att kombinera din specialistkompetens inom redovisning med ett kontinuerligt förbättringsfokus.AnsökanVi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-12-14. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Konsult hos SJRAtt arbeta som konsult hos SJR innebär att du blir en del av en dedikerad organisation med kompetens att ge dig perfekta förutsättningar att utvecklas både inom din yrkesroll och på ett personligt plan. Du får tillgång till vårt stora nätverk av intressanta företag och uppdragsgivare och därmed en unik möjlighet att ta din karriär till nästa steg.Vi på SJR bryr oss om vår personal och tillsammans med oss får du en långsiktig partner som ger dig trygghet och stöd. title: Development Team Lead- Team Notification & Communication
description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleThe RoleAs the Team Lead for Noco (Notification & Communication), you own two of the most trusted touchpoints in the traveler’s journey: the messages that keep customers informed, and the account experience that lets them manage their own journey. Every booking confirmation, schedule-change alert, receipt, and proactive notification a customer receives runs through your team’s systems — and so does the account functionality we’re actively building out to give travelers more control and visibility over their own data.You won’t just lead a team; you will be the bridge between Product, Platform, and the many domain teams who depend on reliable, well-governed communication and account infrastructure. Collaborate with your manager to make sure the team follows their agreed upon ways of working. You will lead a group of experienced engineers in maintaining a high-trust, high-reliability platform while helping shape where it goes next.Your ResponsibilitiesCoordinate Efforts: Keep the team aligned across two active fronts — communication infrastructure and the evolving Customer Account as well as future initiatives — ensuring both move forward smoothly without one starving the other of attention.Facilitate Communication: Serve as the bridge between your engineers and the stakeholders who depend on your systems, from Product Owners to stakeholders to the many domain teams whose customer-facing flows rely on your infrastructure.Technical Guidance: Drive the technical quality bar across both domains. Coordinate direction on complex technical issues with the help of the team.Team Empowerment: Empower your engineers to do their best work without micromanaging. Foster a culture of ownership for the health and performance of everything the team builds.Stakeholder Management: Keep everyone informed from your engineers to management, and communicate expectations as priorities shift.Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for the team’s output — staying hands-on enough to guide technical decisions credibly, participating in recruitment, and providing appraisal input to your manager.Requirements    6+ years of experience in Java development, with exposure to system design and architecture.    Proven leadership or mentorship experience in a technical role.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build bridges between technical and business teams.BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals.
