title: Orderplockare till e-handelslager i Löddeköpinge, Heltid
description: Winblad Import AB fortsätter att växa och söker nu en noggrann och driven orderplockare till vårt lager i Löddeköpinge. Tjänsten är i första hand en heltidstjänst (mån–fre ca 07:30–16:00), men vi är även öppna för rätt kandidat på deltid. Anställningen inleds med provanställning med mål om tillsvidareanställning.Arbetsuppgifter    Plocka, packa och boka sändningar för paket och brev    Hantera inleveranser, avstämning och godsmottagning    Driva returhantering samt ansvara för öppning och stängning av lagretKrav    Flytande svenska i tal och skrift: Du måste kunna läsa instruktioner, hantera boksystern och kommunicera obehindrat på svenska dagligen.    Hög arbetsmoral, struktur och förmåga att arbeta självständigt under hela arbetsdagen.    Hög tillförlitlighet och punktlighet.Meriterande    Erfarenhet av lagerarbete, orderplock eller e-handel.

title: Butikssäljare  färgfackhandel
description: Om tjänstenÄr du en social och driven säljare med gedigen kunskap inom färg, tapet, golv eller kakel? Nu söker vi en ny stjärna till vårt team! Vi erbjuder en heltidstjänst (100 %) hos en välkomnande och väletablerad färgbutik där kundmötet och fackkunskapen alltid står i centrum.Hos oss blir du en nyckelperson i butiken med ett omväxlande och fysiskt arbete. Vi söker dig som redan kan branschen och vill ta nästa steg i en roll där du får ta eget ansvar och göra verklig skillnad för både privatkunder och yrkesmålare.Dina arbetsuppgifterArbetet är rörligt och varierat med högt tempo. I rollen ingår bland annat:    Kundrådgivning och försäljning: Guida kunder genom hela projektet – från val av rätt färgtyp och nyansering till tapeter, golv samt kakel och klinker.    Lager och varuhantering: Ordermottagning, uppackning av varor och påfyllning i butik. Tunga lyft förekommer dagligen.Vem är du? För att lyckas i rollen och trivas hos oss behöver du ha rätt bakgrund från start. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du uppfyller följande krav:    Branscherfarenhet: Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet eller gedigen kunskap inom färghandel – exempelvis kring färg, måleri, tapet, golv eller kakel/klinker.    Körkort: Du innehar B-körkort för manuell växellåda.    Språk: Du behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat i tal och skrift.    Fysik och inställning: Du trivs med ett fysiskt krävande och rörligt jobb där du inte är rädd för att hugga i.    Personlighet: Du är en social, van att arbeta så väl enskilt som i grupp, du brinner för att ge förstklassig service.Vi erbjuder    En trygg tillsvidareanställning på 100 % (inleds med 6 månaders provanställning).    Möjligheten att arbeta brett med spännande produkter inom färg och inredning.AnsökanKänner du att detta stämmer in på dig? Skicka in ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev där du tydligt beskriver din erfarenhet inom färg- eller byggbranschen.Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen med din ansökan….

title: Personlig assistent till aktiv 8-årig pojke i Eskilstuna
description: Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och aktiv personlig assistent till en glad och nyfiken 8-årig pojke i Eskilstuna.Arbetet passar dig som tycker om att arbeta med barn, gillar ett aktivt arbete och vill bygga en långsiktig och trygg relation med barnet och familjen.Om barnetHan är en glad, nyfiken och mycket aktiv 8-årig pojke med autism och ADHD. Han tycker om att vara ute, röra på sig och göra olika aktiviteter – särskilt att besöka badhus och simhall.Han går själv men använder ibland rullstol vid vissa aktiviteter utomhus.För att skapa trygghet i vardagen följer han tydliga rutiner och ett välfungerande schema. Som assistent får du en ordentlig introduktion av familjen kring hans behov, rutiner, kommunikation och hur olika situationer bäst hanteras.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom personlig assistent hjälper och stöttar du honom i vardagen. Arbetet innebär bland annat att:    följa med på aktiviteter och utflykter        följa med till badhus/simhall och vara aktiv tillsammans med honom        hjälpa till med personlig hygien och påklädning        hjälpa till vid måltider        förbereda honom inför aktiviteter        följa etablerade rutiner och skapa struktur och trygghet        vara uppmärksam på hans signaler och behovEn viktig del av arbetet är att skapa en trygg och positiv vardag där han får vara så delaktig och självständig som möjligt.Säkerhet och uppmärksamhetHan är mycket aktiv och kan röra sig snabbt. I vissa situationer kan han plötsligt springa iväg, vilket gör att du behöver vara uppmärksam och ha god uppsikt, särskilt vid aktiviteter utanför hemmet.När han blir mycket stressad eller upprörd kan han ibland göra sig själv illa. Därför söker vi en person som kan behålla lugnet, läsa av situationer och arbeta förebyggande.Han är inte aggressiv mot andra.Vem söker vi?Vi söker framför allt rätt person.Du behöver vara:    lugn och tålmodig        trygg och ansvarstagande        uppmärksam och observant        aktiv och ha förmåga att följa med i barnets tempo        lyhörd och respektfull        flexibel och lösningsorienterad        trygg i att arbeta nära både barnet och familjenDu behöver också kunna samarbeta med familjen och förstå betydelsen av kontinuitet och fasta rutiner.ErfarenhetVi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn.Det är särskilt meriterande om du har erfarenhet från exempelvis:    förskola eller barnomsorg        personlig assistans        LSS-verksamhet        boende eller stödverksamhet        arbete med barn med autism, ADHD eller andra neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningarVi värdesätter praktisk erfarenhet, gott omdöme och personlig lämplighet mycket högt.Arbetstid och omfattningArbetet är främst förlagt till eftermiddagar cirka 3–4 dagar per vecka.Under skollov kan även arbetspass på förmiddagar förekomma.Vi söker dig som kan arbeta regelbundet och gärna vill stanna långsiktigt, eftersom kontinuitet och trygghet är mycket viktigt för barnet.Körkort är inget krav. Busskort kan ordnas vid behov.Anställningsform och lön fastställs enligt överenskommelse och tillämpliga villkor.RegisterutdragEftersom arbetet innebär personlig assistans till ett barn kommer registerutdrag för arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning att behöva visas upp i samband med erbjudande om anställning.Låter detta som ett arbete för dig?Om du är en varm, trygg, aktiv och ansvarstagande person som tycker om att arbeta med barn vill vi gärna höra från dig.Berätta gärna kort om dig själv, din tidigare erfarenhet och varför du tror att just du skulle passa för uppdraget.

title: Inköps- och Säljkoordinator  min. 50 % Hybridarbete
description: Om Jobbet:Vi söker nu en Inköps- och Säljkoordinator som blir en nyckelperson i skärningspunkten mellan våra leverantörer och kunder. Du säkerställer att inköp, order och leveranser flyter smidigt – från första kontakt med leverantör till att kunden får sin komponent i tid. Rollen passar dig som trivs med att arbeta självständigt, gillar internationella kontakter och vill vara en del av ett bolag i tillväxt.Hos oss får du vara med och driva affärer och leverantörsrelationer i en internationell, teknikdriven miljö där kvalitet och långsiktiga partnerskap står i centrum – tillsammans med kollegor som har varandras ryggar. Vi är ett glatt gäng som gillar att ha kul tillsammans på jobbet, som skrattar minst lika mycket som vi jobbar hårt, och som alltid ställer upp för varandra. Samma engagemang tar vi med oss till våra kunder och leverantörer: långsiktiga relationer och riktiga samarbeten, inte bara affärer.Dina arbetsuppgifter:    Hantera inköp och löpande kontakt med leverantörer, med tyngdpunkt på Asien    Ordermottagning, hantering och koordinering av leveranser, import och export    Vara kundernas kontaktperson i den dagliga dialogen kring fraktpriser, leveranstid/leveransplaner och status.    Arbeta i olika ERP-system för inköp, order och lager    Bidra till att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rutiner för inköp och sälj    Övriga kundärendenVi söker dig som har:    Minst 5 års erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustrin, gärna B2B    Erfarenhet av och god kunskap i olika ERP-system    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer i Asien    Erfarenhet av import och export    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift    Goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365, särskilt Outlook, Excel och Teams och van vid att använda AI-hjälpmedel i det dagliga arbetet.    Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och driva ditt eget arbete framåt.    Förmåga att snabbt lära dig företagets produkter system och interna rutiner.    Bra på att följa upp och slutföra uppgifter.    Trivs med att arbeta nära kollegor i ett litet företag. Familjär, kort till beslut    Flexibel och prestigelös.    Som person är du positiv, van att arbeta i team och samtidigt trygg i att arbeta självständigt.Meriterande:     Ytterligare språkkunskaper utöver svenska och engelska.Vi erbjuder    Hybridarbete med min 50% flexibilitet mellan kontor i Älta, Nacka och distans men vill att du ska vara bosatt i Stockholms län.    Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning    En internationell arbetsmiljö med kontakter i hela världen,    Fast lön på marknadsmässig nivå    Friskvårdsbidrag, Sjukförsäkring, Tjänstepension och utvecklingsmöjligheter.Om Weld2castWELD2CAST Engineering AB är en unik kontraktstillverkare av skräddarsydda och maskinbearbetade gjutna och smidda komponenter – med precisionsbearbetning och montering i egen regi. Genom vårt nätverk av produktionscentra i Europa, Turkiet, Kina och Sydostasien, samt logistikcenter i Stockholm, levererar vi skräddarsydda mekaniska komponenter till tillverkningsföretag i Skandinavien och Europa. Våra kunder befinner sig i 14 olika länder i Europa. Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till Gasellföretag under 2026.

title: Affärsadministratör till Ragn-Sells
description: Bli en del av Ragn-Sells i rollen som affärsadministratör, där du arbetar med administration, analys och affärsstöd i nära samarbete med säljorganisationen. En bred och affärsnära roll för dig som vill ta ansvar och utvecklas, oavsett om du har lång erfarenhet eller är i början av din karriär. Sök redan idag då start är omgående! Om tjänstenVår kund Ragn-Sells är ett företag i framkant som vill bevisa att omsorg om jorden och bra affärer går hand i hand. Om detta är en vision du också brinner för kan detta komma att bli din perfekta arbetsplats! Som affärsadministratör hos Ragn-Sells blir du en viktig partner till säljorganisationen och ett nära stöd till företagets KAM. Du är involverad redan i anbudsprocessen, där du bidrar med din kompetens kring exempelvis prismodeller, avtalsupplägg, systemregistrering och kundlösningar. När ett avtal är vunnet ansvarar du för den administrativa uppstarten och säkerställer att avtal, orderflöden och fakturering fungerar som de ska. Du arbetar även med analyser, statistik och kundrapporter som utgör viktiga beslutsunderlag för både verksamheten och kunderna.Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera administration, analys och affärsförståelse. Vi välkomnar både dig som har flera års erfarenhet och dig som är i början av din karriär och vill utvecklas inom området. Det viktigaste är att du är självgående, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad, samtidigt som du har god självinsikt och vet när du behöver stämma av eller ta hjälp av andra.Info:    Omfattning: Heltid, måndag–fredag (38,5 timmar per vecka)    Arbetsplats: Kallhäll    Detta är en långsiktig tjänst med start omgående som konsult     Läs mer här vad det innebär Att vara konsult    Som konsult har du en timbaserad månadslön. Läs mer om hur lönemodellen fungerar via länken: Lönemodellen för dig som konsult på Academic Work.ArbetsuppgifterSom affärsadministratör hanterar du hela det administrativa flödet kring våra kundavtal och stöttar säljorganisationen med analyser, rapportering och systemregistrering.    Stödja affärsenheterna i arbetet med offerter och avtal.      Utgöra det administrativa gränssnittet mot affärsenheterna.      Kontakta kund eller ansvarig säljare vid oaviserade leveranser och ta fram underlag för kundorder.      Administration av prislistor, statistik, fakturering och kundrapporter       Medverka i effektiviserings- och utvecklingsarbetet inom den administrativa avdelningen.       Säkerställa att företagets processer och riktlinjer efterlevs.Vi söker dig som    Har erfarenhet av administration, gärna i en affärs- eller säljrelaterad miljö. Du kan också vara i början av din karriär och ha en relevant utbildning eller erfarenhet som gett dig en god administrativ grund.    Goda kunskaper i Excel samt erfarenhet av att arbeta med data och rapporter    Är noggrann och strukturerad och trivs med att arbeta med stora mängder information och data.    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem    Har mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska    Är lösningsorienterad och har förmåga att prioritera och driva processer framåt.Det är meriterande om du har    Erfarenhet från avfalls- eller återvinningsbranschen    Tidigare erfarenhet av säljsupport, anbud eller avtalshantering    Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära säljorganisation eller KAM    Erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365)För att lyckas i rollenFör att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du vara trygg i att självständigt driva ditt arbete framåt och kunna prioritera när flera saker händer samtidigt. Du har god självinsikt, är lösningsorienterad och förstår vikten av att stämma av och ta hjälp när det behövs.Vi välkomnar både dig med längre erfarenhet, som vill bidra med din kompetens och utveckla arbetssätt, och dig som är tidigare i karriären och vill bygga erfarenhet inom administration, analys och affärsstöd.Vår rekryteringsprocessDenna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Tågtekniker Lok EuroMaint Malmö
description: Företagsbeskrivning:Är du tekniskt intresserad och trivs med ett praktiskt arbete där ingen dag är den andra lik? Vi söker nu en tågtekniker till vår lokverkstad i Malmö. I rollen arbetar du med felsökning, underhåll och reparation av diesellok tillsammans med engagerade kollegor. Du blir en viktig del i arbetet med att säkerställa hög kvalitet, säker drift och tillgängliga fordon.Arbetsbeskrivning:Om rollenSom tågtekniker på avdelningen lok i Malmö ser du till att dieselloken fungerar som de ska. Du arbetar med service, felsökning, reparationer och underhåll av lokens olika system och komponenter. Utöver arbetet med diesellok kan fältarbete förekomma. Då verksamheten i Malmö består av flera avdelningar kan du också få möjlighet att stötta andra delar av depån vid behov, vilket bidrar till en omväxlande och utvecklande arbetsdag. Oavsett avdelning är arbetet på EuroMaint i Malmö varierat och passar dig som gillar att lösa problem, arbeta praktiskt och ta dig an både planerade uppgifter och akuta åtgärder. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där ni tillsammans ansvarar för att hålla fordonen i drift. Förekommande arbetsuppgifter:     Felsöka och reparera diesellok (även andra fordonstyper kan förekomma)     Underhålla och byta komponenter, exempelvis bromsdetaljer, filter, pumpar och slangar     Kontroll, test och justering av mekaniska och elektriska system     Arbete med dieselmotorer, bränslesystem, kylsystem och luftsystem     Dokumentation av utfört arbete     Samarbete med kollegor inom drift, planering och verkstad     Erfarenhet av svarvning är meriterande  Din profilVi söker dig som är intresserad av teknik och tycker om att arbeta praktiskt. Du har erfarenhet från mekaniskt arbete inom exempelvis fordon, industri eller liknande verksamhet och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom området. Vi ser att du har:     Erfarenhet av mekaniskt arbete inom fordon, maskiner eller industri     Grundläggande elkunskaper     Förmåga att förstå tekniska system och arbeta strukturerat med felsökning  Som person är du nyfiken, ansvarstagande och samarbetsinriktad. Du trivs med att lösa problem tillsammans med andra och bidrar till en positiv stämning på arbetsplatsen. Du har ett naturligt fokus på kvalitet och säkerhet och ser vikten av att arbetet utförs noggrant och enligt gällande rutiner. Förmåner & erbjudandeVi erbjuder:     Friskvårdsbidrag på 4 000 kr per år     Ersättning för läkarkostnader och receptbelagd medicin upp till högkostnadsskyddet     Gratis mensskydd på alla våra arbetsplatser  På EuroMaint erbjuder vi en tydlig karriär- och lönemodell för våra tågtekniker. Rollen är indelad i flera nivåer, vilket innebär att du kan utvecklas och befordras inom yrket i takt med att du växer, tar större ansvar och breddar din kompetens. Plats & omfattningPlats: MalmöOmfattning: HeltidStartdatum: Enligt överenskommelseArbetstider: Skiftarbete, dag och kväll. Helgarbete förekommer.Form: Tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders provanställning Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi Master-tester OPTO och CORE för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning av dina färdigheter. Vi gör en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning erbjuds. Då denna tjänst är säkerhetsklassad ingår även en hälsoundersökning i rekryteringsprocessen, denna bekostas av oss. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Sista ansökningsdag är den 6 december, men vänta inte – tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan dess.Profilbeskrivning:Om EuroMaintEuroMaint erbjuder kvalificerat tekniskt underhåll på spårbundna fordon som tillgodoser kundernas behov av väl fungerande fordonsflottor. Vi har ett nät av verkstäder från Luleå i norr till Malmö i söder, samt två verkstäder i Norge. Huvudkontoret är placerat i Solna. Hos oss arbetar många specialister inom underhåll av järnvägsfordon. EuroMaint har en omsättning på ca 1 900 MSEK och cirka 1 100 medarbetare (2024). EuroMaint ägs av den börsnoterade spanska tågtillverkaren CAF sedan juli 2019. Våra värderingar:     Professionalism – vi strävar efter hög kvalitet, innovation och resultat     Förtroende – vi arbetar med ärlighet, integritet och laganda     Hållbarhet – vi tar ansvar för människor, miljö och framtid

title: Junior Cloud RAN Layer 1 SW Developer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity    Are you about to graduate, or have you recently completed your university studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field?  Join Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks.  Our teams develop performance-critical software at the heart of 5G and future radio systems. As a Junior Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced developers and technical experts to learn how advanced wireless communication systems are designed, implemented, tested, and optimized.  This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited about solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative environment.    What you will do         Develop and maintain software in Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 platform.     Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to support activities such as developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review.     Work with modern C++ and performance-critical software components.     Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work.     Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities.     Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams.     Contribute to software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement.     Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product, including prototyping, integration, testing, and evaluation together with experienced engineers.     Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience.     The skills you bring         Programming experience in C/C++, Python, Julia.     Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts.     Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects.     Experience with Linux development environments, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, or cloud-native technologies.     Basic understanding of 5G, mobile networks, physical layer processing, or 3GPP concepts.     Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly.     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.     Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications.     Good communication skills in English.     Curiosity, collaboration, ownership, and a strong willingness to learn.     You do not need previous professional telecom or Layer 1 experience. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, and the motivation to grow.   Please send your CV in English.

title: Baseband System Developer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:   Join Ericsson’s Business Network Engineering Unit as a Baseband System Developer. You will work in a team focused on developing and contributing to systemization for next-generation Radio Access Network products, with emphasis on baseband algorithms, signal processing, and multi-antenna systems. In this role, you will contribute to technical studies, requirements, simulations, and feature development for advanced wireless technologies. Our culture values inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation, with empathy and diversity as cornerstones. Team members are encouraged to express ideas and contribute to co-creation in a speak-up environment. You will collaborate with engineering, product, and standards-related teams, contributing technical input and analysis that support product development and future technology evolution. Success in this role will be demonstrated by delivering high-quality technical contributions, supporting robust system solutions, and helping improve network performance and efficiency toward product goals.     What you will do:        Contribute to systemization for next-generation Radio Access Network products by supporting system requirements, technical studies, and feature development     Develop, analyze, optimize radio resource management (RRM/L2) algorithms, with focus on Energy performance, MIMO, and beamforming strategies     Perform link-level and network-level system studies to evaluate wireless network performance and efficiency for 5G/6G technologies     Develop and refine software simulations and tools to assess design alternatives and support technical decision-making     Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams to support system integration, alignment across technical areas, and successful feature delivery     Support standardization-related investigations and contribute technical input in relevant internal and external forums     Create and maintain systemization artifacts such as requirements, analysis reports, and architectural input that support product development and feature integration    The skills you bring:        Relevant experience in wireless systems, preferably including 5G and emerging 6G technologies     Good foundation in communications theory, digital signal processing, MIMO, and beamforming     Analytical and structured problem-solving mindset, with curiosity and willingness to learn     Experience with simulation tools and environments for performance evaluation     Ability to collaborate across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams     Education: BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a closely related discipline     AI and ML experience for both product development and AI in product solutions    Nice-to-Have Skills:        Agile/Lean product development practices     Strong interpersonal skills and cross-team collaboration capabilities     Leadership experience

title: Verkstadschef inom tågunderhåll - EuroMaint Hallsberg
description: Företagsbeskrivning:Vill du ta ansvar för två viktiga verkstadsverksamheter i Hallsberg och vara med och forma deras framtid? Som verkstadschef på EuroMaint i Hallsberg får du ett helhetsansvar att utveckla verksamheterna, skapa stabilitet och säkerställa hög kvalitet, säkerhet och effektivitet.Arbetsbeskrivning: Om rollen Som verkstadschef har du det övergripande ansvaret för våra två verksamheter i Hallsberg med olika specialistområden men ett gemensamt fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och leverans. Du är trygg i ditt ledarskap och skapar förtroende genom att vara närvarande, lyhörd och tydlig. Du motiveras av att utveckla människor och team samt skapa engagemang och delaktighet. Samtidigt trivs du nära verksamheten och drivs av att omsätta beslut till konkreta resultat. Du ser vad som behöver göras, tar initiativ och agerar för att få saker att hända. Med ett handlingskraftigt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt driver du förbättringar från idé till genomförande och bidrar till verksamhetens långsiktiga utveckling. title: AI Engineer - Build production AI applications
description: Deerdata is a Stockholm-based consulting firm helping companies succeed with data, analytics, and AI. Our AI practice is growing fast, and we take ideas from strategy through to real, live systems in production.We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our AI & Agentic team. You’re a strong software engineer at your core, and you’ve shipped AI systems people actually use: agents with real tool access, retrieval and memory layers that hold up against messy customer data, and assistants that face end users without a human babysitting them. You know that a demo is easy and production is hard, and you enjoy closing that gap.What you’ll do    Design and build customer-facing AI solutions, including agentic systems, GenAI applications, and voice/chat interfaces, from prototype to production    Own the engineering craft: clean, testable code, sensible architecture, CI/CD, observability, cost and latency awareness    Work directly with clients as a trusted technical partner, translating business problems into concrete AI solutions    Support other engineers on the team, and help shape our internal engineering standards and reusable components    Stay ahead of the frontier: evaluate new models, frameworks, and patterns, and bring the right ones into our workWe’re looking for someone who has    5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong grounding in Python and modern backend or full-stack development    Hands-on experience building AI-powered products in production, ideally with LLMs, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, ADK or similar), RAG, and vector and graph databases    Comfort with at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern deployment practices (containers, IaC, CI/CD)    A pragmatic mindset: you care about accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and maintainability, not just what looks good in a notebook    Strong communication skills in English, and the confidence to work directly with client stakeholders. Swedish is good to have, and might be required at some of our customer projectsNice to have    Experience with real-time voice AI    Background in data engineering or MLOps (dbt, Airflow/Dagster, MLflow, evaluation pipelines)    Open-source contributions, technical writing, or speaking at conferences    Experience in a consulting or client-facing settingWhat we offer    A seat in a small, sharp team where you’ll build real systems for real users, not slideware    Hybrid way of working    30 days of vacation, occupational pension, and wellness allowance    Curious, kind colleagues who like to roll up their sleeves and co-create

title: People Business Partner
description: E.ON is one of Europe's largest operators of energy networks and infrastructure and a provider of innovative energy solutions. Our employees are constantly working to digitise the energy world, achieve net zero and connect everyone to good energy. To achieve this, we are focusing our actions on sustainability, digitalisation and growth. We strongly believe that differences make us stronger and welcome all people into our inclusive and diverse culture.Inom E.ON Energiinfrastruktur skapar vi energilösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder och samhället. Nu välkomnar vi en People Business Partner som vill arbeta nära vår fjärrvärmeverksamhet. Du blir en del av vårt People-team och ingår också i ett större sammanhang med People Business Partners i andra E.ON-bolag och centrala specialistfunktioner. Din rollSom People Business Partner är du en nära partner till chefer och lokala ledningsgrupper och omsätter verksamhetens behov i konkreta HR-insatser. Rollen förenar strategiskt och taktiskt arbete med chefsstöd i vardagen.Du vägleder i frågor som rör organisationsutveckling, förändring, bemanning och kompetensförsörjning. Du stöttar också chefer i arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och komplexa personalärenden samt förbereder och genomför facklig samverkan och MBL-förhandlingar. Tillsammans med chefer och HSE arbetar du för en trygg och hälsosam arbetsmiljö, med fokus på bland annat organisatorisk och social arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv.Tillsammans utvecklar vi arbetssätt och beteenden som stödjer verksamhetens förflyttning. Här får du bidra med perspektiv på hur digitalisering och AI kan förenkla och utveckla People-arbetet.Du utgår från Malmö, Eftersom du stöttar verksamheter i Norrköping, Stockholm och Örebro med chefer på flera orter är resor en naturlig och återkommande del av uppdraget. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande och bred erfarenhet av kvalificerat HR-arbete nära chefer och ledningsgrupper. Du har god kunskap om svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och facklig samverkan samt erfarenhet av rehabilitering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.Du är van vid att stödja förändring och att tillsammans med chefer omsätta verksamhetens behov i prioriteringar och aktiviteter. Du använder gärna HR-data som underlag och känner dig bekväm med digitala HR-system. Du kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska och anpassar ditt stöd efter olika människor och situationer.Du förenar empati och lyhördhet med tydlighet och integritet. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Hur är det hos oss?Hos oss möter du ett hjälpsamt team där vi delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Din chef Josefina har ett inkluderande och utvecklingsorienterat ledarskap som bygger på tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlig riktning. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november kl 10.00.Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Josefina Cederberg Wallin, josefina.cederberg-wallin@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Mats Ekblom, +46 705 259188Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.seMattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO +46 730 499778

title: Hands-on Marketing Project Manager
description: We are looking for a Hands-on Marketing Project Manager for a company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Project Manager to coordinate the execution of an upcoming launch.The launch strategy and agency selection have already been completed. Your role will be to turn the agreed plans into coordinated execution: bringing together Product, Legal, MarCom, agencies and other stakeholders, maintaining timelines, following up on commitments and ensuring that risks and issues are addressed promptly.Embedded in the MarCom team, you will provide the structure and follow-through needed to keep the launch on track. You will work closely with the MarCom lead accountable for asset delivery and report directly to the Head of MarCom.Key responsibilitiesCross-functional coordination    Maintain an integrated launch plan covering milestones, dependencies, deliverables and decision points.    Coordinate activities across Product, Legal, MarCom, agencies and other relevant teams.    Ensure that every action has a clear owner and deadline, and follow up consistently on commitments.    Organise project meetings, capture decisions and actions, and keep stakeholders aligned.    Identify dependencies and bottlenecks early, and coordinate the actions needed to resolve them.Agency delivery coordination    Act as the day-to-day coordination contact for the appointed agencies.    Track agency progress against agreed briefs, deadlines, deliverables and standards.    Coordinate reviews and approval workflows with the relevant internal owners.    Flag delays, gaps or deviations and follow up on corrective actions.    Work closely with the responsible MarCom lead to support timely asset delivery.Reporting and escalation    Provide clear, concise progress updates to the Head of MarCom.    Maintain visibility of outstanding actions, risks, issues and decisions required.    Escalate concerns early, explaining their likely impact and recommending next steps.    Ensure that decisions and changes are communicated to everyone affected.Event execution    Coordinate operational readiness ahead of the launch event.    Maintain the execution schedule, responsibilities and on-site coordination plan.    Be present on site to coordinate teams, agencies and suppliers during execution.    Support practical issue resolution and escalate matters requiring an accountable owner’s decision.Scope and accountabilityThis is an execution-focused project management role, not a strategic or creative leadership assignment.    Launch strategy and agency selection are already in place and are not part of this assignment.    You are responsible for project coordination, timeline management, follow-up, delivery tracking and escalation.    Final accountability for asset delivery remains with the designated MarCom lead.    Content, creative, product and legal approvals remain with the relevant internal owners.    You support these owners by keeping workflows moving and making issues visible; you do not replace their decision-making or approval responsibilities.Experience and capabilitiesWe are looking for someone who brings:    Experience managing cross-functional marketing, communications or product launch projects.    Strong agency coordination skills and experience working with multiple internal stakeholders.    Excellent planning, organisation and follow-through.    Experience supporting live events, including on-site execution.    The ability to influence without formal authority and hold stakeholders to agreed commitments constructively.    Sound judgement about when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate.    Clear, concise communication and confidence working with senior stakeholders.    A proactive, practical approach and the ability to stay calm under pressure.What success looks like    Teams and agencies have a shared understanding of priorities, responsibilities and deadlines.    Milestones, dependencies and approval requirements are actively tracked.    Risks and delivery issues are surfaced early, with clear actions and owners.    The Head of MarCom has reliable visibility of progress and decisions needed.    The launch event is well coordinated, with clear ownership and effective on-site support. This role requires fluency in English and Swedish.This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg. Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: 1st Line Support Agent (English and Spanish speaking)
description: The company has developed a groundbreaking cloud service for transportation companies. They have customers all over the world.They are experiencing strong demand of their product and because of that they need to strengthen their 1st line support team with a Spanish and English speaking support agent.This position is in Linköping and you need to work from the office.About you● You have excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think “outside the box”.● You possess great computing skills and are interested in all things technical.● You provide a high level of customer service and have a full understanding of its importance.● You are a curious and fast learner.● You communicate clearly in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.This is considered an entry-level position and although we don’t believe that you need specific qualifications to succeed in this role, it is very important that you are interested in tech, and have a basic understanding of computing, cloud-based services, and mobile technology.About the position As a 1st line support agent, no two days will look the same.Your daily focus will be to help our customers through phone, web chat and email.You will help our customers solving their problems and making sure they have the correct settings on their account.Over time, you will become an expert in the system and point of contact for anyone internally, you’ll be providing operational and technical support to teams across all of our departments.The working hours will be normal office hours, Monday to Friday.Your daily tasks will include● Help the customers through phone, web chat and email, to make sure the customers can use the system the way they want it to work.● Supporting the sales teams in sales demos and general technical support.It will be considered an advantage if● You speak additional languages, especially Swedish, Finnish, or French.● You have experience in technical support, ideally in an international environment.For this position you need to already have a Swedish work permit.

title: Part-time babysitter in Årsta – Serbian, Bosnian or Croatian speaking

title: Senior Projektledare
description: Om Multiply Teknik & IT & VisFlowMultiply Teknik & IT är ett teknikdrivet end to end solution provider som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad mjukvaruutveckling, systemdesign och datadrivna plattformar. title: Product Owner - AI & Test Engineering
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software. Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you. A stream in the making AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas:     AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc.     AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing. You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers. You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.Profile description:Your profile     You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.     You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work.     You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.     You enjoy working with a broad range of stakeholders and helping new ways of working spread across an organization.     It’s a plus if you have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development, AI in testing, test automation, CI/CD or simulation.     You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. As a person, you’re curious, structured, communicative and collaborative. You’re comfortable when not everything is decided yet, and you enjoy helping to create structure together with others. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and like to keep learning. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Senior System Architect
description: JobbeskrivningCompany Story Sigma Connectivity is a global tech house with all the resources needed to bring a product to market under one roof. We believe in investing in knowledge and education, making a positive impact on society and shaping a brighter future for all.Through our core values, at Sigma Connectivity we create an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Our company culture promotes the freedom to explore new ideas and push the boundaries of what is possible.Working with us means you will be working in an international environment with a diverse and inclusive atmosphere. We operate globally from 12 sites and have expert teams in North America, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, United Kingdom and Poland. We are looking for a Senior System Architect!In this role, you’ll translate client visions into robust blueprints for connected products, bridging hardware and software to define the project skeleton. As a part of the Industrialization & System Design team, you’ll own the end-to-end strategy for manufacturability, testability, and product launch—driving DFX (Design for Excellence, including DFM and DFT) directly into early PCB designs and defining test architectures from initial prototype validation through to mass production. What we offer    High-Impact Engineering: Own the technical vision for complex, market-defining products from concept to high-volume manufacturing.    World-Class Team & Culture: Work alongside elite cross-functional engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.    Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct access to diverse, challenging hardware and IoT projects for leading global brands.    Autonomy & Influence: High visibility and direct influence over architectural decisions, client strategies, and design-for-test practices.Work tasksThis role focuses on the early-stage design and technical leadership of industrialization projects, ensuring that hardware and software components are optimized for production and testing.    Architecture & Strategy: Lead system architecture definitions and create comprehensive production test strategies that balance quality, yield, schedule, and cost.    Requirements Breakdown: Convert product, hardware, and quality constraints into clear specifications, including System Requirement Specifications, Production Test Requirements, and Test Implementation Specs.    DFX & Risk Management: Review hardware schematics and PCB concepts early to identify manufacturability, testability, and reliability risks, driving proactive mitigations with R&D teams.    Test Architecture Definition: Define test coverage, interfaces, embedded test functionality, fixtures, measurement methods, and factory data traceability.    Cross-Functional & Client Leadership: Drive technical discussions and balance trade-offs with customers, EMS partners, suppliers, R&D, quality, and sourcing teams.    Mentorship: Guide engineering teams on best practices in systems engineering, hardware testability, and production deployment.We are looking for someone with    A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Engineering Physics, or equivalent practical background.    Proven experience working as a System Architect guiding complex electronic or embedded products from concept to production.    Proven background in production and manufacturing engineering, with strong practical experience bridging development and mass manufacturing environments.    Solid hardware depth to evaluate schematics, drive DFT/DFM improvements, and establish production test architectures alongside EMS partners.    Fluent English communication skills to present trade-offs, draft specifications, and align stakeholdersIt is meritorious if you have    Experience with connected/IoT devices, wireless protocols, or embedded systems.    Exposure to end-of-line testing, RF validation, JTAG, or factory yield optimization.    Track record supporting customer proposals, SOWs, or technical pre-studies.To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:    Supportive    Goal oriented    Social    Intellectually curious    Respectful ReferencesReference checks are conducted as part of the recruitment process and may include both provided and independently identified professional references.

title: Scientist
description: Are you passionate about protein analytics and scientific problem-solving? Would you like to contribute to the development of innovative injectable products in a global, science-driven organization? We are looking for a Scientist to join our Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry team within Injectables Development in Uppsala.In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of analytical methods that support the advancement of new products and technologies. Working in a collaborative and highly skilled environment, you will help generate the scientific insights that drive innovation and ensure product quality throughout development.This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organization where your expertise will contribute directly to the future of injectable aesthetics.Make your mark. Grow with us.  Your team Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry is part of Galderma's Injectables Development organization in Uppsala. The team provides analytical expertise that supports the development of innovative products and technologies, helping to strengthen and expand Galderma's portfolio.You will join a collaborative and highly engaged team where knowledge sharing, scientific curiosity, and mutual support are valued. Together, we work in a dynamic environment where quality, innovation, and patient focus guide everything we do. Your missionAs a Scientist within Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry, you will plan, perform, and interpret analytical studies supporting product and process development. You will contribute to solving complex analytical challenges related to proteins and biologics while ensuring that all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements.Working closely with colleagues across Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions, you will play an important role in advancing development projects from early-stage investigations through method validation and implementation.This role offers a broad range of scientific and technical challenges, providing opportunities to deepen your expertise while contributing to projects with real impact on Galderma's future portfolio. Key responsibilities· Develop, optimize, and validate analytical methods for proteins and related biological materials.· Plan, execute, analyze, and document experimental work.· Interpret analytical data and provide scientifically sound conclusions and recommendations.· Author protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.· Provide analytical expertise and support within cross-functional development projects.· Ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with GMP, internal procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements.· Support project teams by identifying scientific solutions to analytical challenges.· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory and analytical development processes. Your profile You are a curious and collaborative scientist who enjoys combining scientific expertise with practical problem-solving. You are motivated by understanding complex biological systems and translating analytical results into meaningful insights that support product development.You thrive in an environment where teamwork, scientific discussion, and continuous learning are valued. At the same time, you take ownership of your work, approach challenges with a structured mindset, and maintain a strong focus on quality and scientific integrity.You are comfortable working in project-based environments, communicating complex information clearly, and collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds. What you'll bringTo be successful in this role, you bring:· A university degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biology, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.· Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or broader life sciences industry.· Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, biochemistry, protein characterization, or related scientific fields.· Experience with analytical method development and validation.· Experience working in regulated environments and familiarity with GMP and associated quality requirements.· Experience interpreting regulatory guidelines, pharmacopeias, and scientific standards.· Fluency in both English and Swedish, written and spoken. Preferred qualifications Experience in any of the following areas would be considered an advantage:    Immunology and anti-drug antibody (ADA) testing.    Protein therapeutics, biologics, or biosimilar development.    Advanced protein characterization techniques.    Analytical support in cross-functional development projects.    Statistical evaluation of analytical data. Location and otherThis position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Please note that Galderma may conduct pre-employment background and security checks for certain positions. These checks are performed by an external provider and only with the candidate's consent. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

title: Laboratory Engineer

Would you like to join an international organization where innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work?We are looking for a Laboratory Engineer to join our Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry team within Injectables Development in Uppsala.In this role, you will help ensure that our laboratories operate safely, efficiently, and seamlessly, enabling our scientists to focus on developing the next generation of injectable aesthetic products. You will coordinate purchasing activities and support the maintenance, qualification, and lifecycle management of laboratory equipment and shared infrastructure, including refrigerators, freezers, safety cabinets, and other laboratory systems. Working closely with scientists, equipment owners, suppliers, Facilities, Quality, and external service providers, you will help ensure that equipment is available, compliant, and performing as intended.Depending on business needs and your experience, you may also contribute to the analytical testing of proteins and related materials using a range of analytical techniques.To thrive in this role, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating multiple activities, and finding practical solutions in a dynamic laboratory environment. You combine a proactive mindset with strong attention to detail and take pride in supporting scientific teams by ensuring laboratory operations run smoothly and efficiently. Key Responsibilities· Coordinate purchasing and procurement activities for the laboratory.· Support the maintenance, servicing, qualification, and lifecycle management of laboratory equipment and infrastructure.· Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure equipment reliability and availability.· Maintain documentation and records in accordance with regulatory and quality requirements.· Support laboratory operations by identifying opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and ways of working.· Contribute to maintaining a safe, compliant, and well-functioning laboratory environment.· Perform analytical testing of proteins and related materials when required.· Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable regulations, quality standards, and internal procedures. Your profile You are someone who enjoys building relationships, creating structure, and enabling others to do their best work. With a proactive and service-oriented approach, you take ownership of your responsibilities and are motivated by delivering high-quality support in a regulated laboratory environment.You thrive in collaborative settings and communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from scientists and support functions to suppliers and external service providers. You are organized, solution-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple priorities while maintaining a strong focus on quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.You are equally comfortable working independently and as part of a team and are recognized as a dependable colleague who follows through on commitments and contributes to a positive working environment. To be successful in this role, you bring    Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or broader life sciences industry.    Hands-on experience from laboratory environments, including laboratory operations, laboratory support, and/or equipment maintenance.    Experience working in a regulated environment, such as GMP, GLP, ISO-regulated, or other quality-controlled settings.    Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills.    Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken. Preferred QualificationsExperience in any of the following areas would be considered an advantage:    Analytical methods for proteins and biological materials.    Laboratory equipment lifecycle management, qualification, or maintenance activities.    Working with external suppliers and service providers.    Laboratory infrastructure and shared laboratory systems. title: Admissions coordinator to the Stockholm School of Economics
description: The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.We offer youA diverse role at one of the top business schools in Europe with ambitious students and staff in a dynamic, academic environment. This role is ideal for a highly organized, people-oriented person who enjoys complex processes.The roleWe are looking for Admissions coordinator for our BSc programs. The successful candidate will belong to a team of Admissions & Program management at Education Office, reporting to Group Manager of that team.Your tasks include, but are not limited to:    Coordinating application and admissions process for the BSc programs, ensuring an efficient, accurate and applicant-focused process.    Assessing applications, including eligibility, qualifications and supporting documentation, and participating actively in the selection of candidates.    Guiding prospective students and applicants regarding SSE, the BSc programs, admissions requirements and the application process.    Collaborating with faculty, and other internal and external stakeholders involved in admissions.    Contributing to recruitment and conversion activities for prospective and admitted students, including information sessions, events and other applicant-facing activities.    Supporting the Program Manager for the BSc in Business & Economics with diverse program-related tasks and activities, in accordance with the agreed division of responsibilities and based on the needs of the program.    Contributing to the continuous development of admissions processes, systems and ways of working, including the use of digital tools and AI where relevant.    Working in a dynamic organization where priorities, processes and responsibilities may evolve. You should therefore be comfortable adapting to change, taking on new tasks and contributing to developing new ways of working.    Occasional travel and participation in events outside regular office activities may occur.Your profileAs Admissions Coordinator, you will be coordinating admissions process and processing applications and enquiries, often within fixed deadlines. You therefore need to be structured, detail-oriented and comfortable taking responsibility for processes from start to finish. You are proactive, flexible and able to prioritize while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service.At the same time, admissions process is highly collaborative, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues, faculty and other stakeholders. The position involves contact with prospective students and applicants. You therefore have strong interpersonal and communication skills and can explain sometimes complex admissions requirements in a clear, professional and service-minded way. You are also comfortable handling challenging cases and communicating decisions consistently and respectfully. You are comfortable interpreting admissions requirements, assessing applicants and documentation against established criteria, and applying rules and procedures consistently.Qualifications:    An academic education    Experience of, or a strong understanding of, admissions processes within Swedish higher education.    Experience of working with Swedish and international high school qualifications    Swedish and English, both spoken and written.    An interest in how generative AI and digital tools can support efficient and high-quality admissions processes.Meritorious:    Previous experience working with admissions in Swedish higher education, particularly BSc admissions.    International experience or previous experience working in an international environment is an asset.    Good knowledge of Swedish higher-education admissions processes, eligibility requirements, merit rating and selection principles.    Experience assessing Swedish and international upper-secondary qualifications and supporting documentation.    Previous experience working in NyA and/or Ladok, or other systems used in higher-education admissions.    Previous experience working with CRM or application-management systems.OtherThis is a permanent position of 100% with an initial probationary period of six months. Start preferably in January or according to agreement. We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.Please be aware that we conduct background checks on final candidates for this position.About the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.What you’ll doYou will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.Beyond that, your work will include:    Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.    Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.    AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.What you bringA solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.You're comfortable with:    Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it    Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended    Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running    Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences    Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need toYou look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.Why Coretura?We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!Last application date: 4th of December 2026.Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.Please note we do not accept any applications via email.About our recruitment process  We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance.Read more →

title: MEP Manager
description: Key Requirements:    A third level qualification in a related field    5 years post qualification experience in a similar roleAs a member of the project management team, you have the opportunity to influence safety culture onsite by demonstrating personal commitment, setting clear expectations, and effectively communicating safety policies. By consistently modelling safe behaviour, prioritizing safety above productivity, and ensuring that all workers receive proper training and resources, you can foster an environment where safety is ingrained in every aspect of the construction process. Encouraging open communication, recognizing and rewarding safe behaviour, and conducting regular inspections further reinforce the importance of safety. By taking these steps, you can help create a culture where safety is a shared value and a top priority for all stakeholders involved in the project.Key Responsibilities:The Primary objective of the role is to provide MEPF support to Clients CM team, the GC team and the MEPF subcontractors on the client’s data centre builds. This involves interfacing with the GC/Client & MEPF Contractors / Clients CM / Clients DE / Clients Security / Client & MEP Consultants / Clients Cx / Local authorities and others as needed.Reporting to the MEP Operations Director your key responsibilities for the role will include but will not be limited to the following:    Foster a team approach to delivering your projects with your team.    Encourage your team to grow in their own roles and provide professional development where appropriate.    Review of IFC design for design issues / improvements and to determine where local alternatives with better lead times could be applied    Review incoming design change directives for impact to MEP works and establish if they can be implemented depending on site progress, and if they can be implemented determine a reasonable schedule impact    Work with the MEPF contractors and offer technical support on MEPF systems, clarify clients’ expectations and typical installation practices for client which may not necessarily be clarified on the IFC design    Review alternative technical proposals from the MEPF contractors to determine if proposal would be acceptable to client prior to formal submission where the contractor is required / chooses to deviate from the specification / design    Track and monitor MEPF shop drawings, RFI’s and technical submittals and push same through the approval process, offer technical support to the reviewers where required.    Attend and lead the project Lean Last Planning Session.    Assist the Planning Department with defining and tracking equipment delivery dates for both MEPF contractors and OFCI Vendors to maintain project schedule.    Provide the OFCI Vendors with an insight into MEPF programme in order to align the Clients works affecting the efficient MEPF progress.    Coordinate the sequence of MEPF works on behalf of the GC    Track, monitor and report on MEPF progress daily whilst monitoring manpower and equipment deployed across the sites    Review of progress against resources and forecast required resources to be deployed in order to meet / recover schedule    Offering MEPF contractors’ advice on long lead equipment handling, installation, and commissioning    Ensuring MEPF contractor provided equipment for installations and testing is secured well in advance    Review the quality of the MEPF installation whilst it is work in progress to minimize reworks    Advise MEPF contractors of client’s best practices and standards. Communicate clients’ expectations to the MEPF teams    Work with the MEPF contractors to close out comments and nonconformance reports    Review the MEPF contractors ITP’s, Inspection notices, pre-commissioning and commissioning plans and procedures with the aid of the commissioning manager    Provide guidance to the MEPF contractors on installation and coordination at site    Review and determine acceptable deviations from the design / shop drawings    Coordinate with the LLE vendors for equipment delivery, installation, testing and commissioning.    Review reported VS actual progress at site to verify contractor is on or behind schedule    Provide MEPF contractors with guidance on commissioning and oversee MEPF L1-L3 commissioning    Interface and support clients Cx team for L4-L5 commissioning    Management of MEPF contractors through to handover (TOC).    Review MEPF variations or change to scope and liaise with the commercial team for approval.    Identify potential risks and challenges related to MEP systems and develop mitigation strategies.    Implement and enforce quality control standards for MEP installations.    Develop and manage the project schedule for MEP installations, coordinating with other construction activities.    Facilitate effective communication between different project teams, subcontractors, and clients.    Facilitate the handover of MEP systems to the building owner or operator.    Lead by example and demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, and professionalism.    Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each MEP team member on the project.    Prioritize safety and enforce strict adherence to safety protocols.    Regularly walk the construction site to observe work progress and ensure tasks are being performed according to specifications.    Document changes to the project plan, as well as any issues that may impact the schedule or budget.Strong time management and communication skills are essential to this role as well as computer literacy and the ability to prepare reports and administer necessary paperwork.

description: HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.Our production site in Halmstad is one of our primary manufacturing hubs, delivering high-quality products to customers worldwide. We are now looking for a Production Operator to join our production team in PBCA manufacturing and help us manufacture electronic products with the right quality, quantity, and delivery performance.About the Role As a Production Operator in our machine hall, you will be part of our PCBA manufacturing process. Depending on your training and assignment, you will work with areas such as material preparation, machine setup and operation, inspection, soldering, and basic troubleshooting.Experience from electronics manufacturing is an advantage, but not a requirement. We will provide the training needed for your role.Key Responsibilities:    Produce PCBA according to the production plan, approved documentation, machine programs, and work instructions    Operate and monitor equipment in our SMT and/or THM production    Prepare materials, machines, and programs for production and product changeovers    Monitor production quality through processes such as SPI, AOI, reflow, soldering, and visual inspection    Identify deviations and perform basic troubleshooting within your training and authorization    Follow procedures for safety, ESD, traceability, quality, and material handling    Register production information and contribute to 5S and continuous improvement according to our Operational excellence program.About You We are looking for a responsible and quality-conscious team member who enjoys practical, technical work in a production environment.
