title: Post-doc position at the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness at SSE
description: About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research areaWellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.The roleThe postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. Your profileThe applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. Qualifications    PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.    A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals    Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs    Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python    Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network    Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular scienceMeritorious    Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text    Development of open research software or openly shared models    Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics How to apply: Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:     A curriculum vitae     A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).     Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)     Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts     Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.For further questions on the positions, please contact Assistant professor and Executive Director Fredrik Lange at fredrik.lange@hhs.seAbout the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Flödesledare - Power Pack, Surface Division
description: Company description:Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countriesJob description:Vill du leda människor, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa förutsättningar för en välfungerande produktion? Vi söker dig som motiveras av att skapa engagemang, utveckla människor och få team att lyckas tillsammans.  Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du. Bli en del av vårt team Vill du vara med och bygga upp något helt nytt från grunden? Vi tar nu hem monteringen av Power Pack och etablerar i samband med detta en helt ny avdelning med taktade produktionslinor. Därför söker vi en flödesledare som vill ta en nyckelroll i uppbyggnaden av den nya verksamheten. I rollen får du möjlighet att forma teamet, driva bemanningen och utveckla arbetssätt och produktionsflöden för att skapa en stabil och effektiv verksamhet från start. Du blir samtidigt en del av vår operativa ledningsgrupp tillsammans med tio andra flödesledare. Här får du ett nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och en viktig roll i att tillsammans skapa en säker, stabil och välfungerande produktion.  Ditt uppdrag Som flödesledare leder du den operativa verksamheten och har personalansvar för cirka 20-25 medarbetare på skiftet. Du arbetar tvärfunktionellt och har som uppdrag att leverera moduler i rätt tid och med rätt bemanning. Tillsammans med teamet säkerställer du att vi levererar produkter med hög kvalitet, i rätt tid och på ett säkert sätt. Rollen kombinerar operativt ledarskap med administrativa uppgifter och du tillbringar en stor del av din arbetstid ute i verksamheten. Du kommer bland annat att:     Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna.      Ansvara för medarbetarsamtal, kompetensutveckling och andra personalrelaterade processer.      Säkerställa att rätt kompetens och resurser finns på plats utifrån verksamhetens behov.      Hålla dagliga avstämningar och följa upp teamets mål och resultat.        Bidra till arbetsmiljö- och förbättringsarbetet, exempelvis genom att hålla skyddsronder samt uppföljningar kopplade till 5S.      Säkerställa en smidig överlämning mellan dag- och eftermiddagsskiftet.  Din profil  Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta nära verksamheten och motiveras av att skapa förutsättningar för andra att lyckas. Du kommunicerar tydligt, bygger förtroende genom närvaro och lyhördhet och skapar engagemang kring gemensamma mål. Du samarbetar väl med andra, bygger goda relationer och bidrar till en miljö där människor känner sig inkluderade, delaktiga och uppmuntras att utvecklas. Du känner dig trygg i att ta ansvar, göra prioriteringar och prova nya arbetssätt som bidrar till teamets och verksamhetens utveckling. Vi välkomnar olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder och värdesätter din vilja att leda, utveckla människor och bidra till verksamhetens framgång. Vi söker dig som      Har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom produktion.      Har ett intresse för att leda och utveckla människor.      Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.      Har god datorvana.      Erfarenhet från en ledande, samordnande eller coachande roll.      Erfarenhet av projektledning.      Erfarenhet av förbättrings- och förändringsarbete.  Placering och övrig information Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning placerad inom Surface Division, vid produktionsanläggningen i Norra bro, Örebro.  Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid, kl. 07:30 – 16:15. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.  Ansökan och kontaktinformation  Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 27/11- 2026. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. title: Spaceport Engineer  EGSE
description: Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace?  Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?    If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as EGSE (Electrical ground support equipment) Spaceport Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.   Help build the systems that make rocket launches possible! As a Spaceport Engineer – EGSE, you will design, build and maintain the electrical ground support equipment used in testing and launch operations. Combining hands-on work with system ownership, you will collaborate with operations teams, suppliers and customers to bring reliable data acquisition and control systems into use. JOB REQUIREMENTS     A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.     A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles, particularly low-voltage instrumentation and control circuits.     Experience programming or configuring PLC and HMI systems, and using electrical drawings to build or troubleshoot panels and wiring harnesses.     A practical approach to solving technical problems, with the ability to take initiative and work closely with others to keep projects moving. Desired We welcome different technical backgrounds. Experience in some of the following areas would be valuable, and you do not need to bring them all:     Data acquisition and control systems in aerospace, industrial facilities or similar environments.     Technical documentation such as P&IDs, wiring schematics, control descriptions and instrument lists.     Industrial networks, communication protocols and hardware interfaces, or National Instruments tools used with LabVIEW.     Safety requirements and hazard analysis for ground support equipment.     Supporting technicians or mentoring junior engineers. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES    Design and develop instrumentation, data acquisition, PLC and HMI systems, including the electrical drawings and documentation needed to build and maintain them.     Build, test, troubleshoot and commission equipment, including instrument calibration and configuration.     Coordinate installation from site surveys and supplier quotations through to commissioning, training and technical support.     Work with operations teams to deliver safe, reliable systems that meet project, regulatory and operational requirements.     Carry out system checkouts and support testing and launch campaigns, including launch-day operations.     Define requirements and coordinate the installation of supporting power and communications infrastructure.  JOB BENEFITSWe offer you       A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.      An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.      An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   Additional benefits  In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.       Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.      Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.       Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.      Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.      Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  LOCATIONThis is a full-time, permanent position based at our Space Center Esrange outside of Kiruna.  NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.  When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.   As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.   WE HEALP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACESSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.  With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.    We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Supply Chain Sales Support Manager
description: Do you enjoy creating clarity at the intersection of customers, Sales and Supply Chain? We’re looking for a Supply Chain Sales Support Manager to lead our global function and develop a proactive, structured and data-driven service that colleagues and customers can rely on. At Seco, collaboration, responsibility, curiosity and continuous improvement guide how we work and grow. Here, you get to:     Lead a global function at the heart of customer order flow.     Shape how Sales and Supply Chain work together through clear governance, service levels, KPIs and digital tools.     Join a collaborative environment where curiosity and continuous learning are valued.   About the job  You lead and develop the global Supply Chain Sales Support function, creating a standardized, customer-focused and efficient interface between Sales and our end-to-end supply chain. With a clear focus on governance and proactive support, you ensure that customer needs, order exceptions and supply constraints are translated into priorities and coordinated action. The function is in the middle of a shift: building on a strong foundation in case handling towards an end-to-end control and improvement capability. You lead that change, and you lead it through people. Developing your team’s skills, ownership and confidence is as much a part of the job as the processes and tools. Job responsibilities     Lead, coach and develop the Supply Chain Sales Support team: set clear roles and expectations, build capability in customer communication, supply chain understanding, problem-solving and case management, and grow people into broader ownership.     Lead the development towards proactive exception management, building on the team’s case-handling expertise, and make new ways of working stick in daily operations.     Establish and maintain global governance across the order-to-delivery flow, including ownership boundaries, decision rights and escalation paths.     Act as the primary supply chain interface for Sales and Customer Service regarding prioritized orders, supply exceptions and special customer requirements.     Develop the service model, including case categories, service levels, prioritization principles, escalation protocols and KPIs.     Use case data and performance insights to identify root causes and drive structural improvements with the responsible process owners.     Drive digitalization of case management, workflows, reporting and knowledge management, reducing repetitive demand through automation and self-service. Location and flexibility  The position is flexible is preferably based in Fagersta, Sweden, but another Seco location can be considered for the right candidate. We offer a hybrid working model that combines time at the office with remote work. Your profile   You have solid experience in supply chain, logistics, planning, order management or customer service operations. Having worked at the intersection of a commercial organization and operational supply chain functions, you’re comfortable creating structure across complex, cross-functional environments and using data to support decisions. You communicate fluently in English; Swedish is considered an advantage. Your background includes:      Experience establishing processes, ownership models, escalation paths or service frameworks across multiple functions.     Knowledge of customer-order exceptions, escalations and prioritization, preferably within a case-based way of working.     The ability to identify recurring operational issues, uncover root causes and turn insights into structural improvements.     Experience using CRM or case-management systems, ERP data, KPIs and reporting.     People leadership experience and a university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or equivalent experience. Customer focus and structure are central to your way of working. You simplify complex supply chain situations, create a shared understanding among commercial and operational colleagues and distinguish individual exceptions from structural problems. Calm and solution-focused, you challenge unnecessary manual work and fragmented processes while moving issues confidently towards resolution. The teamYou lead the global Supply Chain Sales Support team and work closely with Sales, Customer Service, Planning, Logistics, Production Units, Distribution Centres, IT and other operational functions. Together, you create globally consistent ways of working while accommodating relevant local requirements. Our Seco culture   At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.    Contact information   For further information about this position, please contact Christian Shafi, Global Logistics & Supply Chain Sales Support Manager +46 (0)70- 741 92 28 We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.   Union contacts – Sweden        David Romlin, Unionen, +46 (0)70-608 46 90      Jörgen Andersson, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)70-548 10 70     Benny Christiansen, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-523 50 60  Recruitment Specialist: Heidi Pynnönen     How to apply Send us your application no later than November 27th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099488.   We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test. For more information about our recruitment process, please contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

title: Production Support Technician – Automation
description: Aimpoint AB is the company that invented and developed the red dot sight, for which we are today the world-leading provider. Aimpoint sights are used in the civilian hunting and shooting markets, as well as by police and military forces. The company has over 570 employees and a turnover of approximately 2,3 billion SEK. Sales in the United States are managed through our American subsidiary, Aimpoint Inc.Our headquarters are located in Malmö, with production facilities in Malmö and Gällivare.Aimpoint is part of the Sandberg Development group. For more information about the company, please visit www.aimpoint.com/seProduction Support Technician – Automation Do you enjoy troubleshooting complex automation systems and solving technical challenges in a fast-paced production environment? At Aimpoint, you'll work with highly automated manufacturing equipment, advanced robotics, machine vision systems and modern production technology in an environment where continuous improvements and technical development are encouraged.We are looking for a Production Support Technician - Automation to join our Production Support team. In this role, you will be responsible for keeping our automated production lines running efficiently through troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, corrective actions, and continuous improvement. Working with robots, vision systems, PLC-controlled equipment, and advanced manufacturing technologies, you will play a vital role in supporting Aimpoint's continued growth and operational excellence.As our production capacity expands, you will also participate in the installation, commissioning, and optimization of new automated production lines and equipment.This position is permanently assigned to the night shift and includes an additional night shift allowance.In this role, you will:    Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in automated production equipment.    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.    Analyze recurring issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term improvements.    Support production with expertise in automation, robotics, electrical systems, and machine troubleshooting.    Participate in the installation, commissioning, and optimization of new production lines and equipment.    Document maintenance activities and improvement actions in the maintenance management system (Idus).    Repair, adjust, and optimize tools and production equipment.    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across production and maintenance.    Support training and knowledge sharing related to new equipment, processes, and working methods.Required Qualifications    Technical education within Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Maintenance, or equivalent experience.    Experience working with automated production equipment in a manufacturing environment.    Strong hands-on experience in troubleshooting electrical, mechanical and automated production equipment.    Familiarity with maintenance systems and technical documentation.    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.It is considered a strong advantage if you also have experience with:    ABB robots and robotic production equipment.    Cognex vision systems and machine vision technology.    Siemens PLCs and TIA Portal.    Pneumatic systems and industrial automation components.    Reading and troubleshooting electrical schematics.    LEAN manufacturing, TPM, and continuous improvement initiatives.    Root cause analysis and systematic problem-solving methodologies.To succeed in this role, you are analytical, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges independently. You enjoy working hands-on in a production environment and thrive when solving problems that have a direct impact on production performance.You see problems as challenges and work proactively to prevent production disruptions.You will join a skilled Production Support team working closely with Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering and Production Operations.The salary range for this position is SEK 38 000–45 000 depending on experience and qualifications.Why Aimpoint?We are driven by our core values: Performance, Innovation, and Commitment! - and we believe you are too!Just like us, you enjoy having fun at work and find interaction with others both challenging and rewarding. title: Development Team Lead- Team Notification & Communication
description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleThe RoleAs the Team Lead for Noco (Notification & Communication), you own two of the most trusted touchpoints in the traveler’s journey: the messages that keep customers informed, and the account experience that lets them manage their own journey. Every booking confirmation, schedule-change alert, receipt, and proactive notification a customer receives runs through your team’s systems — and so does the account functionality we’re actively building out to give travelers more control and visibility over their own data.You won’t just lead a team; you will be the bridge between Product, Platform, and the many domain teams who depend on reliable, well-governed communication and account infrastructure. Collaborate with your manager to make sure the team follows their agreed upon ways of working. You will lead a group of experienced engineers in maintaining a high-trust, high-reliability platform while helping shape where it goes next.Your ResponsibilitiesCoordinate Efforts: Keep the team aligned across two active fronts — communication infrastructure and the evolving Customer Account as well as future initiatives — ensuring both move forward smoothly without one starving the other of attention.Facilitate Communication: Serve as the bridge between your engineers and the stakeholders who depend on your systems, from Product Owners to stakeholders to the many domain teams whose customer-facing flows rely on your infrastructure.Technical Guidance: Drive the technical quality bar across both domains. Coordinate direction on complex technical issues with the help of the team.Team Empowerment: Empower your engineers to do their best work without micromanaging. Foster a culture of ownership for the health and performance of everything the team builds.Stakeholder Management: Keep everyone informed from your engineers to management, and communicate expectations as priorities shift.Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for the team’s output — staying hands-on enough to guide technical decisions credibly, participating in recruitment, and providing appraisal input to your manager.Requirements    6+ years of experience in Java development, with exposure to system design and architecture.    Proven leadership or mentorship experience in a technical role.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build bridges between technical and business teams.BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:    Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.    We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    We love gaming and after work activities.    We know the value of personal development and continuous training.    Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics. Subject description Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks. Project description RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects. Duties As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas: Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments a. Agentic planning and reasoning - Semantic mission planning using foundation models - Task decomposition based on foundation models - Event-driven task replanning b. Autonomous inspection planning - Uncertainty aware planning - Multi-agent systems for inspection planning Qualifications To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required. For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en. description: Join our Stockholm team as an on-call Sales Associate! A flexible contract that fits perfectly around studies or other commitments. Driven by curiosity, the brand has consistently connected its approach to the rhythm of what is happening in the wider world, looking to an ever-evolving contemporary society for both purpose and inspiration. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Fachperson IV-Rente 100 %--- Fachperson IV\-Rente 100 %==========================    **WAS** ist deine Zukunft?--------------------------Werde Teil unseres Teams alsFachperson IV\-Rente 100 %==========================Bist du eine empathische und lösungsorientierte Person mit Interesse an Sozialversicherungen, insbesondere der Invalidenversicherung? Wenn du zudem gerne liest und schreibst, interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit schätzt sowie gerne Entscheide fällst, dann freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung.### Deine Aufgaben* Du prüfst Anspruchsvoraussetzungen für eine Rente, bist zuständig für das Festlegen der Renten\-Leistungen gemäss IVG und erlässt Verfügungen.* Du triffst dabei interne und externe sowie medizinische und wirtschaftliche Abklärungen.* Du pflegst eine interprofessionelle, kooperative Zusammenarbeit mit den involvierten Personen.* Du führst örungen von versicherten Personen durch und erlässt Rentenverfügungen.* Du erteilst den versicherten Personen und unseren Anspruchsgruppen persönlich, telefonisch sowie schriftlich Auskünfte.### Deine Kompetenzen* Du verfügst über eine kaufmännische Ausbildung sowie eine Weiterbildung, vorzugsweise im Sozialversicherungsbereich.* Du hast Kenntnisse im Sozialversicherungswesen, insbesondere vertiefte Kenntnisse im Leistungsbereich der Invalidenversicherung oder einer anderen Sozialversicherung.* Du bist eine gefestigte Person, kannst dich gut abgrenzen und eine hohe Effizienz zeichnet dich aus.* Du verstehst es, komplexe versicherungsrechtliche Sachverhalte einfach und verständlich schriftlich auszuführen.* Du bist lösungsorientiert und triffst gerne Entscheidungen.### Dein neuer ArbeitgeberWirtschaft Arbeit Soziales ist das Luzerner Zentrum für Sozialversicherungen und den Arbeitsmarkt. Dazu zählt die IV Luzern. Diese engagiert sich für die Wiedereingliederung und die Ausrichtung von Leistungen an Menschen mit Beeinträchtigung.### Deine VorteileWir lernen und verbessern uns laufend. Deshalb fördern wir deine Weiterentwicklung und unterstützen dich bei internen sowie externen Aus\- und Weiterbildungen.Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind zentral gelegen und gut mit dem ÖV erreichbar.  Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeit\- und Teilzeitmodelle und ermöglichen mobil\-flexibles Arbeiten an unseren Standorten oder zu Hause.Es erwarten dich vielfältige, herausfordernde und sozial verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeiten mit Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Bei uns arbeitest du in einem agilen Umfeld mit Wertschätzung und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.Jetzt ganz einfach online den Bewerbungsprozess starten.    **Bei Fragen helfe ich dir gerne weiter:**    HR Manager \& Stv. title: Cloud Operations Lead
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Cloud Operations Lead--- Cloud Operations Lead=====================Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity. As we continue to grow our Platform team, we are looking for a**Cloud Operations Lead (80\-100%)**to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.We are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.Tasks-----**Your Mission**As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform \& Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.**What You Own in the First 12 Months*** **Availability and customer satisfaction.** You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.* **ISO 27001 and audit readiness.** Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit\-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.* **Team depth.** No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.**Responsibilities*** **Operations and multi\-hypervisor environment:** Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi\-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.* **Networking, storage and datacenter:** Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.* **Monitoring, incident response and recovery:** Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.* **Service desk and customer support:** Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.* **Team leadership:** Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on\-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.* **Automation and process:** Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Customer Service Key Account Manager --- Customer Service Key Account Manager ==================================== The \*\*Customer Service Key Account Manager\*\* is the face of Mikron for key customers, building strong and lasting relationships through regular interactions and excellent customer service. Through close collaboration with internal teams and Sales, the KAM contributes to customer loyalty, business development, and sustainable Customer Service growth. \*\*Key responsabilities\*\* \* Develop and maintain strong customer relationships through regular visits and proactive communication, promoting Customer Service products and solutions. \* Promote and coordinate Customer Service activities, including inspections, maintenance, repairs, production support, and equipment upgrades. \* Manage and follow up on customer inquiries, quotations, orders, and invoicing to ensure timely and efficient service. \* Act as the first point of contact in case of equipment breakdowns, initiating service requests and coordinating with the technical department. \* Coordinate on\\-site service activities in close collaboration with the Customer Service Technical Manager (CSTM). \* Conduct customer meetings and technical briefings in collaboration with Customer Service teams. \* Prepare, review, and discuss spare parts lists with customers to identify their needs and business opportunities. \* Ensure all activities comply with applicable Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards. \*\*Core Behavioral Competencies\*\* \* Technical proficiency \* Customer focused \\\& partnership \* Commitment \\\& loyalty \* Confidentiality \\\& discretion \* Goal achievement \*\*Functional Competencies\*\* \* Autonomy \* Accountability \* Problem\\-solving \* Product \\\& process optimization \* Communication \\\& feedback \*\*Leadership Competencies\*\* \* Strategic Mindset \*\*Profile\*\* \* Technical background in mechanical engineering, microtechnology, or a related field. \* Additional training in technical\\-commercial management is an asset. \* 3--5 years of professional experience, ideally in assembly systems or industrial automation. \* Solid experience in industrial mechanics and technical coordination; title: Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement --- Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement ================================================================== \*\*Depuis plus de 60 ans, la Fondation Claire Magnin prend soin de celles et ceux qui en ont besoin.\*\* Au sein de ses 7 établissements (EMS et EPSM), 400 collaboratrices et collaborateurs s'engagent chaque jour avec exigence et sincérité auprès de personnes en situation de vulnérabilité. Ici, on questionne, on expérimente et on ose faire évoluer les pratiques pour s'améliorer en permanence. Nous en sommes convaincu·es : les compétences sont essentielles, mais ce sont avant tout les personnalités et l'engagement qui font la différence. Rejoindre la Fondation Claire Magnin, c'est faire le choix d'un environnement où l'humain est réellement au centre, porté par une équipe soudée et souriante, dans l'une des plus belles régions de Suisse romande. Si cela résonne en vous, alors rencontrons\\-nous ! Une équipe de haut vol ! L'établissement des Hirondelles à Clarens réunit, sous un même toit, plusieurs approches complémentaires au service de ses 91 résidentes et résidents : santé mentale des seniors (SMS), psychiatrie de l'âge avancé (PAA) et Centre d'accueil temporaire (CAT). Ici, vous rejoignez une équipe interdisciplinaire soudée, où entraide et collaboration font réellement la différence au quotidien. \*\*C'est le moment de passer à un métier qui compte vraiment !\*\* Nous recherchons un·e \*\*Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement\*\* \*\*Activités administratives\*\* \* Vous assurez la gestion et la coordination des admissions des résidents en long séjour, court séjour et en centre d'accueil temporaire (CAT), en veillant au suivi administratif, à la coordination avec les différents intervenants et à la bonne préparation de l'accueil du résident. \* Vous assurez la réception, le tri, le traitement et la distribution du courrier interne et externe du département administratif et finances. \* Vous assurez, en collaboration avec les autres collaborateurs du département administratif et finances, la gestion de la centrale téléphonique du département. \*\*Activités support soins et accompagnement\*\* \* Vous évaluer les soins requis des résidents selon les critères OPAS et déterminez la classe de soins correspondante (1 à 12\\) à des fins de facturation. \* Vous évaluez les besoins d'aide et d'accompagnement du résident dans les actes ordinaires de la vie quotidienne, afin de déterminer son éventuelle éligibilité à une allocation pour impotent (API). \* Vous assurez le traitement, la saisie et le suivi des indicateurs de qualité médicaux (IQM) des résidents, conformément aux exigences fédérales en matière de qualité des soins en EMS. \* Vous assurez la gestion des remplacements du personnel absent, notamment par le recours à du personnel intérimaire, en fonction des besoins des services. \* Vous assurez le suivi de la consommation du matériel LiMA des résidents, en veillant au contrôle des quantités utilisées et au respect des modalités de prise en charge et de facturation. \*\*Votre profil :\*\* \*\*Ce poste est fait pour vous si :\*\* \* Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'infirmier·ère reconnu en Suisse. \* Vous bénéficiez idéalement d'une expérience dans le domaine médico\\-social, notamment en EMS. \* Vous êtes Évaluateur·trice PLEX / PLAISIR ou êtes disposé·e à vous former. \* Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels et idéalement l'outil de planification \<\< POLYPOINT PEP \>\>. \* Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et d'autonomie, tout en sachant gérer les priorités. \* Vous appréciez le travail en binôme, le partage des responsabilités et la collaboration avec différents professionnels. \* Vous possédez un excellent sens relationnel, de bonnes capacités d'analyse et savez faire preuve de flexibilité et d'adaptabilité. Au\\-delà du parcours, c'est aussi votre manière d'être qui fera la différence : \* Vous êtes organisé·e, à l'écoute et attentif·ve à ce qui se joue autour de vous. \* Vous avez le sens du collectif et aimez faire équipe \*\*Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?\*\* \* Une culture honnête et bienveillante \* Une place donnée à l'initiative et à l'audace \* Des équipes engagées, dynamiques et solidaires \* Une Fondation qui évolue et se remet en question \* Des prestations sociales selon la CCT SAN \* Des conditions de prévoyance supérieure au minimum légal \* Un encouragement actif à la formation continue \* Primes de fidélité \* Des places de parc gratuites et des tarifs préférentiels pour les repas \* Un rabais flotte pour l'achat d'un véhicule neuf \*\*Informations pratiques\*\* Lieu de travail : Résidence Les Hirondelles à Clarens Type de contrat : CDI Taux d'activité : 100% Entrée en fonction : dès le 1er janvier 2027 ou à convenir Délai de postulation : 12 décembre 2026 \*\*Envie de nouveauté ?\*\* Alors envoyez nous votre candidature \*(votre dossier doit contenir: une lettre de motivation, votre CV, vos diplômes, vos certificats de travail, copie de vos documents d'identité et l'extrait de votre casier judiciaire)\* \*\*Nous nous réjouissons d'en apprendre plus sur vous.\*\* !\[Fondation Claire Magnin\]( ) \* Fondation Claire Magnin Avenue Rousseau 19 1815 Clarens \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid67840d3jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

l'accueil des visiteurs avec comme responsabilité de coordonner les événements et gérer les groupes avec votre équipe. \*\*Vos tâches\*\* \* Accueillir, renseigner et orienter nos hôtes sur l'ensemble cœur de la nature et des montagnes. \* Un poste varié avec des responsabilités. \* Des projets qui évoluent au fil des saisons, été comme hiver. \* Une équipe dynamique, conviviale et passionnée. Intéressé·e ? Envoyez\\-nous votre CV, votre lettre de motivation et vos prétentions salariales par courriel. Discrétion garantie. !\[Centre Touristique Gruyères-Moléson-Vudalla \]( ) \* Centre Touristique Gruyères\\-Moléson\\-Vudalla Place de l'Aigle 6 1663 Moléson\\-sur\\-Gruyères \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid1bb6ac3jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Project Consultant - Bereich Einwohner 80-100% (m/w/d)--- Project Consultant \- Bereich Einwohner 80\-100% (m/w/d)========================================================*Die Swiss Post Digital Government AG unterstützt die öffentlichen Verwaltungen der Schweiz bei ihrer digitalen Transformation mit modernen, sicheren ERP\-Lösungen, die speziell auf die Bedürfnisse von Gemeinden und Kantonen zugeschnitten sind. Das Unternehmen, das aus dem Zusammenschluss national anerkannter Fachkompetenzen hervorgegangen ist, entwickelt innovative Tools, mit denen sich Verwaltungsprozesse durchgängig digitalisieren und vereinfachen lassen. Das Unternehmen ist in der \- und Deutschschweiz vertreten und setzt auf Nähe, Zuverlässigkeit und eine hochwertige Betreuung, um die öffentliche Verwaltung von morgen zu gestalten.* **Project Consultant \- Bereich Einwohner 80\-100% (m/w/d)**------------------------------------------------------------ Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Einführung und optimalen Nutzung unserer ERP\-Lösungen im Bereich Einwohnerkontrolle. Dabei übernimmst du die fachliche Umsetzung der dir zugewiesenen Aufgaben und arbeitest eng mit dem zuständigen Projektmanager sowie weiteren internen Fachstellen zusammen. So trägst du dazu bei, die Prozesse der Einwohnerkontrolle effizient und nachhaltig zu gestalten. **Dein Wirkungsfeld*** In den dir zugewiesenen Kundenprojekten übernimmst du die fachliche Einführung unserer ERP\-Applikationen und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem zuständigen Projektmanager sowie den beteiligten internen Fachstellen zusammen. Du rapportierst an den Teamlead Projects.* Du übernimmst die fachliche Umsetzung der dir zugewiesenen Arbeitspakete bei der Einführung unserer Applikationen im Bereich Einwohnerkontrolle.* Du planst und koordinierst deine eigenen fachlichen Aktivitäten in enger Abstimmung mit dem Projektmanager.* Du parametrierst die Applikationen, führst Kundenschulungen durch und wirkst fachlich bei der Projektabnahme mit, sowohl vor Ort bei unseren Kunden in der Deutschschweiz als auch remote.* Du berätst unsere Kunden in fachlichen Fragen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Verwaltungsprozesse optimal auf unsere Lösungen abzustimmen.* Du unterstützt das Verkaufsteam bei Präsentationen für potenzielle Kunden und wirkst unter anderem bei der Vorbereitung von Pflichtenheften im Rahmen von Ausschreibungen mit. **Dein Profil*** Du verfügst über mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung in einer Schweizer Gemeinde, insbesondere im Bereich Einwohnerkontrolle. Von grossem Vorteil sind praktische Kenntnisse unserer ERP\-Systeme Genowin NG und/oder Civetica.* Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke, kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit und hast Freude an der Beratung sowie an der Vermittlung von Wissen.* Du arbeitest selbstständig, sorgfältig und präzise, denkst vernetzt und bringst eine hohe Affinität zu Softwareapplikationen mit.* Von Vorteil bringst du Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Kundenprojekten als ERP\-Consultant mit. Ebenfalls geschätzt sind allgemeine Consulting\-Erfahrung oder Erfahrung als Fachspezialist in ERP\-Einführungsprojekten auf Kundenseite. Du verstehst die Bedeutung eines strukturierten Projektvorgehens.* Du bist bereit, regelmässig Kundeneinsätze in der Deutschschweiz wahrzunehmen.* Du bist neugierig und bereit, dich nebst dem Fachbereich Einwohnende auch in andere Fachbereiche einzuarbeiten.* Du beherrschst Deutsch auf Niveau C1 und Englisch auf Niveau B2, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. ösischkenntnisse (ab Niveau B1\) sind von Vorteil. **Deine Vorteile*** Hohe Eigenständigkeit: Du arbeitest innerhalb der vereinbarten Ziele selbständig und gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenverantwortlich* Gezielte fachliche Weiterbildungen, damit du dein Wissen laufend vertiefen und dich beruflich weiterentwickeln kannst* Kostenloser Parkplatz in Baldegg, Möglichkeit von Homeoffice und attraktive Sozialleistungen Willst du dich, dein Fachwissen und deine Erfahrung bei uns einbringen?Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung. ![Swiss Post Digital Government AG]()* Swiss Post Digital Government AG  Rue du Technopôle 1  3960 Sierre*jid659af68jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique
description: Ref 2590988 \\\| Date: 13 Nov 2026 !\[Etat de Fribourg\]( ) Vous aimeriez contribuer au développement du canton de Fribourg, avez l'esprit du service public, et cherchez un poste varié qui fait sens ? A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. A l'écoute, dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, l'administration cantonale, et ses établissements, sont au service de la population fribourgeoise. Collaborateur\\-trice scientifique \*\*Qui sommes\\-nous?\*\* Enseignement, recherche, emplois, événements: l'Université de Fribourg est un espace d'innovations et un moteur important pour la vie économique et culturelle de la région. Elle attire des étudiant\\-e\\-s et des chercheur\\-euse\\-s en provenance de toute la Suisse et du monde entier, elle marque le quotidien de la cité bilingue de Fribourg, depuis sa fondation en 1889\\. The Knowledge and Technology Transfer Service of the University of Fribourg supports researchers in industry collaborations, the protection and commercialization of research results, and the creation of spin\\-offs. \*\*Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?\*\* Nous misons sur la complémentarité des compétences et la variété des perspectives car c'est la diversité des parcours et des profils qui fait la force de l'Etat de Fribourg. Nous favorisons la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et les conditions de travail flexibles. Pour en savoir plus, suivez ce \[lien\](\< \>). \*\*Vos missions\*\* The position covers responsibilities currently associated with intellectual property and licensing, particularly for chemistry, physics and the humanities. \* Evaluate inventions for patent protection and commercialization \* Advise researchers on IP protection strategies \* Conduct prior\\-art searches and patentability analyses \* Assess novelty, inventive step and patentable subject matter \* Identify the essential technical features of inventions and contribute to initial patent claims \* Coordinate patent applications with researchers and external patent attorneys \* Identify licensing and valorization partners \* Negotiate and manage license, research and collaboration agreements \* Manage intellectual property and support early\\-stage spin\\-offs \* Provide guidance and training to researchers on IP, commercialization, and industry engagement. \* Build and maintain relationships with industry partners, innovation ecosystem stakeholders, and investors. \*\*What we offer\*\* A varied and international working environment at the intersection of science, intellectual property and business. Flexible working hours, possibility of remote work, continuing education and good work\\-life balance. Two\\-year fixed\\-term contract, renewable. \*\*Profil souhaité\*\* \* You have a PhD in natural sciences, engineering or related discipline, in\\-depth practical understanding of intellectual property, including prior\\-art searches and patentability analyses, drafting initial patent claims and further development in collaboration with patent attorneys \* Minimum 3\\-5 years of experience in technology evaluation, licensing and technology transfer in academia, industry, a startup company or a patent law firm \* You are proactive, analytical, independent and comfortable working with researchers, companies and legal specialists. Strong organizational and project management abilities are your strengths \* You have excellent communication stakeholder management skills and a professional command of English and either French or German \*\*Coordonnées des personnes de contact\*\* Dr. Valeria Mozzetti Rohrseitz Head of Knowledge and Technology Transfer \[Écrire un email\](\< \>) jpid9becad3jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

Swiss or EU qualification* Experience as a legal professional (lawyer, counsel, advisor or similar) in\-house, law firm, or consultancy* Relevant professional experience in IT related legal topics, privacy, digital law, AI governance is an advantage* Strong attention to detail and preference for an operational, process\-driven legal work.* Structured and solution\-oriented approach, legal pragmatism* stakeholder communication skills; description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer--- Field Application Engineer==========================**Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.**Your responsibilities*** Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.* Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.* Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.* Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.* Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.**Who we are looking for*** Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.* Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.* Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).* Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills* Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on* Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset* Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time**What we offer*** Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide* Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!* Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.* Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.* Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!* Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.* Company restaurant and other benefits **If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways,** because all competencies are valued! **Have we sparked your interest?** We look forward to getting to know you!Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams.Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.  *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment*. *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. title: Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement --- Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement ================================================================== \*\*Depuis plus de 60 ans, la Fondation Claire Magnin prend soin de celles et ceux qui en ont besoin.\*\* Au sein de ses 7 établissements (EMS et EPSM), 400 collaboratrices et collaborateurs s'engagent chaque jour avec exigence et sincérité auprès de personnes en situation de vulnérabilité. Ici, on questionne, on expérimente et on ose faire évoluer les pratiques pour s'améliorer en permanence. Nous en sommes convaincu·es : les compétences sont essentielles, mais ce sont avant tout les personnalités et l'engagement qui font la différence. Rejoindre la Fondation Claire Magnin, c'est faire le choix d'un environnement où l'humain est réellement au centre, porté par une équipe soudée et souriante, dans l'une des plus belles régions de Suisse romande. Si cela résonne en vous, alors rencontrons\\-nous ! Une équipe de haut vol ! L'établissement des Hirondelles à Clarens réunit, sous un même toit, plusieurs approches complémentaires au service de ses 91 résidentes et résidents : santé mentale des seniors (SMS), psychiatrie de l'âge avancé (PAA) et Centre d'accueil temporaire (CAT). Ici, vous rejoignez une équipe interdisciplinaire soudée, où entraide et collaboration font réellement la différence au quotidien. \*\*C'est le moment de passer à un métier qui compte vraiment !\*\* Nous recherchons un·e \*\*Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement\*\* \*\*Activités administratives\*\* \* Vous assurez la gestion et la coordination des admissions des résidents en long séjour, court séjour et en centre d'accueil temporaire (CAT), en veillant au suivi administratif, à la coordination avec les différents intervenants et à la bonne préparation de l'accueil du résident. \* Vous assurez la réception, le tri, le traitement et la distribution du courrier interne et externe du département administratif et finances. \* Vous assurez, en collaboration avec les autres collaborateurs du département administratif et finances, la gestion de la centrale téléphonique du département. \*\*Activités support soins et accompagnement\*\* \* Vous évaluer les soins requis des résidents selon les critères OPAS et déterminez la classe de soins correspondante (1 à 12\\) à des fins de facturation. \* Vous évaluez les besoins d'aide et d'accompagnement du résident dans les actes ordinaires de la vie quotidienne, afin de déterminer son éventuelle éligibilité à une allocation pour impotent (API). \* Vous assurez le traitement, la saisie et le suivi des indicateurs de qualité médicaux (IQM) des résidents, conformément aux exigences fédérales en matière de qualité des soins en EMS. \* Vous assurez la gestion des remplacements du personnel absent, notamment par le recours à du personnel intérimaire, en fonction des besoins des services. \* Vous assurez le suivi de la consommation du matériel LiMA des résidents, en veillant au contrôle des quantités utilisées et au respect des modalités de prise en charge et de facturation. \*\*Votre profil :\*\* \*\*Ce poste est fait pour vous si :\*\* \* Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'infirmier·ère reconnu en Suisse. \* Vous bénéficiez idéalement d'une expérience dans le domaine médico\\-social, notamment en EMS. \* Vous êtes Évaluateur·trice PLEX / PLAISIR ou êtes disposé·e à vous former. \* Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels et idéalement l'outil de planification \<\< POLYPOINT PEP \>\>. \* Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et d'autonomie, tout en sachant gérer les priorités. \* Vous appréciez le travail en binôme, le partage des responsabilités et la collaboration avec différents professionnels. \* Vous possédez un excellent sens relationnel, de bonnes capacités d'analyse et savez faire preuve de flexibilité et d'adaptabilité. Au\\-delà du parcours, c'est aussi votre manière d'être qui fera la différence : \* Vous êtes organisé·e, à l'écoute et attentif·ve à ce qui se joue autour de vous. \* Vous avez le sens du collectif et aimez faire équipe \*\*Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?\*\* \* Une culture honnête et bienveillante \* Une place donnée à l'initiative et à l'audace \* Des équipes engagées, dynamiques et solidaires \* Une Fondation qui évolue et se remet en question \* Des prestations sociales selon la CCT SAN \* Des conditions de prévoyance supérieure au minimum légal \* Un encouragement actif à la formation continue \* Primes de fidélité \* Des places de parc gratuites et des tarifs préférentiels pour les repas \* Un rabais flotte pour l'achat d'un véhicule neuf \*\*Informations pratiques\*\* Lieu de travail : Résidence Les Hirondelles à Clarens Type de contrat : CDI Taux d'activité : 100% Entrée en fonction : dès le 1er janvier 2027 ou à convenir Délai de postulation : 12 décembre 2026 \*\*Envie de nouveauté ?\*\* Alors envoyez nous votre candidature \*(votre dossier doit contenir: une lettre de motivation, votre CV, vos diplômes, vos certificats de travail, copie de vos documents d'identité et l'extrait de votre casier judiciaire)\* \*\*Nous nous réjouissons d'en apprendre plus sur vous.\*\* !\[Fondation Claire Magnin\]( ) \* Fondation Claire Magnin Avenue Rousseau 19 1815 Clarens \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid67840d3jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

Membre d'Interiman Group, ALBEDIS s'appuie sur l'expertise combinée de ses marques partenaires pour couvrir des domaines tels que l'architecture et l'immobilier, la finance, l'IT, les sciences de la vie, le juridique ou encore les ressources humaines, avec une présence dans toute la Suisse (Berne, Genève, Lausanne, Zurich).Assistant to Sales Directors============================Description de l'entreprise---------------------------**Assistant to Sales Directors \- 100%**----------------------------------------Notre client est une **entreprise industrielle lausannoise, leader dans son domaine**, reconnue pour son savoir\-faire, la qualité de ses produits et son environnement international. title: Head of Infrastructures
description: Ref 2591052 \\\| Date: 13 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Head of Infrastructures \*\*Mission\*\* Under the responsibility of the Dean of the School of Engineering (STI), you will be responsible for managing and coordinating the infrastructure activities of the faculty across its different sites. You will ensure the smooth operation of STI infrastructure and associated services, coordinate renovation and laboratory installation projects, manage space allocation, and act as the main interface between STI research units, EPFL central services, and external partners. You will lead the STI Infrastructure unit (STI\\-IN), supervise its activities, and provide practical solutions to technical and operational challenges in a dynamic academic and research environment. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* 1. \*\*Infrastructure Management and Coordination\*\* \* Oversee STI's daily infrastructure operations, including laboratories, shared facilities, scientific equipment logistics, and associated services. \* Act as the main contact for STI research units, coordinating infrastructure needs and technical solutions with EPFL central services and external partners. 1. \*\*Renovation and Infrastructure Projects\*\* \* Manage laboratory renovations, modifications, and installations, from needs assessment to completion, ensuring compliance with budgets and deadlines. \* Coordinate infrastructure requirements for new professors, research groups, and shared scientific facilities. 1. \*\*Space Management and Logistics\*\* \* Oversee space allocation, lead the STI Space Committee, and ensure implementation of its decisions. \* Coordinate laboratory relocations, reorganizations, closures, and scientific equipment transfers. 1. \*\*Technical and Operational Support\*\* \* Assess technical issues and coordinate interventions, maintenance, and infrastructure improvements with EPFL technical services. \* Ensure effective resolution of operational issues and appropriate support to STI laboratories. 1. \*\*Team Management and Institutional Support\*\* \* Lead the STI\\-IN team, coordinate operational priorities, and manage the unit's operating budget. \* Represent STI in infrastructure\\-related committees and support the Dean in institutional initiatives. \*The position description is not exhaustive and may evolve according to institutional needs.\* \*\*Profile\*\* \* Technical diploma (Technicien ES), engineering degree (Ingénieur HES), or equivalent education and experience in building technology, construction, or infrastructure management. \* Proven professional experience in building infrastructure management, renovation works, or technical project coordination. \* Good practical understanding of building systems and technical installations; experience with research laboratories is a strong asset. \* Experience in managing technical projects and coordinating multidisciplinary teams and service providers. \* Ability to assess technical needs, identify constraints, and propose practical and effective solutions. \* Strong organizational skills, autonomy, and ability to manage multiple projects and operational requests simultaneously. \* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proactive, pragmatic, and service\\-oriented approach. \* Proficiency with standard IT tools; knowledge of CAD software is an asset. \* Fluent in both French and English. \*\*We offer\*\* At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well\\-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year. \[Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits\](\< \> " ") \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : Activity Rate : Contract Type: CDI Reference: 2603 jpid1df94eejm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm
