title: Portfolio Manager
employer: Brevan Howard Investment Products Limited, Saint-Hélier (Jersey), succursale de Genève
description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.Investment ManagementGenerate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre-agreed trading mandate.Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance-sheet-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.Take hands-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.Risk ManagementOperate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.Improve and scale risk-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.Performance, Monitoring and ReportingMonitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.Contribution to the Fund and the FirmContribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.Governance, Compliance and ConductOperate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification the role requires in the relevant jurisdiction (for example the FCA Certification Regime in the UK); and act with integrity at all times. WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:EssentialA minimum of 7–10 years’ experience in a principal risk-taking capacity, as a trader at a sell-side institution and/or as a Portfolio Manager, Sub-Portfolio Manager or Pod Portfolio Manager at a hedge fund or asset manager, trading global macro markets.A minimum of 3 years’ attributable, verifiable track record of managing risk capital, evidenced through audited or employer-confirmed P&L and risk reports, with the candidate’s own contribution clearly separable from that of any wider team.P&L of a scale that justifies a substantial allocation of institutional capital, together with evidence of having run a large book and of the ability to scale risk as capital grows.A high quality of returns, assessed through information ratio, maximum drawdown and recovery, hit rate and consistency across market regimes, with limited reliance on a small number of outsized trades. Returns generated through excessive leverage, concentration or tail-risk selling are not regarded as evidence of skill.Experience of running directional macro risk through periods of market stress and drawdown within a formal institutional risk framework, and of operating comfortably at the scale and volatility of a flagship global macro fund.A clearly articulated, proven and repeatable investment process that can be explained from first principles: the source of edge, how ideas are generated, how positions are sized and risk-managed, and how the process has adapted to changing market conditions.A strategy and return stream that would be diversifying within a global macro portfolio. DesirableExperience as a lead Portfolio Manager at a global macro hedge fund with a multi-asset mandate spanning developed and emerging markets.Experience of managing balance-sheet-intensive strategies and large gross exposures, including funding, repo and collateral management.Experience of building and leading a team of analysts, traders or sub-portfolio managers.Experience of expressing macro views across more than one asset class, for example rates and FX together with inflation, volatility, equity indices, credit or commodities.A postgraduate qualification (Master’s, PhD or MBA) and/or a relevant professional designation such as the CFA or FRM. TECHNICAL/BUSINESS SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:EssentialExpert understanding of the pricing, mechanics, risk characteristics and regulatory treatment of global rates, FX, inflation and volatility instruments: government bonds, interest rate and cross-currency swaps, futures, options and swaptions, other OTC derivatives and financing instruments.A sophisticated understanding of global macroeconomics, monetary and fiscal policy, central bank reaction functions and their transmission into financial markets.Fluency in portfolio risk measures (VaR, expected shortfall, stress and scenario analysis, DV01, Greeks, factor exposures, liquidity and correlation risk) and in interpreting and challenging risk system output.Strong quantitative skills, including statistics, time-series analysis and derivatives pricing; technical data analysis skills, with Python or a comparable language and Bloomberg proficiency expected.Detailed knowledge of market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, execution venues and transaction cost management in the relevant markets.Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle, operational controls, counterparty and collateral arrangements, and the regulatory environment governing trading in the relevant jurisdictions.The ability to articulate complex investment views, risks and performance clearly and concisely to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and peers, verbally and in writing.Judgement under uncertainty, intellectual honesty, discipline under pressure and resilience through drawdowns; self-motivated and accountable, and able to operate in a collaborative organisation with unimpeachable integrity.A strong undergraduate degree from a respected academic institution in a rigorous discipline such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or computer science.DesirableExperience of building proprietary models, datasets and analytical tools, or of running a systematic overlay to a discretionary process.Established relationships with sell-side counterparties, brokers and liquidity providers

title: Treasurer EME and Life (100%)
description: Interested in a senior leadership role working in a stimulating and challenging environment? Group Treasury & Capital Management within Group Finance is seeking an experienced finance leader to serve as Treasurer for our EME and Life businesses. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence some of the most important financial decisions across Zurich’s EME and Life businesses. Working directly with senior business and finance leaders, you will help shape capital allocation, balance sheet strategy and shareholder value creation across a broad international portfolio. Operating at the intersection of strategy, finance and capital and liquidity management, this is a highly visible role with significant influence across multiple businesses and jurisdictions. You will bring a deep understanding of insurance balance sheets, strong commercial judgement, and the ability to influence decisions across multiple legal entities and stakeholder groups.If you are an experienced insurance finance professional with capital management and balance sheet management skills, this job may be for you.What you will do:Serve as the primary Treasury and Capital Management partner to the EME and Life businesses, working closely with business CFOs and finance leaders to support strategic decision making and execution.Support business planning and strategic initiatives by ensuring capital, liquidity and balance sheet implications are appropriately reflected in decision making.Identify opportunities to improve capital efficiency, optimise liquidity positions and enhance returns on deployed capital across the EME and Life portfolio.Build a clear and comprehensive picture of each of the balance sheets in terms of regulatory capital requirements, liquidity, financial risk, leverage, return on capital and legal entity structure and identify opportunities to enhance balance sheet efficiency.Provide insight and challenge on matters relating to capital allocation and ensure the efficient deployment of capital across EME and Life balance sheets, balancing growth opportunities, risk appetite, and shareholder returns.Oversee capital and liquidity management activities across the portfolio of entities and ensure businesses remain appropriately capitalised and liquid under both business as usual and stressed conditions, whilst maximising dividends and other liquidity repatriations, where appropriate.Work closely with relevant balance sheet CFOs to identify and resolve all issues relating to Treasury and Capital Management and to ensure that relevant information and issues are escalated at local, regional and Group levels as appropriate.Monitor industry and marketplace developments, including regulatory developments and promote a market-leading approach to capital and liquidity management within EME and Life.Lead and develop a team of Treasury professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.Build strong relationships across Group, regional, and local teams.What you bring:Significant experience within insurance finance, treasury, capital management, corporate finance or related disciplines.Strong understanding of insurance balance sheets and value drivers.Experience working with insurance regulatory capital frameworks and capital management processes.Commercially minded with strong strategic judgements.Strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills.Solution-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment.Able to challenge constructively and influence without using formal authorityYou belong here. Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.  You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple. Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together. About Us Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. We look forward to receiving your online application today!Information for recruitment agenciesZurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees. Why ZurichAt Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right? We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great! Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Sachbearbeiter:in Front Office Leistungen Ambulant--- Sachbearbeiter:in Front Office Leistungen Ambulant==================================================80\-100%, Winterthur / Smart Working**Gestalte deine Zukunft \- gemeinsam mit uns!**Du hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt, denkst lösungsorientiert und möchtest in einem der dynamischsten Geschäftsfelder der AXA Schweiz mitgestalten? Dann bist du in unserem Team Gesundheitsvorsorge genau richtig.Seit 2017 zählt die AXA\-Gesundheitsvorsorge zu den am stärksten wachsenden Bereichen der AXA Schweiz \- heute betreuen wir über 200'000 Kundinnen und Kunden mit Kranken\-Zusatzversicherungen und innovativen Services wie unserem Wechsel\- und Rechnungsservice. Wir übernehmen den administrativen Aufwand, damit unsere Kundschaft Zeit und Geld spart.Bei der Gesundheitsvorsorge arbeitest du im Bereich Vorsorge der AXA Schweiz. Mit unseren vielfältigen und fortschrittlichen Produkten schaffen wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden Freiräume und Sicherheit, damit sie ihr Leben unbeschwert gestalten können.Die AXA ist die **Vorsorgepartnerin** Nr. 1 in der Schweiz. Mit unseren vielfältigen und fortschrittlichen Produkten in den Bereichen Gesundheit sowie private und berufliche Vorsorge schaffen wir Freiräume und Sicherheit für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, damit sie ihr Leben unbeschwert gestalten können.**Das erwartet dich*** Du bist erste Anlaufstelle für Versicherte, Leistungserbringer und weitere Anspruchsgruppen \- telefonisch, schriftlich und über digitale Kanäle wie Kundenportal und myAXA App* Du sorgst für eine kompetente, lösungsorientierte Betreuung und eine erstklassige Customer Experience* Du nutzt moderne, KI\-gestützte Tools zur effizienten Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere digitalen Services weiterzuentwickeln* Du koordinierst Anliegen eigenständig und leitest sie zielgerichtet an die zuständigen Fachbereiche weiter* Du arbeitest eng mit dem Office und weiteren Schnittstellen zusammen und förderst eine reibungslose, abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit* Bei entsprechender Eignung bringst du dich in bereichsübergreifende Projekte ein**Das bringst du mit*** Kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Erfahrung im Krankenversicherungsumfeld und/oder medizinische Grundausbildung (z. B. Pharmaassistent:in, Drogist:in, MPA, FaGe, Pflegefachperson)* Freude am Umgang mit digitalen Tools und Offenheit für neue, KI\-gestützte Arbeitsweisen* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an anspruchsvollen Kundengesprächen* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; **eine zweite Landessprache ( ösisch oder Italienisch) ist zwingend erforderlich**, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil**Das bieten wir dir**Wir sind überzeugt: Zufriedene Mitarbeitende bringen die besten Leistungen. Deshalb investieren wir in Benefits, die spürbare Vorteile bieten \- über das Übliche hinaus.**Flexibilität und Freiraum:** Smart Working (flexibles Arbeitsmodell) Jahresarbeitszeit, 5 Wochen Ferien (ab 50 Jahren 6 Wochen), Feriengeschenk 2 Wochen alle 5 Jahre, Ferienkauf bis zu 10 zusätzliche Tage/pro Jahr **und Familie:** Familienfreundliche Meetingzeiten, 22 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub, 8 Wochen Urlaub für den anderen Elternteil, Kinderkrippensubventionen, Betriebliche Familienzulagen, freie Tage für Betreuung von Angehörigen und in herausfordernden, persönlichen Situationen**Vorsorge und Versicherungen:** Attraktive Pensionskasse mit weitreichenden überobligatorischen Leistungen inklusive Wahlsparoptionen, bis zu 30% Rabatt auf Versicherungsprodukte**Flexible Benefits:** AXA Shareplan (Mitarbeiterbeteiligung), CHF 500 jährlich auf der Vorteilsplattform Swibeco, vergünstigte Mittagsverpflegung oder Lunch\-Card, Smart Working\-Pauschale CHF 200 pro Jahr**Mobilität:** Rückvergütung fürs Halbtax, \-Pay bis CHF 1'000 pro Jahr (20% Rabatt), Flottenrabatt, kostenlose E\-Ladestation, AXA Leihfahrräder**Gesunde Balance im Arbeitsalltag:** Kostenlose Check\-Ups, jährliche Gesundheitswochen, vielfältige Bewegungsangebote (online/offline), Massageangebote, Ruheräume, Employee Care, Online\-Gesundheitsportal, diverse Seminare/Events rund um Gesundheitsprävention \& Mental Health**Entwicklung:** 3 Tage individuelle Lernzeit, kostenlose Coachings, grosses Angebot an Lern\- \& Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, finanzielle Beteiligung an Weiterbildungen, Förderung der Internen Mobilität, Talent\-Entwicklungsangebote, Seminare für Mitarbeitende 55\+ (AXA Horizon), Engagement in Communities zu unterschiedlichen Themen, Teilnahme an Innovationsprojekten (Innoday, AXA Hackathon, UnConference), 2 Tage Zeit für Freiwilligeneinsätze (Umwelt \& Soziales)**Dein zukünftiger Arbeitsort****Bewirb dich jetzt!**Hast du Fragen oder weitere Anliegen? , Carbognin ist gerne per Email () für dich da.Mehr Infos zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du .**Vielfalt und Inklusion liegen uns bei der AXA am Herzen**Offenheit, Respekt und Wertschätzung von Unterschieden und Gemeinsamkeiten sind wesentliche Merkmale der Zusammenarbeit bei der AXA Schweiz. Wir möchten Chancengerechtigkeit fördern und auch im Bewerbungsprozess Barrieren abbauen.Wenn du aufgrund von Behinderungen, Neurodivergenzen und/oder gesundheitlichen Einschränkungen Unterstützung oder individuelle Anpassungen benötigst, kannst du dich jederzeit an das Recruiting\-Team unter wenden.**Über die AXA**Bei der AXA glauben wir daran, dass jeder Mensch das Potenzial hat, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten. Unser Ziel ist es, ein dynamisches, unterstützendes und fortschrittliches Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das dich inspiriert, ermutigt und fördert. Mit einer Kultur, die geprägt ist von Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, Vertrauen und Vielfalt. Mit unseren modernen Arbeitsbedingungen möchten wir die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeitenden berücksichtigen und dir den Raum geben, deine Stärken zu entfalten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich im Team für neue Ideen zu engagieren. So kannst du dich persönlich weiterentwickeln und mit uns die Welt von morgen gestalten \- indem wir schützen, was wirklich wichtig ist.Du möchtest noch mehr über die AXA als Arbeitgeberin erfahren und tiefer in unsere Arbeitswelt eintauchen? Dann bist du auf unserer genau richtig!**Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!**Aus administrativen sowie datenschutztechnischen Gründen werden ausschliesslich vollständige Bewerbungsdossiers (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Zertifikate etc.) berücksichtigt, welche über den Online\-Bewerbungslink hochgeladen werden.Für diese Stelle können wir keine Bewerbungen über Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.![AXA Versicherungen AG]()* AXA Versicherungen AG  Chemin de Primerose 11  1007 Lausanne*jid7fe306fjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: (Exklusiv) Senior Pflegeexperte - Fachentwicklung, Schulung, QM / Fest---(Exklusiv) Senior Pflegeexperte \- Fachentwicklung, Schulung, QM / Fest=======================================================================### EinleitungIm direkten Auftrag unserer Mandantin, einer sympathischen, renommierten und stark wachsenden Spitex\-Organisation (PA\-Modell) mit sympathischer Firmenkultur, suchen wir für den Ausbau des Teams in Zürich (zentrale , Parkplätze vorhanden) eine erfahrene Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/BSc Pflege als Sr. Pflegeexperte/in (80\-100%).### der ArbeitIn dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion gestalten Sie die fachliche Entwicklung der Organisation aktiv mit. Sie konzipieren, organisieren und leiten interne Fachschulungen, Workshops und Weiterbildungen für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen und entwickeln praxisnahe Schulungskonzepte zu Themen wie InterRAI\-HC, Pflegeplanung, Pflegedokumentation sowie KLV\- und WZW\-Kriterien. Als kompetente Fachperson begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende im Rahmen von Coachings, Fallbesprechungen und Praxisbegleitungen und unterstützen bei komplexen Pflegesituationen (ohne eigene Pflegetätigkeit). Zudem wirken Sie bei der Entwicklung von Schulungsunterlagen, Praxisleitfäden und pflegerischen Standards mit. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit liegt im Qualitätsmanagement und Pflegecontrolling. Sie analysieren Pflegedossiers, identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale und stellen eine fachgerechte Bedarfsabklärung, Pflegeplanung und Dokumentation sicher. Gemeinsam mit der Pflegedienstleitung und weiteren Fachstellen fördern Sie eine einheitliche, evidenzbasierte Pflegepraxis und unterstützen die Umsetzung von Qualitätsmassnahmen sowie internen Audits.  Unsere Mandantin bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Fachfunktion mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum zu übernehmen und den Aufbau eines nachhaltigen Schulungs\- und Fachentwicklungskonzeptes aktiv mitzugestalten. Sie dürfen sich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, moderne Strukturen, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen sowie langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb einer erfolgreichen und wachsenden Organisation freuen.### AnforderungsprofilFür diese spannende Herausforderung verfügen Sie über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (BSc Pflege etc.). Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der ambulanten Pflege, idealerweise im Spitex\-Umfeld (ev. mit PA\-Modell), mit und verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in InterRAI\-HC, Pflegeplanung, Pflegedokumentation sowie den gesetzlichen Anforderungen im Bereich KLV und WZW. Idealerweise konnten Sie zudem bereits Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung, Fachentwicklung oder der Durchführung von Schulungen sammeln. Eine pädagogische Weiterbildung (z.B. SVEB, Berufsbildner/in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation) ist von Vorteil. Sie überzeugen durch Ihre ausgeprägten didaktischen, organisatorischen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten und verstehen es, Mitarbeitende zu fördern sowie nachhaltige Verbesserungen anzustossen.  Sind Sie auf der Suche nach einer vielseitigen Pflegeexperten\-Funktion in der Fachentwicklung, Schulung sowie QM mit viel Gestaltungsfreiheit und Entwicklungspotenzial? title: Peer Mitarbeiterin / Peer Mitarbeiter
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Mitarbeiterin / Mitarbeiter (EX-IN)---Mitarbeiterin / Mitarbeiter (EX\-IN)====================================Die Clienia\-Gruppe gehört zu den grössten privaten Anbieterinnen psychiatrischer Dienstleistungen in der Schweiz. Mit über 20 Standorten – darunter die Privatkliniken Clienia Littenheid und Clienia Schlössli sowie das gerontopsychiatrische Angebot der Clienia Bergheim – bietet sie ein vielfältiges Spektrum an psychiatrischen und psychotherapeutischen Behandlungsmethoden im ambulanten, tagesklinischen und stationären Rahmen an. Die Gruppe beschäftigt rund 1800 Mitarbeitende und erzielte 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 240 .  Für unsere zertifizierte Station A2 für Stressfolgeerkrankungen und Emotionsregulation mit Behandlungsschwerpunkt DBT suchen wir per 1\. März 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/nMitarbeiterin / Mitarbeiter (EX\-IN)====================================20%===Station A2 für Psychotherapie mit Behandlungsschwerpunkt Emotionsregulation (DBT)Die Station A2 ist spezialisiert auf Stressfolgeerkrankungen. Ziel der Behandlung ist eine funktionale Emotionsregulation, damit die Patienten ihre vielfältigen Symptome wie Selbstverletzungen, impulsives Verhalten sowie emotionale Instabilität reduzieren können. Die Behandlung richtet sich ganz nach dem Konzept der DBT (Dialektisch Behaviorale Therapie, nach M. Linehan), umfasst aber auch Interventionen der Schematherapie, Ergo\- und Bewegungstherapie, neuropsychologisches Training sowie komplementärmedizinische Angebote wie Phytotherapie, Akupunktur und Aromapflege.  Die Atmosphäre auf der Station wird durch eine respektvolle Grundhaltung und der sorgfältigen Pflege zwischenmenschlicher Beziehungen geprägt.### Ihre Aufgaben* Begleitung von Patienten auf ihrem Genesungsweg im Rahmen von Einzelgesprächen und im Stationsalltag  * Einbringen der Perspektive von Erfahrung mit psychischer Erkrankung und Genesung in behandlungsrelevante Bereiche  * Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kernteam  * Durchführung eines peergeleiteten Gruppenangebotes zur Unterstützung des persönlichen Recover\-Prozesses der Betroffenen  * Unterstützung und Vernetzung zu Nachsorge\-Angeboten, z.B. Selbsthilfegruppen  * Teilnahme an Intervisionen sowie an der Fachgruppe und Recovery  ### Ihr Profil* Du bringst eine hohe fachliche und persönliche Kompetenz als Expertin oder Experte aus Erfahrung mit und warst idealerweise bereits als im stationären Setting tätig  * Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene \-Weiterbildung (EX\-IN)  * Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, eine Weiterbildung in DBT (Dialektisch Behaviorale Therapie, nach M. Linehan) zu absolvieren  * Du hast ein erweitertes Verständnis der eigenen Genesungsgeschichte und kannst differenziert darüber sprechen  * Du kannst Übersetzer/\-in und Vermittler/\-in für die Patienten (z.B. Beantwortung von Fragen zu Krankheitsbildern) sein  * Du kannst empathisch und unvoreingenommen auf andere Menschen zugehen  * Du verfügst über eine hohe Teamfähigkeit  * Du verfügst über die Fähigkeit zu selbst organisiertem, eigenständigem Arbeiten  ### Unser AngebotNebst einem spannenden Arbeitsbereich bieten wir dir eine gute Einführung auf der Station, ein vielseitiges Weiterbildungsangebot sowie attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen in einer modernen Klinik.Fühlst du dich angesprochen?  Weitere Auskünfte erteilt dir gerne Leyendecker, Stationsleiterin, Tel. oder , Bereichsleiterin Pflege, Tel. .  Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung via Bewerbungstool.### Arbeitsort **Clienia Schlössli AG  Privatklinik für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie**  Schlösslistrasse 8  CH\-8618 Oetwil am See  Tel.  ### Ihre Kontaktperson  Bereichsleiterin Pflege  Tel.******jidc2fe1cajm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Manager Klientenbetreuung Spitex 80-100% / Fest
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: (Exklusiv) Manager Klientenbetreuung Spitex 80-100% / Fest---(Exklusiv) Manager Klientenbetreuung Spitex 80\-100% / Fest===========================================================### EinleitungIm exklusiven Auftrag unserer Mandantin, einer renommierten und stark wachsenden Spitex\-Organisation mit einer sympathischen Firmenkultur und einem innovativen Betreuungsmodell für pflegende Angehörige, suchen wir zur Verstärkung des Teams eine erfahrene, kommunikative und dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit für die anspruchsvolle Kundenbetreuung.### der ArbeitIn dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson für Klienten und deren Angehörige bei anspruchsvollen Anliegen und individuellen Fragestellungen. Sie beraten und begleiten die Klienten rund um die angebotenen Spitex\-Dienstleistungen und erarbeiten gemeinsam mit den involvierten Stellen kundenorientierte Lösungen. Dabei stehen Sie in engem Austausch mit den Pflegefachpersonen, internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Ansprechpartnern und sorgen für eine professionelle und verbindliche Kommunikation. Darüber hinaus erkennen Sie Optimierungspotenziale und wirken bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Abläufe und Qualitätsstandards mit. Mit Ihrem ausgeprägten Dienstleistungsverständnis leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Klientenzufriedenheit und Betreuungsqualität.  Unsere Mandantin bietet Ihnen eine abwechslungsreiche, sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen, wachsenden Unternehmen. Sie profitieren von einer kollegialen Unternehmenskultur, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen und langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.### AnforderungsprofilUm in dieser spannenden Funktion erfolgreich zu sein, verfügen Sie über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische, pflegerische oder vergleichbare Ausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung im Kundenservice, in der Kommunikation oder im Qualitätsmanagement. Zudem bringen Sie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der anspruchsvollen Kundenbetreuung oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit. Erfahrungen im Gesundheitswesen, insbesondere im Spitex\-Bereich, sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.  Sie haben Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, verfügen über ausgeprägtes Einfühlungsvermögen und verstehen es, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän und lösungsorientiert zu handeln. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Belastbarkeit sowie stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab. Bezeichnen Sie sich zudem als aufgestellte, kommunikative und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einer gesunden Portion Humor? Dann sollten wir uns bald kennenlernen.  Möchten Sie Ihre Erfahrung und Ihr Organisationstalent in einem wachsenden Unternehmen einbringen? Schätzen Sie den persönlichen Kontakt mit Menschen und die Möglichkeit, mit Ihrem Engagement und Ihren Ideen etwas zu bewegen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und Diplome) an Herrn , Sr. HR Consultant, . ![Evergreen Human Resources AG]()*** ![Evergreen Human Resources AG]()***jid1e42d80jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: MLOps Engineer Intern--- MLOps Engineer Intern=====================At Swissquote, we’re all in.  All in to shake things up. Elle met, depuis 1917, ses services au profit des réseaux ferrés les plus exigeants en Suisse et en Europe. En réunissant au sein d'une même entreprise les différents aspects tels que la conception, la construction, la fabrication, l'exploitation et l'entretien des machines, Scheuchzer SA est parfaitement équipée pour répondre aux exigences de ses clients. Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous cherchons un (e): Responsable Planification et Conduite des chantiers (H/F) --------------------------------------------------------- ### Votre mission Au sein de notre centre de profit Travaux voie ferrée, vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités de planification, de préparation et de conduite des chantiers. Véritable acteur clé de notre organisation opérationnelle, vous encadrez vos équipes et assurez la coordination des ressources afin de garantir une exécution efficace des travaux, dans le respect des exigences de sécurité, de qualité, de délais et de performance. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Kitchen Director/ Chef de Cuisine - new All-Day Dining Outlet--- Kitchen Director/ Chef de Cuisine \- new All\-Day Dining Outlet===============================================================People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:  **Something new is taking shape. And you will write the first chapter.**  In the winter of 2027/28, Kulm Hotel St. will open a new all\-day dining restaurant: French in style (offering refined yet relaxed dining), generous in spirit, and built with the clear ambition to become a new culinary benchmark in the Engadin from day one. We aren't revealing all the details just yet—but for the person chosen to shape this kitchen, we are happy to lift the curtain just a bit.  We are looking for a **Kitchen Director** who doesn't just accompany an opening, but leads it with vision, a strong hands\-on mindset, and active leadership at the pass.  **What you will achieve with us:*** **Strategic \& Operational Setup:** From the initial concept idea to the grand opening night and beyond—you will drive the project from A to Z.* **A Distinct Culinary Signature:** You will develop a culinary profile that delights our discerning guests from their first morning coffee late into the evening.* **Team Building \& Leadership:** Together with us, you will assemble a high\-performing brigade of around 20 chefs, leading them inspiringly and fostering their growth.* **Internal Hub:** Working in close alignment with hotel management, Culinary Management, and the F\&B team, you will actively shape operational workflows, supplier networks, and purchasing.* **Uncompromising Standards \& Control:** Quality, flawless HACCP procedures, food cost control, stock management, and sustainable waste reduction are your daily benchmark.**This is you:**  * **Proven Opening Expert:** You have already managed a high\-profile restaurant opening or significantly contributed to one in a senior role (e.g., as Executive Sous\-Chef or Chef de Cuisine) – ideally within bistro\-style or upscale café\-restaurant operations.* **High\-End Background:** You bring solid experience from luxury hospitality and/or fine dining (comparable to a level of around 16 GaultMillau points).* **Passion for :** You are passionate about French cuisine—and you know how to interpret it in a modern, light, contemporary way, while remaining open to international influences.* **Leadership \& Integrity ("Leader at the Pass"):** You are actively involved in day\-to\-day kitchen operations. Clear communication, leading by example, and mutual respect define your management style. Teams naturally follow your lead.* **Language Skills:** An international background is welcome. Business\-fluent English and/or Italian are required; good knowledge of is a strong advantage.**Why Kulm Hotel?*** **Creative Autonomy:** The rare opportunity to help shape a new culinary concept right from the very beginning.* **Tradition Meets Future:** tourism once began at Kulm Hotel St. —now write the next great chapter.* **Strong Environment:** A highly professional, appreciative team and full backing from the executive management.**Benefits**  At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. Alongside a forward\-looking workplace in one of the world’s most beautiful destinations, we offer attractive career development opportunities, comfortable staff accommodation, excellent dining in our staff restaurant, and exclusive benefits.  **Curious?** We look forward to receiving your compelling application, including your CV and a brief note on what excites you most about this entrepreneurial role. Naturally, all inquiries will be treated with strict confidentiality.  ![AG GRAND HOTELS ENGADINERKULM]()* AG GRAND HOTELS ENGADINERKULM  Via Veglia 18, Kulm Hotel  7500 St.*jid7ff792ejm jit1146jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer--- Field Application Engineer==========================**Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.**Your responsibilities*** Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.* Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.* Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.* Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.**Who we are looking for*** Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.* Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.* Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).* Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. title: Cloud Operations Lead
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Cloud Operations Lead--- Cloud Operations Lead=====================Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity. As we continue to grow our Platform team, we are looking for a**Cloud Operations Lead (80\-100%)**to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.We are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.Tasks-----**Your Mission**As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform \& Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.**What You Own in the First 12 Months*** **Availability and customer satisfaction.** You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.* **ISO 27001 and audit readiness.** Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit\-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.* **Team depth.** No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.**Responsibilities*** **Operations and multi\-hypervisor environment:** Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi\-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.* **Networking, storage and datacenter:** Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.* **Monitoring, incident response and recovery:** Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.* **Service desk and customer support:** Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.* **Team leadership:** Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on\-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.* **Automation and process:** Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.* **Compliance and audit readiness:** Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev\- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.* **Budget, vendors and procurement:** Co\-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform \& Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.Requirements------------**Who You Are**We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.* You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.* You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.* You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.* You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.* You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.**Must Haves*** **Leadership:** 5\+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.* **VMware:** hands\-on experience in production. title: Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering
description: EinleitungstextThe Chair of Geotechnical Engineering at ETH Zurich, part of the Institute for Geotechnical Engineering (IGT), focuses its teaching and research on foundation engineering, soil mechanics and natural hazards. Our objective is to combine theoretical knowledge with experiments and numerical simulations to develop new methods for understanding and predicting the behaviour of soils, foundations and infrastructure. We are opening a position in our research group at ETH Zurich, focusing on developing and integrating modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods into geotechnical engineering research, while maintaining a strong connection to the underlying physics and mechanics. We do not aim to develop a new AI model or replace physics-based engineering with purely data-driven AI. Instead, we want to use AI to transform the way research itself is performed—from numerical model generation and experimental data acquisition to analysis, visualization and communication.For this purpose, we are looking for a Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering, who will work across the research group, collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.The role combines scientific research, computational engineering, research automation, data science and the development of reusable AI-enabled tools. A central objective is to identify new opportunities where AI can enable research that would otherwise be difficult or impossible, and to develop capabilities that can be used across the entire group.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThe job will interconnect several different areas of our activity:Scientific AI and physics-informed modellingDevelop and apply AI and machine-learning approaches to challenging problems in geotechnical engineering and computational mechanics, with particular emphasis on approaches that combine data with physical knowledge, rather than relying exclusively on black-box, data-driven models.Explore topics including physics-informed and physics-guided machine learning, hybrid physics–ML constitutive modelling, surrogate and reduced-order models, inverse problems and parameter identification, uncertainty quantification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery.Apply these methods to problems involving soil behaviour, soil–structure interaction, liquefaction, natural hazards, foundations and infrastructure resilience.AI-enabled numerical modellingDevelop tools for automating and accelerating numerical modelling workflows, including finite element (FE) and potentially discrete element (DEM) and material point method (MPM) simulations.Automate tasks, such as model generation, geometry and mesh creation, assignment of materials and boundary conditions, parameter studies, high-performance computing (HPC) execution, model verification, extraction of results and standardised post-processing.Create robust and reusable tools that enable researchers throughout the group to build and analyse numerical models more efficiently while retaining appropriate engineering control and verification.Automation of experimental researchDevelop AI-enabled methods for the acquisition, processing and interpretation of experimental data from laboratory and centrifuge testing.Automate sensor-data processing, synchronization of different measurement systems, computer-vision analysis of experiments, extraction of deformation and failure mechanisms from images and videos, identification of experimental parameters, and integration of experimental and numerical results.Geotechnical data intelligenceDevelop methods to exploit the growing volume of geotechnical data available within the group and through external repositories.Organize and extract information from historical laboratory and centrifuge experiments and numerical analyses, and exploit large external datasets and research repositories such as DesignSafe and databases containing geotechnical and geological properties.Contribute to the longer-term development of structured, physics-aware geotechnical datasets to support parameter inference, model calibration, uncertainty quantification, identification of model deficiencies and the development of new physics-informed AI approaches.Scientific visualisation and communicationDevelop automated approaches for transforming research results into high-quality visualisations, animations and videos.Develop tools that support scientific publications and presentations while facilitating effective communication of research through websites, teaching materials, professional audiences and social-media platforms.Group-wide AI capabilityHelp establish AI as a broadly accessible research capability within the group.Identify opportunities for AI across ongoing research activities, develop common tools and workflows, provide internal training and documentation, and work directly with researchers to enable them to use modern AI and computational methods effectively and independently.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an intellectually curious scientist / engineer who combines strong computational skills with an interest in physical systems and engineering research. A background in geotechnical engineering is not mandatory but can represent an advantage.PhD in computational mechanics, computational engineering, scientific machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, civil or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline.Excellent programming skills.Strong background in numerical methods, such as FEM, FD, DEM or MPM.Demonstrated experience with machine learning, modern AI methods and AI-assisted software development.Experience with scientific data engineering, databases and the processing of large or heterogeneous datasets.Experience with HPC, parallel computing and/or GPU computing.Experience with automated simulation workflows and APIs.Experience with scientific visualisation and the automated generation of figures, animations or videos.Experience with computer vision and image/video analysis is particularly valuable.Candidates from other fields than geotechnical engineering with strong expertise in computational mechanics and Scientific AI are strongly encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced geotechnical researchers who will provide the necessary domain expertise.Beyond specific technical qualifications, we are particularly interested in candidates who can bridge disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to understand an engineering or scientific problem, identify where AI or computational methods can provide genuine added value, develop a rigorous solution, and transform that solution into a reusable capability for other researchers.We therefore value scientific creativity, strong software-development practices, independence, collaborative ability and an enthusiasm for learning new areas.The position is particularly suited to someone who is excited by the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Wir bietenThe opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, computational mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Considerable freedom to identify research opportunities and contribute to the development of new methods as AI technologies and Scientific AI continue to evolve.The opportunity to work across scientific research, computational engineering, numerical simulations, experimental research and data science.Close collaboration with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists in an interdisciplinary research environment.The opportunity to develop reusable AI-enabled tools and workflows that strengthen research capabilities across the group.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:CVMotivation letterDiplomaReference LettersFurther information about the Chair of Geotechnical Engineering can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr. Alexandru Marin, Tel. +41 44 633 7370 or alexandru.marin@igt.baug.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.Investment ManagementGenerate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre-agreed trading mandate.Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance-sheet-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.Take hands-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.Risk ManagementOperate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.Improve and scale risk-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.Performance, Monitoring and ReportingMonitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.Contribution to the Fund and the FirmContribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.Governance, Compliance and ConductOperate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification the role requires in the relevant jurisdiction (for example the FCA Certification Regime in the UK); and act with integrity at all times. WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:EssentialA minimum of 7–10 years’ experience in a principal risk-taking capacity, as a trader at a sell-side institution and/or as a Portfolio Manager, Sub-Portfolio Manager or Pod Portfolio Manager at a hedge fund or asset manager, trading global macro markets.A minimum of 3 years’ attributable, verifiable track record of managing risk capital, evidenced through audited or employer-confirmed P&L and risk reports, with the candidate’s own contribution clearly separable from that of any wider team.P&L of a scale that justifies a substantial allocation of institutional capital, together with evidence of having run a large book and of the ability to scale risk as capital grows.A high quality of returns, assessed through information ratio, maximum drawdown and recovery, hit rate and consistency across market regimes, with limited reliance on a small number of outsized trades. Returns generated through excessive leverage, concentration or tail-risk selling are not regarded as evidence of skill.Experience of running directional macro risk through periods of market stress and drawdown within a formal institutional risk framework, and of operating comfortably at the scale and volatility of a flagship global macro fund.A clearly articulated, proven and repeatable investment process that can be explained from first principles: the source of edge, how ideas are generated, how positions are sized and risk-managed, and how the process has adapted to changing market conditions.A strategy and return stream that would be diversifying within a global macro portfolio. DesirableExperience as a lead Portfolio Manager at a global macro hedge fund with a multi-asset mandate spanning developed and emerging markets.Experience of managing balance-sheet-intensive strategies and large gross exposures, including funding, repo and collateral management.Experience of building and leading a team of analysts, traders or sub-portfolio managers.Experience of expressing macro views across more than one asset class, for example rates and FX together with inflation, volatility, equity indices, credit or commodities.A postgraduate qualification (Master’s, PhD or MBA) and/or a relevant professional designation such as the CFA or FRM. TECHNICAL/BUSINESS SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:EssentialExpert understanding of the pricing, mechanics, risk characteristics and regulatory treatment of global rates, FX, inflation and volatility instruments: government bonds, interest rate and cross-currency swaps, futures, options and swaptions, other OTC derivatives and financing instruments.A sophisticated understanding of global macroeconomics, monetary and fiscal policy, central bank reaction functions and their transmission into financial markets.Fluency in portfolio risk measures (VaR, expected shortfall, stress and scenario analysis, DV01, Greeks, factor exposures, liquidity and correlation risk) and in interpreting and challenging risk system output.Strong quantitative skills, including statistics, time-series analysis and derivatives pricing; technical data analysis skills, with Python or a comparable language and Bloomberg proficiency expected.Detailed knowledge of market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, execution venues and transaction cost management in the relevant markets.Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle, operational controls, counterparty and collateral arrangements, and the regulatory environment governing trading in the relevant jurisdictions.The ability to articulate complex investment views, risks and performance clearly and concisely to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and peers, verbally and in writing.Judgement under uncertainty, intellectual honesty, discipline under pressure and resilience through drawdowns; self-motivated and accountable, and able to operate in a collaborative organisation with unimpeachable integrity.A strong undergraduate degree from a respected academic institution in a rigorous discipline such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or computer science.DesirableExperience of building proprietary models, datasets and analytical tools, or of running a systematic overlay to a discretionary process.Established relationships with sell-side counterparties, brokers and liquidity providers

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Principal Data Architect--- Principal Data Architect========================Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and . We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey. **Role** As a Principal Data Architect, you will provide strategic guidance and long\-term vision across data and AI, working closely with our clients to solve complex data challenges, from platform modernisation and governance to real\-time architectures and AI operationalization. You will design and deliver data architectures and strategies that are fit for purpose, balancing technical rigour with business value, while bringing the curiosity and conviction to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of what data and AI can do for our clients. **How you’ll make impact*** **Trusted Advisor:** You guide our clients towards successful solutions to their data challenges. You'll lead design sessions, architecture reviews, proof\-of\-concept projects and evaluation of new data technologies and vendors.* **Early Engagement \& Vision:** You take part in pre\-sales and sales activities to help create a compelling vision for our clients' data strategy, modernisation and governance journeys, including transitions to cloud\-native data platforms, data meshes, real\-time data architectures, and AI\-native platforms.* **Architecture \& Implementation:** You design sophisticated architectures for data and AI projects, implementing them together with your team while inspiring your stakeholders.* **Methodology \& Concepts:** You bring rigorous methodology to every engagement, applying agile DevOps and DataOps practices to keep delivery on track, while ensuring architectural decisions are grounded in deep conceptual understanding of data platforms, data mesh, security and governance.* **Cloud Expertise:** You feel at home in both cloud and on\-premises environments. In the cloud, you design optimal solutions on Azure, AWS, and GCP, knowing when each platform is the right fit.* **Data Engineering:** You lead your team to success in flagship projects with solid data engineering knowledge, ensuring clean and maintainable code, efficient data models and robust pipelines.* **AI Operationalization:** You take data and AI projects from prototype to production readiness, with a strong focus on traceability, transparency, and reproducibility as foundations for governed and compliant AI.* **Thought Leadership \& Consulting:** You promote understanding of AI and data technologies, share your knowledge both internally and externally, and invest in growing the talent around you. **What’s important to us*** You bring deep expertise in AI and data solutions, along with a nuanced understanding of their possibilities and limitations.* You have a passion for clean, maintainable software architecture in data platforms and have taken on responsibility in technical mandates in agile environments both as an architect and as an engineer within your career.* You have proven experience leading the technical aspects of pre\-sales activities and bid management, shaping winning proposals and translating client needs into compelling solution narratives.* You are proficient across multiple data platforms and cloud environments, including Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks and Snowflake, and are comfortable with distributed processing, data modelling, API design, containerisation, serverless computation, data governance, and data security.* With your positive attitude and strong self\-motivation, you take responsibility for proposals, client projects and the further development of our data and AI competencies. You make confident decisions and can clearly explain your reasoning, balancing technical rigour with pragmatism to keep delivery on track.* Excellent communication skills on management level as well as with technical experts in both and English are essential.* You hold a technical degree in Computer Science, or a comparable field. **What we offer*** Work life blend: we offer a safe \& healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home* Profit share scheme: In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year* Global and Diverse Zühlke community: witness how colleagues from all our 16 offices across the globe come together to create a unique, positive and inclusive work culture, learning from one another at annual team camps, and celebrating year\-end parties and other local festivities.* Committed to development: we are committed to the growth of our people and are investing in your development. We’re empowering you to build the skills you need to make a positive impact, both personally and for our clients, today and in the future.
